text_en: After the death of Joshua , the children of Israel consulted the Lord , saying: Who shall go up before us against the Chanaanite , and shall be the leader of the war ?
text_la: Post mortem Josue, consuluerunt filii Israël Dominum, dicentes : Quis ascendet ante nos contra Chananæum, et erit dux belli?
text_pt: E sucedeu, depois da morte de Josué, que os filhos de Israel perguntaram ao SENHOR, dizendo: Quem dentre nós primeiro subirá aos cananeus, para pelejar contra eles?
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ τὴν τελευτὴν Ἰησοῦ καὶ ἐπηρώτων οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἐν κυρίῳ λέγοντες τίς ἀναβήσεται ἡμῖν πρὸς τὸν Χαναναῖον ἀφηγούμενος τοῦ πολεμῆσαι ἐν αὐτῷ

text_en: And the Lord said: Juda shall go up: behold I have delivered the land into his hands.
text_la: Dixitque Dominus : Judas ascendet : ecce tradidi terram in manus ejus.
text_pt: E disse o Senhor: Judá subirá; eis que entreguei esta terra na sua mão.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος Ιουδας ἀναβήσεται ἰδοὺ δέδωκα τὴν γῆν ἐν χειρὶ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Juda said to Simeon , his brother: Come up with me into my lot, and fight against the Chanaanite , that I also may go along with you into your lot. And Simeon went with him.
text_la: Et ait Judas Simeoni fratri suo : Ascende mecum in sortem meam, et pugna contra Chananæum, ut et ego pergam tecum in sortem tuam. Et abiit cum eo Simeon.
text_pt: Então disse Judá a Simeão, seu irmão: Sobe comigo à minha herança. E pelejemos contra os cananeus, e também eu contigo subirei à tua herança. E Simeão partiu com ele.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιουδας πρὸς Συμεων τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ἀνάβηθι μετ' ἐμοῦ ἐν τῷ κλήρῳ μου καὶ πολεμήσωμεν ἐν τῷ Χαναναίῳ καὶ πορεύσομαι καί γε ἐγὼ μετὰ σοῦ ἐν τῷ κλήρῳ σου καὶ ἐπορεύθη μετ' αὐτοῦ Συμεων

text_en: And Juda went up, and the Lord delivered the Chanaanite , and the Pherezite into their hands: and they slew of them in Bezec ten thousand men .
text_la: Ascenditque Judas, et tradidit Dominus Chananæum ac Pherezæum in manus eorum : et percusserunt in Bezec decem millia virorum.
text_pt: E subiu Judá, e o Senhor lhe entregou na sua mão os cananeus e os perizeus; e feriram deles, em Bezeque, a dez mil homens.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβη Ιουδας καὶ ἔδωκεν κύριος τὸν Χαναναῖον καὶ τὸν Φερεζαῖον ἐν χειρὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτοὺς ἐν Βεζεκ δέκα χιλιάδας ἀνδρῶν

text_en: And they found Adonibezec in Bezec, and fought against him, and they defeated the Chanaanite , and the Pherezite.
text_la: Inveneruntque Adonibezec in Bezec, et pugnaverunt contra eum, ac percusserunt Chananæum et Pherezæum.
text_pt: E acharam Adoni-Bezeque em Bezeque, e pelejaram contra ele; e feriram aos cananeus e aos perizeus.
text_el: καὶ εὗρον τὸν Αδωνιβεζεκ ἐν Βεζεκ καὶ ἐπολέμησαν ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ ἐπάταξαν τὸν Χαναναῖον καὶ τὸν Φερεζαῖον

text_en: And Adonibezec fled: and they pursued after him and took him, and cut off his fingers and toes.
text_la: Fugit autem Adonibezec : quem persecuti comprehenderunt, cæsis summitatibus manuum ejus ac pedum.
text_pt: Porém Adoni-Bezeque fugiu, mas o seguiram, e prenderam-no e cortaram-lhe os dedos polegares das mãos e dos pés.
text_el: καὶ ἔφυγεν Αδωνιβεζεκ καὶ κατεδίωξαν ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔλαβον αὐτὸν καὶ ἀπέκοψαν τὰ ἄκρα τῶν χειρῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Adonibezec said: Seventy kings, having their fingers and toes cut off, gathered up the leavings of the meat under my table: as I have done, so has God requited me. And they brought him to Jerusalem , and he died there.
text_la: Dixitque Adonibezec : Septuaginta reges amputatis manuum ac pedum summitatibus colligebant sub mensa mea ciborum reliquias : sicut feci, ita reddidit mihi Deus. Adduxeruntque eum in Jerusalem, et ibi mortuus est.
text_pt: Então disse Adoni-Bezeque: Setenta reis, com os dedos polegares das mãos e dos pés cortados, apanhavam as migalhas debaixo da minha mesa; assim como eu fiz, assim Deus me pagou. E levaram-no a Jerusalém, e morreu ali.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Αδωνιβεζεκ ἑβδομήκοντα βασιλεῖς τὰ ἄκρα τῶν χειρῶν αὐτῶν καὶ τῶν ποδῶν αὐτῶν ἀποκεκομμένοι ἦσαν συλλέγοντες τὰ ὑποκάτω τῆς τραπέζης μου καθὼς οὖν ἐποίησα οὕτως ἀνταπέδωκέν μοι ὁ θεός καὶ ἤγαγον αὐτὸν εἰς Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἀπέθανεν ἐκεῖ

text_en: And the children of Juda besieging Jerusalem , took it, and put it to the sword, and set the whole city on fire.
text_la: Oppugnantes ergo filii Juda Jerusalem, ceperunt eam, et percusserunt in ore gladii, tradentes cunctam incendio civitatem.
text_pt: E os filhos de Judá pelejaram contra Jerusalém, e tomando-a, feriram-na ao fio da espada; e puseram fogo na cidade.
text_el: καὶ ἐπολέμησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ιουδα ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ κατελάβοντο αὐτὴν καὶ ἐπάταξαν αὐτὴν ἐν στόματι ῥομφαίας καὶ τὴν πόλιν ἐνέπρησαν ἐν πυρί

text_en: And afterwards they went down and fought against the Chanaanite , who dwelt in the mountains, and in the south, and in the plains.
text_la: Et postea descendentes pugnaverunt contra Chananæum, qui habitabat in montanis, et ad meridiem, et in campestribus.
text_pt: E depois os filhos de Judá desceram a pelejar contra os cananeus, que habitavam nas montanhas, e no sul, e nas planícies.
text_el: καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα κατέβησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ιουδα πολεμῆσαι ἐν τῷ Χαναναίῳ τῷ κατοικοῦντι τὴν ὀρεινὴν καὶ τὸν νότον καὶ τὴν πεδινήν

text_en: And Juda going forward against the Chanaanite , that dwelt in Hebron , (the name whereof was in former times Cariath-Arbe) slew Sesai, and Ahiman, and Tholmai:
text_la: Pergensque Judas contra Chananæum, qui habitabat in Hebron (cujus nomen fuit antiquitus Cariath Arbe), percussit Sesai, et Ahiman, et Tholmai:
text_pt: E partiu Judá contra os cananeus que habitavam em Hebrom (era porém outrora o nome de Hebrom, Quiriate-Arba), e feriram a Sesai, e a Aimã e Talmai.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθη Ιουδας πρὸς τὸν Χαναναῖον τὸν κατοικοῦντα ἐν Χεβρων καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Χεβρων ἐξ ἐναντίας τὸ δὲ ὄνομα Χεβρων ἦν ἔμπροσθεν Καριαθαρβοκσεφερ καὶ ἐπάταξεν τὸν Σεσι καὶ τὸν Αχιμαν καὶ τὸν Θολμι γεννήματα τοῦ Ενακ

text_en: And departing from thence, he went to the inhabitants of Dabir, the ancient name of which was Cariath-Sepher, that is, the city of letters.
text_la: atque inde profectus abiit ad habitatores Dabir, cujus nomen vetus erat Cariath Sepher, id est, civitas litterarum.
text_pt: E dali partiu contra os moradores de Debir; e era outrora o nome de Debir, Quiriate-Sefer.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν ἐκεῖθεν πρὸς τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Δαβιρ καὶ τὸ ὄνομα Δαβιρ ἦν ἔμπροσθεν Πόλις γραμμάτων

text_en: And Caleb said: He that shall take Cariath-Sepher, and lay it waste, to him will I give my daughter Axa to wife .
text_la: Dixitque Caleb : Qui percusserit Cariath Sepher, et vastaverit eam, dabo ei Axam filiam meam uxorem.
text_pt: E disse Calebe: Quem ferir a Quiriate-Sefer, e a tomar, lhe darei a minha filha Acsa por mulher.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Χαλεβ ὃς ἂν πατάξῃ τὴν Πόλιν τῶν γραμμάτων καὶ προκαταλάβηται αὐτήν δώσω αὐτῷ τὴν Ασχαν θυγατέρα μου εἰς γυναῖκα

text_en: And Othoniel, the son of Cenez, the younger brother of Caleb , having taken it, he gave him Axa his daughter to wife .
text_la: Cumque cepisset eam Othoniel filius Cenez frater Caleb minor, dedit ei Axam filiam suam conjugem.
text_pt: E tomou-a Otniel, filho de Quenaz, o irmão de Calebe, mais novo do que ele; e Calebe lhe deu a sua filha Acsa por mulher.
text_el: καὶ προκατελάβετο αὐτὴν Γοθονιηλ υἱὸς Κενεζ ἀδελφὸς Χαλεβ ὁ νεώτερος καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ τὴν Ασχαν θυγατέρα αὐτοῦ εἰς γυναῖκα

text_en: And as she was going on her way, her husband admonished her to ask a field of her father. And as she sighed sitting on her ass, Caleb said to her: What ails you?
text_la: Quam pergentem in itinere monuit vir suus ut peteret a patre suo agrum. Quæ cum suspirasset sedens in asino, dixit ei Caleb : Quid habes?
text_pt: E sucedeu que, indo ela a ele, o persuadiu que pedisse um campo a seu pai; e ela desceu do jumento, e Calebe lhe disse: Que é que tens?
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ εἰσπορεύεσθαι αὐτὴν καὶ ἐπέσεισεν αὐτὴν αἰτῆσαι παρὰ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῆς τὸν ἀγρόν καὶ ἐγόγγυζεν ἐπάνω τοῦ ὑποζυγίου καὶ ἔκραξεν ἀπὸ τοῦ ὑποζυγίου εἰς γῆν νότου ἐκδέδοσαί με καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ Χαλεβ τί ἐστίν σοι

text_en: But she answered: Give me a blessing , for you have given me a dry land: give me also a watery land So Caleb gave her the upper and the nether watery ground.
text_la: At illa respondit : Da mihi benedictionem, quia terram arentem dedisti mihi : da et irriguam aquis. Dedit ergo ei Caleb irriguum superius, et irriguum inferius.
text_pt: E ela lhe disse: Dá-me uma bênção; pois me deste uma terra seca, dá-me também fontes de águas. E Calebe lhe deu as fontes superiores e as fontes inferiores.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ασχα δός μοι εὐλογίαν ὅτι εἰς γῆν νότου ἐκδέδοσαί με καὶ δώσεις μοι λύτρωσιν ὕδατος καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῇ Χαλεβ κατὰ τὴν καρδίαν αὐτῆς τὴν λύτρωσιν μετεώρων καὶ τὴν λύτρωσιν ταπεινῶν

text_en: And the children of the Cinite , the kinsman of Moses , went up from the city of palms, with the children of Juda , into the wilderness of his lot, which is at the south side of Arad, and they dwelt with him.
text_la: Filii autem Cinæi cognati Moysi ascenderunt de civitate palmarum cum filiis Juda, in desertum sortis ejus, quod est ad meridiem Arad, et habitaverunt cum eo.
text_pt: Também os filhos do queneu, sogro de Moisés, subiram da cidade das palmeiras com os filhos de Judá ao deserto de Judá, que está ao sul de Arade, e foram, e habitaram com o povo.
text_el: καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Ιωβαβ τοῦ Κιναίου πενθεροῦ Μωυσῆ ἀνέβησαν ἐκ τῆς πόλεως τῶν φοινίκων πρὸς τοὺς υἱοὺς Ιουδα εἰς τὴν ἔρημον τὴν οὖσαν ἐν τῷ νότῳ ἐπὶ καταβάσεως Αραδ καὶ ἐπορεύθη καὶ κατῴκησεν μετὰ τοῦ λαοῦ

text_en: And Juda went with Simeon , his brother, and they together defeated the Chanaanites that dwelt in Sephaath, and slew them. And the name of the city was called Horma, that is, Anathema .
text_la: Abiit autem Judas cum Simeone fratre suo, et percusserunt simul Chananæum qui habitabat in Sephaath, et interfecerunt eum. Vocatumque est nomen urbis, Horma, id est, anathema.
text_pt: E foi Judá com Simeão, seu irmão, e feriram aos cananeus que habitavam em Zefate; e totalmente a destruíram, e chamou-se o nome desta cidade Hormá.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθη Ιουδας μετὰ Συμεων τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπάταξαν τὸν Χαναναῖον τὸν κατοικοῦντα Σεφεθ καὶ ἀνεθεμάτισαν αὐτὴν καὶ ἐξωλέθρευσαν αὐτὴν καὶ ἐκάλεσαν τὸ ὄνομα τῆς πόλεως Ἐξολέθρευσις

text_en: And Juda took Gaza , with its confines, and Ascalon , and Accaron , with their confines.
text_la: Cepitque Judas Gazam cum finibus suis, et Ascalonem, atque Accaron cum terminis suis.
text_pt: Tomou mais Judá a Gaza com o seu termo, e a Ascalom com o seu termo, e a Ecrom com o seu termo.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἐκληρονόμησεν Ιουδας τὴν Γάζαν καὶ τὸ ὅριον αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν Ἀσκαλῶνα καὶ τὸ ὅριον αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν Ακκαρων καὶ τὸ ὅριον αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν Ἄζωτον καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς

text_en: And the Lord was with Juda , and he possessed the hill country: but was not able to destroy the inhabitants of the valley, because they had many chariots armed with scythes.
text_la: Fuitque Dominus cum Juda, et montana possedit : nec potuit delere habitatores vallis, quia falcatis curribus abundabant.
text_pt: E estava o Senhor com Judá, e despovoou as montanhas; porém não expulsou aos moradores do vale, porquanto tinham carros de ferro.
text_el: καὶ ἦν κύριος μετὰ Ιουδα καὶ ἐκληρονόμησεν τὸ ὄρος ὅτι οὐκ ἐδύνατο κληρονομῆσαι τοὺς κατοικοῦντας τὴν κοιλάδα ὅτι Ρηχαβ διεστείλατο αὐτήν

text_en: And they gave Hebron to Caleb , as Moses had said, who destroyed out of it the three sons of Enac.
text_la: Dederuntque Caleb Hebron, sicut dixerat Moyses, qui delevit ex ea tres filios Enac.
text_pt: E deram Hebrom a Calebe, como Moisés o dissera; e dali expulsou os três filhos de Anaque.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν τῷ Χαλεβ τὴν Χεβρων καθὰ ἐλάλησεν Μωυσῆς καὶ ἐκληρονόμησεν ἐκεῖθεν τὰς τρεῖς πόλεις καὶ ἐξῆρεν ἐκεῖθεν τοὺς τρεῖς υἱοὺς Ενακ

text_en: But the sons of Benjamin did not destroy the Jebusites that inhabited Jerusalem : and the Jebusite has dwelt with the sons of Benjamin in Jerusalem until this present day.
text_la: Jebusæum autem habitatorem Jerusalem non deleverunt filii Benjamin : habitavitque Jebusæus cum filiis Benjamin in Jerusalem, usque in præsentem diem.
text_pt: Porém os filhos de Benjamim não expulsaram os jebuseus que habitavam em Jerusalém; antes os jebuseus ficaram habitando com os filhos de Benjamim em Jerusalém, até ao dia de hoje,
text_el: καὶ τὸν Ιεβουσαῖον τὸν κατοικοῦντα ἐν Ιερουσαλημ οὐκ ἐξῆραν οἱ υἱοὶ Βενιαμιν καὶ κατῴκησεν ὁ Ιεβουσαῖος μετὰ τῶν υἱῶν Βενιαμιν ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης

text_en: The house of Joseph also went up against Bethel , and the Lord was with them.
text_la: Domus quoque Joseph ascendit in Bethel, fuitque Dominus cum eis.
text_pt: E subiu também a casa de José contra Betel, e foi o Senhor com eles.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ιωσηφ καί γε αὐτοὶ εἰς Βαιθηλ καὶ Ιουδας μετ' αὐτῶν

text_en: For when they were besieging the city, which before was called Luza,
text_la: Nam cum obsiderent urbem, quæ prius Luza vocabatur,
text_pt: E a casa de José mandou espias a Betel, e foi antes o nome desta cidade Luz.
text_el: καὶ παρενέβαλον οἶκος Ισραηλ κατὰ Βαιθηλ τὸ δὲ ὄνομα τῆς πόλεως ἦν ἔμπροσθεν Λουζα

text_en: they saw a man coming out of the city, and they said to him: Show us the entrance into the city, and we will show you mercy.
text_la: viderunt hominem egredientem de civitate, dixeruntque ad eum : Ostende nobis introitum civitatis, et faciemus tecum misericordiam.
text_pt: E viram os espias a um homem, que saía da cidade, e lhe disseram: Ora, mostra-nos a entrada da cidade, e usaremos contigo de misericórdia.
text_el: καὶ εἶδον οἱ φυλάσσοντες ἄνδρα ἐκπορευόμενον ἐκ τῆς πόλεως καὶ ἔλαβαν αὐτὸν καὶ εἶπον αὐτῷ δεῖξον ἡμῖν τὴν εἴσοδον τῆς πόλεως καὶ ποιήσομεν μετὰ σοῦ ἔλεος

text_en: And when he had showed them, they smote the city with the edge of the sword: but that man , and all his kindred, they let go:
text_la: Qui cum ostendisset eis, percusserunt urbem in ore gladii : hominem autem illum, et omnem cognationem ejus, dimiserunt.
text_pt: E, mostrando-lhes ele a entrada da cidade, feriram-na ao fio da espada; porém àquele homem e a toda a sua família deixaram ir.
text_el: καὶ ἔδειξεν αὐτοῖς τὴν εἴσοδον τῆς πόλεως καὶ ἐπάταξαν τὴν πόλιν ἐν στόματι ῥομφαίας τὸν δὲ ἄνδρα καὶ τὴν συγγένειαν αὐτοῦ ἐξαπέστειλαν

text_en: Who being sent away, went into the land of Hetthim, and built there a city, and called it Luza : which is so called until this day.
text_la: Qui dimissus, abiit in terram Hetthim, et ædificavit ibi civitatem, vocavitque eam Luzam : quæ ita appellatur usque in præsentem diem.
text_pt: Então aquele homem se foi à terra dos heteus, e edificou uma cidade, e chamou o seu nome Luz; este é o seu nome até ao dia de hoje.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆλθεν ὁ ἀνὴρ εἰς γῆν Χεττιιμ καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν ἐκεῖ πόλιν καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτῆς Λουζα τοῦτο ὄνομα αὐτῆς ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης

text_en: Manasses also did not destroy Bethsan , and Thanac, with their villages ; nor the inhabitants of Dor, and Jeblaam, and Mageddo , with their villages . And the Chanaanite began to dwell with them.
text_la: Manasses quoque non delevit Bethsan, et Thanac cum viculis suis, et habitatores Dor, et Jeblaam, et Mageddo cum viculis suis, cœpitque Chananæus habitare cum eis.
text_pt: Manassés não expulsou os habitantes de Bete-Seã, nem mesmo dos lugares da sua jurisdição; nem a Taanaque, com os lugares da sua jurisdição; nem os moradores de Dor, com os lugares da sua jurisdição; nem os moradores de Ibleão, com os lugares da sua jurisdição; nem os moradores de Megido, com os lugares da sua jurisdição; e resolveram os cananeus habitar na mesma terra.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἐκληρονόμησεν Μανασσης τὴν Βαιθσαν ἥ ἐστιν Σκυθῶν πόλις οὐδὲ τὰς θυγατέρας αὐτῆς οὐδὲ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς οὐδὲ τὴν Εκθανααδ καὶ τὰς θυγατέρας αὐτῆς οὐδὲ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Δωρ καὶ τὰς θυγατέρας αὐτῆς καὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Βαλααμ καὶ τὰς θυγατέρας αὐτῆς καὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Μαγεδων καὶ τὰς θυγατέρας αὐτῆς οὐδὲ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Ιεβλααμ οὐδὲ τὰς θυγατέρας αὐτῆς καὶ ἤρξατο ὁ Χαναναῖος κατοικεῖν ἐν τῇ γῇ ταύτῃ

text_en: But after Israel was grown strong, he made them tributaries, and would not destroy them.
text_la: Postquam autem confortatus est Israël, fecit eos tributarios, et delere noluit.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, quando Israel cobrou mais forças, fez dos cananeus tributários; porém não os expulsou de todo.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὅτε ἐνίσχυσεν Ισραηλ καὶ ἔθετο τὸν Χαναναῖον εἰς φόρον καὶ ἐξαίρων οὐκ ἐξῆρεν αὐτόν

text_en: Ephraim also did not slay the Chanaanite that dwelt in Gazer, but dwelt with him.
text_la: Ephraim etiam non interfecit Chananæum, qui habitabat in Gazer, sed habitavit cum eo.
text_pt: Tampouco expulsou Efraim os cananeus que habitavam em Gezer; antes os cananeus ficaram habitando com ele, em Gezer.
text_el: καὶ Εφραιμ οὐκ ἐξῆρεν τὸν Χαναναῖον τὸν κατοικοῦντα ἐν Γαζερ καὶ κατῴκει ὁ Χαναναῖος ἐν μέσῳ αὐτοῦ ἐν Γαζερ καὶ ἐγένετο εἰς φόρον

text_en: Zabulon destroyed not the inhabitants of Cetron, and Naalol: but the Chanaanite dwelt among them, and became their tributary.
text_la: Zabulon non delevit habitatores Cetron, et Naalol : sed habitavit Chananæus in medio ejus, factusque est ei tributarius.
text_pt: Tampouco expulsou Zebulom os moradores de Quitrom, nem os moradores de Naalol; porém os cananeus ficaram habitando com ele, e foram tributários.
text_el: καὶ Ζαβουλων οὐκ ἐξῆρεν τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Κεδρων καὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Ενααλα καὶ κατῴκησεν ὁ Χαναναῖος ἐν μέσῳ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐγένετο εἰς φόρον

text_en: Aser also destroyed not the inhabitants of Accho, and of Sidon , of Ahalab, and of Achazib, and of Helba, and of Aphec, and of Rohob:
text_la: Aser quoque non delevit habitatores Accho, et Sidonis, Ahalab, et Achazib, et Helba, et Aphec, et Rohob:
text_pt: Tampouco Aser expulsou os moradores de Aco, nem os moradores de Sidom; como nem de Alabe, nem de Aczibe, nem de Helba, nem de Afeque, nem de Reobe;
text_el: καὶ Ασηρ οὐκ ἐξῆρεν τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Ακχω καὶ ἐγένετο αὐτῷ εἰς φόρον καὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Δωρ καὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Σιδῶνα καὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Ααλαφ καὶ τὸν Αχαζιβ καὶ τὴν Χελβα καὶ τὴν Αφεκ καὶ τὴν Ροωβ

text_en: And he dwelt in the midst of the Chanaanites , the inhabitants of that land, and did not slay them.
text_la: habitavitque in medio Chananæi habitatoris illius terræ, nec interfecit eum.
text_pt: Porém os aseritas habitaram no meio dos cananeus que habitavam na terra; porquanto não os expulsaram.
text_el: καὶ κατῴκησεν Ασηρ ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ Χαναναίου τοῦ κατοικοῦντος τὴν γῆν ὅτι οὐκ ἐδυνάσθη ἐξᾶραι αὐτόν

text_en: Nephthali also destroyed not the inhabitants of Bethsames, and of Bethanath: and he dwelt in the midst of the Chanaanites , the inhabitants of the land, and the Bethsamites and Bethanites were tributaries to him.
text_la: Nephthali quoque non delevit habitatores Bethsames, et Bethanath : et habitavit inter Chananæum habitatorem terræ, fueruntque ei Bethsamitæ et Bethanitæ tributarii.
text_pt: Tampouco Naftali expulsou os moradores de Bete-Semes, nem os moradores de Bete-Anate; mas habitou no meio dos cananeus que habitavam na terra; porém lhes foram tributários os moradores de Bete-Semes e Bete-Anate.
text_el: καὶ Νεφθαλι οὐκ ἐξῆρεν τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Βαιθσαμυς οὐδὲ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Βαιθενεθ καὶ κατῴκησεν Ισραηλ ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ Χαναναίου τοῦ κατοικοῦντος τὴν γῆν οἱ δὲ κατοικοῦντες Βαιθσαμυς καὶ τὴν Βαιθενεθ ἐγενήθησαν αὐτοῖς εἰς φόρον

text_en: And the Amorrhite straitened the children of Dan in the mountain, and gave them not a place to go down to the plain:
text_la: Arctavitque Amorrhæus filios Dan in monte, nec dedit eis locum ut ad planiora descenderent:
text_pt: E os amorreus impeliram os filhos de Dã até às montanhas; porque nem os deixavam descer ao vale.
text_el: καὶ ἐξέθλιψεν ὁ Αμορραῖος τοὺς υἱοὺς Δαν εἰς τὸ ὄρος ὅτι οὐκ ἀφῆκεν αὐτὸν καταβῆναι εἰς τὴν κοιλάδα

text_en: And he dwelt in the mountain Hares, that is, of potsherds, in Aialon and Salebim. And the hand of the house of Joseph was heavy upon him, and he became tributary to him.
text_la: habitavitque in monte Hares, quod interpretatur testaceo, in Ajalon et Salebim. Et aggravata est manus domus Joseph, factusque est ei tributarius.
text_pt: Também os amorreus quiseram habitar nas montanhas de Heres, em Aijalom e em Saalbim; porém prevaleceu a mão da casa de José, e ficaram tributários.
text_el: καὶ ἤρξατο ὁ Αμορραῖος κατοικεῖν ἐν τῷ ὄρει τοῦ Μυρσινῶνος οὗ αἱ ἄρκοι καὶ αἱ ἀλώπεκες καὶ ἐβαρύνθη ἡ χεὶρ οἴκου Ιωσηφ ἐπὶ τὸν Αμορραῖον καὶ ἐγένετο εἰς φόρον

text_en: And the border of the Amorrhite was from the ascent of the scorpion, the rock, and the higher places.
text_la: Fuit autem terminus Amorrhæi ab ascensu Scorpionis, petra, et superiora loca.
text_pt: E foi o termo dos amorreus desde a subida de Acrabim, desde a penha, e dali para cima.
text_el: καὶ τὸ ὅριον τοῦ Αμορραίου ὁ Ιδουμαῖος ἐπάνω Ακραβιν ἐπὶ τῆς Πέτρας καὶ ἐπάνω

text_en: And an angel of the Lord went up from Galgal to the place of weepers, and said: I made you go out of Egypt , and have brought you into the land for which I swore to your fathers: and I promised that I would not make void my covenant with you for ever:
text_la: Ascenditque angelus Domini de Galgalis ad Locum flentium, et ait : Eduxi vos de Ægypto, et introduxi in terram, pro qua juravi patribus vestris : et pollicitus sum ut non facerem irritum pactum meum vobiscum in sempiternum,
text_pt: E subiu o anjo do SENHOR de Gilgal a Boquim, e disse: Do Egito vos fiz subir, e vos trouxe à terra que a vossos pais tinha jurado e disse: Nunca invalidarei a minha aliança convosco.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβη ἄγγελος κυρίου ἀπὸ Γαλγαλ ἐπὶ τὸν Κλαυθμῶνα καὶ ἐπὶ Βαιθηλ καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον Ισραηλ καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς κύριος κύριος ἀνεβίβασεν ὑμᾶς ἐξ Αἰγύπτου καὶ εἰσήγαγεν ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν ὤμοσεν τοῖς πατράσιν ὑμῶν τοῦ δοῦναι ὑμῖν καὶ εἶπεν ὑμῖν οὐ διασκεδάσω τὴν διαθήκην μου τὴν μεθ' ὑμῶν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: On condition that you should not make a league with the inhabitants of this land, but should throw down their altars : and you would not hear my voice: why have you done this?
text_la: ita dumtaxat ut non feriretis fœdus cum habitatoribus terræ hujus, sed aras eorum subverteretis : et noluistis audire vocem meam : cur hoc fecistis?
text_pt: E, quanto a vós, não fareis acordo com os moradores desta terra, antes derrubareis os seus altares; mas vós não obedecestes à minha voz. Por que fizestes isso?
text_el: καὶ ὑμεῖς οὐ διαθήσεσθε διαθήκην τοῖς ἐγκαθημένοις εἰς τὴν γῆν ταύτην οὐδὲ τοῖς θεοῖς αὐτῶν οὐ μὴ προσκυνήσητε ἀλλὰ τὰ γλυπτὰ αὐτῶν συντρίψετε καὶ τὰ θυσιαστήρια αὐτῶν κατασκάψετε καὶ οὐκ εἰσηκούσατε τῆς φωνῆς μου ὅτε ταῦτα ἐποιήσατε

text_en: Wherefore I would not destroy them from before your face; that you may have enemies, and their gods may be your ruin.
text_la: Quam ob rem nolui delere eos a facie vestra : ut habeatis hostes, et dii eorum sint vobis in ruinam.
text_pt: Assim também eu disse: Não os expulsarei de diante de vós; antes estarão como espinhos nas vossas ilhargas, e os seus deuses vos serão por laço.
text_el: καὶ ἐγὼ εἶπα οὐ προσθήσω τοῦ μετοικίσαι τὸν λαόν ὃν εἶπα τοῦ ἐξολεθρεῦσαι αὐτοὺς ἐκ προσώπου ὑμῶν καὶ ἔσονται ὑμῖν εἰς συνοχάς καὶ οἱ θεοὶ αὐτῶν ἔσονται ὑμῖν εἰς σκάνδαλον

text_en: And when the angel of the Lord spoke these words to all the children of Israel : they lifted up their voice, and wept.
text_la: Cumque loqueretur angelus Domini hæc verba ad omnes filios Israël, elevaverunt ipsi vocem suam, et fleverunt.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, falando o anjo do Senhor estas palavras a todos os filhos de Israel, o povo levantou a sua voz e chorou.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἐλάλησεν ὁ ἄγγελος κυρίου τοὺς λόγους τούτους πρὸς πάντα Ισραηλ καὶ ἐπῆρεν ὁ λαὸς τὴν φωνὴν αὐτῶν καὶ ἔκλαυσαν

text_en: And the name of that place was called, The place of weepers , or of tears : and there they offered sacrifices to the Lord .
text_la: Et vocatum est nomen loci illius, Locus flentium, sive lacrimarum : immolaveruntque ibi hostias Domini.
text_pt: Por isso chamaram àquele lugar, Boquim; e sacrificaram ali ao Senhor.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἐκλήθη τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ τόπου ἐκείνου Κλαυθμών καὶ ἔθυσαν ἐκεῖ τῷ κυρίῳ

text_en: And Joshua sent away the people, and the children of Israel went every one to his own possession to hold it:
text_la: Dimisit ergo Josue populum, et abierunt filii Israël unusquisque in possessionem suam, ut obtinerent eam:
text_pt: E havendo Josué despedido o povo foram-se os filhos de Israel, cada um à sua herança, para possuírem a terra.
text_el: καὶ ἐξαπέστειλεν Ἰησοῦς τὸν λαόν καὶ ἀπῆλθαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἕκαστος εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰς τὴν κληρονομίαν αὐτοῦ τοῦ κατακληρονομῆσαι τὴν γῆν

text_en: And they served the Lord all his days, and the days of the ancients, that lived a long time after him, and who knew all the works of the Lord , which he had done for Israel .
text_la: servieruntque Domino cunctis diebus ejus, et seniorum, qui longo post eum vixerunt tempore, et noverant omnia opera Domini quæ fecerat cum Israël.
text_pt: E serviu o povo ao Senhor todos os dias de Josué, e todos os dias dos anciãos que ainda sobreviveram depois de Josué, e viram toda aquela grande obra do Senhor, que fizera a Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐδούλευσεν ὁ λαὸς τῷ κυρίῳ πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας Ἰησοῦ καὶ πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τῶν πρεσβυτέρων ὅσοι ἐμακροημέρευσαν μετὰ Ἰησοῦν ὅσοι ἔγνωσαν πᾶν τὸ ἔργον κυρίου τὸ μέγα ὃ ἐποίησεν τῷ Ισραηλ

text_en: And Joshua, the son of Nun , the servant of the Lord , died, being a hundred and ten years old;
text_la: Mortuus est autem Josue filius Nun, famulus Domini, centum et decem annorum,
text_pt: Faleceu, porém, Josué, filho de Num, servo do Senhor, com a idade de cento e dez anos;
text_el: καὶ ἐτελεύτησεν Ἰησοῦς υἱὸς Ναυη δοῦλος κυρίου υἱὸς ἑκατὸν δέκα ἐτῶν

text_en: and they buried him in the borders of his possession in Thamnathsare, in Mount Ephraim, on the north side of Mount Gaas.
text_la: et sepelierunt eum in finibus possessionis suæ in Thamnathsare in monte Ephraim, a septentrionali plaga montis Gaas.
text_pt: E sepultaram-no no termo da sua herança, em Timnate-Heres, no monte de Efraim, para o norte do monte de Gaás.
text_el: καὶ ἔθαψαν αὐτὸν ἐν ὁρίῳ τῆς κληρονομίας αὐτοῦ ἐν Θαμναθαρες ἐν ὄρει Εφραιμ ἀπὸ βορρᾶ τοῦ ὄρους Γαας

text_en: And all that generation was gathered to their fathers: and there arose others that knew not the Lord and the works which he had done for Israel .
text_la: Omnisque illa generatio congregata est ad patres suos : et surrexerunt alii, qui non noverant Dominum, et opera quæ fecerat cum Israël.
text_pt: E foi também congregada toda aquela geração a seus pais, e outra geração após ela se levantou, que não conhecia ao Senhor, nem tampouco a obra que ele fizera a Israel.
text_el: καὶ πᾶσα ἡ γενεὰ ἐκείνη προσετέθησαν πρὸς τοὺς πατέρας αὐτῶν καὶ ἀνέστη γενεὰ ἑτέρα μετ' αὐτούς ὅσοι οὐκ ἔγνωσαν τὸν κύριον καὶ τὸ ἔργον ὃ ἐποίησεν τῷ Ισραηλ

text_en: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord , and they served Baalim ,
text_la: Feceruntque filii Israël malum in conspectu Domini, et servierunt Baalim.
text_pt: Então fizeram os filhos de Israel o que era mau aos olhos do Senhor; e serviram aos baalins.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ τὸ πονηρὸν ἐναντίον κυρίου καὶ ἐλάτρευον τοῖς Βααλιμ

text_en: and they left the Lord , the God of their fathers, who had brought them out of the land of Egypt : and they followed strange gods , and the gods of the people that dwelt round about them, and they adored them: and they provoked the Lord to anger ,
text_la: Ac dimiserunt Dominum Deum patrum suorum, qui eduxerat eos de terra Ægypti, et secuti sunt deos alienos, deosque populorum, qui habitabant in circuitu eorum, et adoraverunt eos : et ad iracundiam concitaverunt Dominum,
text_pt: E deixaram ao Senhor Deus de seus pais, que os tirara da terra do Egito, e foram-se após outros deuses, dentre os deuses dos povos, que havia ao redor deles, e adoraram a eles; e provocaram o Senhor à ira.
text_el: καὶ ἐγκατέλιπον τὸν κύριον θεὸν τῶν πατέρων αὐτῶν τὸν ἐξαγαγόντα αὐτοὺς ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν ὀπίσω θεῶν ἑτέρων ἀπὸ τῶν θεῶν τῶν λαῶν τῶν περικύκλῳ αὐτῶν καὶ προσεκύνησαν αὐτοῖς καὶ παρώργισαν τὸν κύριον

text_en: forsaking him, and serving Baal and Astaroth
text_la: dimittentes eum, et servientes Baal et Astaroth.
text_pt: Porquanto deixaram ao Senhor, e serviram a Baal e a Astarote.
text_el: καὶ ἐγκατέλιπον τὸν κύριον καὶ ἐλάτρευσαν τῇ Βααλ καὶ ταῖς Ἀστάρταις

text_en: and the Lord being angry against Israel , delivered them into the hands of plunderers: who took them and sold them to their enemies, that dwelt round about: neither could they stand against their enemies:
text_la: Iratusque Dominus contra Israël, tradidit eos in manus diripientium : qui ceperunt eos, et vendiderunt hostibus qui habitabant per gyrum : nec potuerunt resistere adversariis suis,
text_pt: Por isso a ira do Senhor se acendeu contra Israel, e os entregou na mão dos espoliadores que os despojaram; e os entregou na mão dos seus inimigos ao redor; e não puderam mais resistir diante dos seus inimigos.
text_el: καὶ ὠργίσθη θυμῷ κύριος τῷ Ισραηλ καὶ παρέδωκεν αὐτοὺς ἐν χειρὶ προνομευόντων καὶ ἐπρονόμευσαν αὐτούς καὶ ἀπέδοτο αὐτοὺς ἐν χειρὶ τῶν ἐχθρῶν αὐτῶν κυκλόθεν καὶ οὐκ ἠδυνάσθησαν ἀντιστῆναι κατὰ πρόσωπον τῶν ἐχθρῶν αὐτῶν

text_en: But wherever they meant to go, the hand of the Lord was upon them, as he had said, and as he had sworn to them: and they were greatly distressed.
text_la: sed quocumque pergere voluissent, manus Domini super eos erat, sicut locutus est, et juravit eis, et vehementer afflicti sunt.
text_pt: Por onde quer que saíam, a mão do Senhor era contra eles para mal, como o Senhor tinha falado, e como o Senhor lhes tinha jurado; e estavam em grande aflição.
text_el: ἐν πᾶσιν οἷς ἐπόρνευον καὶ χεὶρ κυρίου ἦν αὐτοῖς εἰς κακά καθὼς ἐλάλησεν κύριος καὶ καθὼς ὤμοσεν κύριος καὶ ἐξέθλιψεν αὐτοὺς σφόδρα

text_en: And the Lord raised up judges, to deliver them from the hands of those that oppressed them: but they would not hearken to them,
text_la: Suscitavitque Dominus judices, qui liberarent eos de vastantium manibus : sed nec eos audire voluerunt,
text_pt: E levantou o Senhor juízes, que os livraram da mão dos que os despojaram.
text_el: καὶ ἤγειρεν αὐτοῖς κύριος κριτὰς καὶ ἔσωσεν αὐτοὺς ἐκ χειρὸς τῶν προνομευόντων αὐτούς

text_en: committing fornication with strange gods , and adoring them. They quickly forsook the way, in which their fathers had walked: and hearing the commandments of the Lord , they did all things contrary.
text_la: fornicantes cum diis alienis, et adorantes eos. Cito deseruerunt viam, per quam ingressi fuerant patres eorum : et audientes mandata Domini, omnia fecere contraria.
text_pt: Porém tampouco ouviram aos juízes, antes prostituíram-se após outros deuses, e adoraram a eles; depressa se desviaram do caminho, por onde andaram seus pais, obedecendo os mandamentos do Senhor; mas eles assim não fizeram.
text_el: καί γε τῶν κριτῶν αὐτῶν οὐκ ἐπήκουσαν ὅτι ἐξεπόρνευσαν ὀπίσω θεῶν ἑτέρων καὶ προσεκύνησαν αὐτοῖς καὶ παρώργισαν τὸν κύριον καὶ ἐξέκλιναν ταχὺ ἐκ τῆς ὁδοῦ ἧς ἐπορεύθησαν οἱ πατέρες αὐτῶν τοῦ εἰσακούειν ἐντολὰς κυρίου οὐκ ἐποίησαν οὕτως

text_en: And when the Lord raised them up judges, in their days, he was moved to mercy, and heard the groanings of the afflicted, and delivered them from the slaughter of the oppressors.
text_la: Cumque Dominus judices suscitaret, in diebus eorum flectebatur misericordia, et audiebat afflictorum gemitus, et liberabat eos de cæde vastantium.
text_pt: E, quando o Senhor lhes levantava juízes, o Senhor era com o juiz, e os livrava da mão dos seus inimigos, todos os dias daquele juiz; porquanto o Senhor se compadecia deles pelo seu gemido, por causa dos que os oprimiam e afligiam.
text_el: καὶ ὅτι ἤγειρεν αὐτοῖς κύριος κριτάς καὶ ἦν κύριος μετὰ τοῦ κριτοῦ καὶ ἔσωσεν αὐτοὺς ἐκ χειρὸς τῶν ἐχθρῶν αὐτῶν πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τοῦ κριτοῦ ὅτι παρεκλήθη κύριος ἀπὸ τοῦ στεναγμοῦ αὐτῶν ἀπὸ προσώπου τῶν πολιορκούντων αὐτοὺς καὶ κακούντων αὐτούς

text_en: But after the judge was dead, they returned, and did much worse things than their fathers had done, following strange gods , serving them, and adoring them. They left not their own inventions, and the stubborn way, by which they were accustomed to walk.
text_la: Postquam autem mortuus esset judex, revertebantur, et multo faciebant pejora quam fecerant patres eorum, sequentes deos alienos, servientes eis, et adorantes illos. Non dimiserunt adinventiones suas, et viam durissimam per quam ambulare consueverunt.
text_pt: Porém sucedia que, falecendo o juiz, reincidiam e se corrompiam mais do que seus pais, andando após outros deuses, servindo-os, e adorando-os; nada deixavam das suas obras, nem do seu obstinado caminho.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἀπέθνῃσκεν ὁ κριτής καὶ ἀπέστρεψαν καὶ πάλιν διέφθειραν ὑπὲρ τοὺς πατέρας αὐτῶν πορευθῆναι ὀπίσω θεῶν ἑτέρων λατρεύειν αὐτοῖς καὶ προσκυνεῖν αὐτοῖς οὐκ ἀπέρριψαν τὰ ἐπιτηδεύματα αὐτῶν καὶ οὐκ ἀπέστησαν ἀπὸ τῆς ὁδοῦ αὐτῶν τῆς σκληρᾶς

text_en: And the wrath of the Lord was kindled against Israel , and he said: Behold this nation has made void my covenant, which I had made with their fathers, and has despised to hearken to my voice:
text_la: Iratusque est furor Domini in Israël, et ait : Quia irritum fecit gens ista pactum meum, quod pepigeram cum patribus eorum, et vocem meam audire contempsit:
text_pt: Por isso a ira do Senhor se acendeu contra Israel, e disse: Porquanto este povo transgrediu a minha aliança, que tinha ordenado a seus pais, e não deram ouvidos à minha voz,
text_el: καὶ ὠργίσθη θυμῷ κύριος ἐν τῷ Ισραηλ καὶ εἶπεν ἀνθ' ὧν ὅσα ἐγκατέλιπαν τὸ ἔθνος τοῦτο τὴν διαθήκην μου ἣν ἐνετειλάμην τοῖς πατράσιν αὐτῶν καὶ οὐχ ὑπήκουσαν τῆς φωνῆς μου

text_en: I also will not destroy the nations which Joshua left when he died:
text_la: et ego non delebo gentes, quas dimisit Josue, et mortuus est:
text_pt: Tampouco desapossarei mais de diante deles a nenhuma das nações, que Josué deixou, quando morreu;
text_el: καὶ ἐγὼ οὐ προσθήσω τοῦ ἐξᾶραι ἄνδρα ἐκ προσώπου αὐτῶν ἀπὸ τῶν ἐθνῶν ὧν κατέλιπεν Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἀφῆκεν

text_en: That through them I may try Israel , whether they will keep the way of the Lord , and walk in it, as their fathers kept it, or not.
text_la: ut in ipsis experiar Israël, utrum custodiant viam Domini, et ambulent in ea, sicut custodierunt patres eorum, an non.
text_pt: Para por elas provar a Israel, se há de guardar, ou não, o caminho do Senhor, como seus pais o guardaram, para nele andar.
text_el: τοῦ πειράσαι ἐν αὐτοῖς τὸν Ισραηλ εἰ φυλάσσονται τὴν ὁδὸν κυρίου πορεύεσθαι ἐν αὐτῇ ὃν τρόπον ἐφυλάξαντο οἱ πατέρες αὐτῶν ἢ οὔ

text_en: The Lord therefore left all these nations , and would not quickly destroy them, neither did he deliver them into the hands of Joshua .
text_la: Dimisit ergo Dominus omnes nationes has, et cito subvertere noluit, nec tradidit in manus Josue.
text_pt: Assim o Senhor deixou ficar aquelas nações, e não as desterrou logo, nem as entregou na mão de Josué.
text_el: καὶ ἀφῆκεν κύριος τὰ ἔθνη ταῦτα τοῦ μὴ ἐξᾶραι αὐτὰ τὸ τάχος καὶ οὐ παρέδωκεν αὐτὰ ἐν χειρὶ Ἰησοῦ

text_en: These are the nations which the Lord left, that by them he might instruct Israel , and all that had not known the wars of the Chanaanites :
text_la: Hæ sunt gentes quas Dominus dereliquit, ut erudiret in eis Israëlem, et omnes qui non noverant bella Chananæorum:
text_pt: Estas, pois, são as nações que o SENHOR deixou ficar, para por elas provar a Israel, a saber, a todos os que não sabiam de todas as guerras de Canaã.
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα τὰ ἔθνη ἀφῆκεν Ἰησοῦς ὥστε πειράσαι ἐν αὐτοῖς τὸν Ισραηλ πάντας τοὺς μὴ ἐγνωκότας πάντας τοὺς πολέμους Χανααν

text_en: That afterwards their children might learn to fight with their enemies, and to be trained up to war :
text_la: ut postea discerent filii eorum certare cum hostibus, et habere consuetudinem præliandi:
text_pt: Tão-somente para que as gerações dos filhos de Israel delas soubessem (para lhes ensinar a guerra), pelo menos os que dantes não sabiam delas.
text_el: πλὴν διὰ τὰς γενεὰς τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ τοῦ διδάξαι αὐτοὺς πόλεμον πλὴν οἱ ἔμπροσθεν αὐτῶν οὐκ ἔγνωσαν αὐτά

text_en: The five princes of the Philistines , and all the Chanaanites , and the Sidonians , and the Hevites that dwelt in Mount Libanus, from Mount Baal Hermon to the entering into Emath.
text_la: quinque satrapas Philisthinorum, omnemque Chananæum, et Sidonium, atque Hevæum, qui habitabat in monte Libano, de monte Baal Hermon usque ad introitum Emath.
text_pt: Cinco príncipes dos filisteus, e todos os cananeus, e sidônios, e heveus que habitavam nas montanhas do Líbano desde o monte de Baal-Hermom, até à entrada de Hamate.
text_el: τὰς πέντε σατραπείας τῶν ἀλλοφύλων καὶ πάντα τὸν Χαναναῖον καὶ τὸν Σιδώνιον καὶ τὸν Ευαῖον τὸν κατοικοῦντα τὸν Λίβανον ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄρους τοῦ Βαλαερμων ἕως Λοβωημαθ

text_en: And he left them, that he might try Israel by them, whether they would hear the commandments of the Lord , which he had commanded their fathers, by the hand of Moses , or not.
text_la: Dimisitque eos, ut in ipsis experiretur Israëlem, utrum audiret mandata Domini quæ præceperat patribus eorum per manum Moysi, an non.
text_pt: Estes, pois, ficaram, para por eles provar a Israel, para saber se dariam ouvido aos mandamentos do Senhor, que ele tinha ordenado a seus pais, pelo ministério de Moisés.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὥστε πειράσαι ἐν αὐτοῖς τὸν Ισραηλ γνῶναι εἰ ἀκούσονται τὰς ἐντολὰς κυρίου ἃς ἐνετείλατο τοῖς πατράσιν αὐτῶν ἐν χειρὶ Μωυσῆ

text_en: So the children of Israel dwelt in the midst of the Chanaanite , and the Hethite , and the Amorrhite , and the Pherezite, and the Hevite, and the Jebusite:
text_la: Itaque filii Israël habitaverunt in medio Chananæi, et Hethæi, et Amorrhæi, et Pherezæi, et Hevæi, et Jebusæi:
text_pt: Habitando, pois, os filhos de Israel no meio dos cananeus, dos heteus, e amorreus, e perizeus, e heveus, e jebuseus,
text_el: καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ κατῴκησαν ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ Χαναναίου καὶ τοῦ Χετταίου καὶ τοῦ Αμορραίου καὶ τοῦ Φερεζαίου καὶ τοῦ Ευαίου καὶ τοῦ Ιεβουσαίου

text_en: And they took their daughters to wives , and they gave their own daughters to their sons, and they served their gods .
text_la: et duxerunt uxores filias eorum, ipsique filias suas filiis eorum tradiderunt, et servierunt diis eorum.
text_pt: Tomaram de suas filhas para si por mulheres, e deram as suas filhas aos filhos deles; e serviram aos seus deuses.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβον τὰς θυγατέρας αὐτῶν ἑαυτοῖς εἰς γυναῖκας καὶ τὰς θυγατέρας αὐτῶν ἔδωκαν τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτῶν καὶ ἐλάτρευσαν τοῖς θεοῖς αὐτῶν

text_en: And they did evil in the sight of the Lord , and they forgot their God , and served Baalim and Astaroth.
text_la: Feceruntque malum in conspectu Domini, et obliti sunt Dei sui, servientes Baalim et Astaroth.
text_pt: E os filhos de Israel fizeram o que era mau aos olhos do Senhor, e se esqueceram do Senhor seu Deus; e serviram aos baalins e a Astarote.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ τὸ πονηρὸν ἔναντι κυρίου καὶ ἐπελάθοντο κυρίου θεοῦ αὐτῶν καὶ ἐλάτρευσαν ταῖς Βααλιμ καὶ τοῖς ἄλσεσιν

text_en: And the Lord being angry with Israel , delivered them into the hands of Chusan Rasathaim, king of Mesopotamia, and they served him eight years.
text_la: Iratusque contra Israël Dominus, tradidit eos in manus Chusan Rasathaim regis Mesopotamiæ, servieruntque ei octo annis.
text_pt: Então a ira do SENHOR se acendeu contra Israel, e ele os vendeu na mão de Cusã-Risataim, rei da mesopotâmia; e os filhos de Israel serviram a Cusã-Risataim oito anos.
text_el: καὶ ὠργίσθη θυμῷ κύριος ἐν τῷ Ισραηλ καὶ ἀπέδοτο αὐτοὺς εἰς χεῖρας Χουσαρσαθωμ βασιλέως Συρίας ποταμῶν καὶ ἐδούλευσαν αὐτῷ ὀκτὼ ἔτη

text_en: And they cried to the Lord , who raised them up a saviour, and delivered them; to wit, Othoniel, the son of Cenez, the younger brother of Caleb :
text_la: Et clamaverunt ad Dominum, qui suscitavit eis salvatorem, et liberavit eos, Othoniel videlicet filium Cenez, fratrem Caleb minorem:
text_pt: E os filhos de Israel clamaram ao Senhor, e o Senhor levantou-lhes um libertador, que os libertou: Otniel, filho de Quenaz, irmão de Calebe, mais novo do que ele.
text_el: καὶ ἐκέκραξαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ πρὸς κύριον καὶ ἤγειρεν κύριος σωτῆρα τῷ Ισραηλ καὶ ἔσωσεν αὐτούς τὸν Γοθονιηλ υἱὸν Κενεζ ἀδελφὸν Χαλεβ τὸν νεώτερον αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰσήκουσεν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the spirit of the Lord was in him, and he judged Israel . And he went out to fight, and the Lord delivered Chusan Rasathaim, king of Syria , and he overthrew him:
text_la: fuitque in eo spiritus Domini, et judicavit Israël. Egressusque est ad pugnam, et tradidit Dominus in manus ejus Chusan Rasathaim regem Syriæ, et oppressit eum.
text_pt: E veio sobre ele o Espírito do Senhor, e julgou a Israel, e saiu à peleja; e o Senhor entregou na sua mão a Cusã-Risataim, rei da Síria; contra o qual prevaleceu a sua mão.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐπ' αὐτὸν πνεῦμα κυρίου καὶ ἔκρινεν τὸν Ισραηλ καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἐπὶ τὸν πόλεμον καὶ παρέδωκεν κύριος ἐν χειρὶ αὐτοῦ τὸν Χουσαρσαθωμ βασιλέα Συρίας καὶ ἐκραταιώθη ἡ χεὶρ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸν Χουσαρσαθωμ

text_en: And the land rested forty years, and Othoniel, the son of Cenez, died.
text_la: Quievitque terra quadraginta annis, et mortuus est Othoniel filius Cenez.
text_pt: Então a terra sossegou quarenta anos; e Otniel, filho de Quenaz, faleceu.
text_el: καὶ ἡσύχασεν ἡ γῆ ἔτη πεντήκοντα καὶ ἀπέθανεν Γοθονιηλ υἱὸς Κενεζ

text_en: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the Lord : who strengthened against them Eglon, king of Moab : because they did evil in his sight.
text_la: Addiderunt autem filii Israël facere malum in conspectu Domini : qui confortavit adversum eos Eglon regem Moab, quia fecerunt malum in conspectu ejus.
text_pt: Porém os filhos de Israel tornaram a fazer o que era mau aos olhos do Senhor; então o Senhor fortaleceu a Eglom, rei dos moabitas, contra Israel; porquanto fizeram o que era mau aos olhos do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ προσέθεντο οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ποιῆσαι τὸ πονηρὸν ἔναντι κυρίου καὶ ἐνίσχυσεν κύριος τὸν Εγλωμ βασιλέα Μωαβ ἐπὶ τὸν Ισραηλ διὰ τὸ πεποιηκέναι αὐτοὺς τὸ πονηρὸν ἔναντι κυρίου

text_en: And he joined to him the children of Ammon , and Amalec : and he went and overthrew Israel , and possessed the city of palm trees .
text_la: Et copulavit ei filios Ammon, et Amalec : abiitque et percussit Israël, atque possedit urbem palmarum.
text_pt: E reuniu consigo os filhos de Amom e os amalequitas, e foi, e feriu a Israel, e tomaram a cidade das palmeiras.
text_el: καὶ προσήγαγεν πρὸς αὐτὸν πάντας τοὺς υἱοὺς Αμμων καὶ Αμαληκ καὶ ἐπορεύθη καὶ ἐπάταξεν τὸν Ισραηλ καὶ ἐκληρονόμησεν τὴν πόλιν τῶν φοινίκων

text_en: And the children of Israel served Eglon, king of Moab , eighteen years.
text_la: Servieruntque filii Israël Eglon regi Moab decem et octo annis.
text_pt: E os filhos de Israel serviram a Eglom, rei dos moabitas, dezoito anos.
text_el: καὶ ἐδούλευσαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ τῷ Εγλωμ βασιλεῖ Μωαβ ἔτη δέκα ὀκτώ

text_en: And afterwards they cried to the Lord , who raised them up a saviour, called Aod, the son of Cera, the son of Jemini, who used the left hand as well as the right. And the children of Israel sent presents to Eglon, king of Moab , by him.
text_la: Et postea clamaverunt ad Dominum, qui suscitavit eis salvatorem vocabulo Aod, filium Gera, filii Jemini, qui utraque manu pro dextera utebatur. Miseruntque filii Israël per illum munera Eglon regi Moab.
text_pt: Então os filhos de Israel clamaram ao Senhor, e o Senhor lhes levantou um libertador, a Eúde, filho de Gera, filho de Jemim, homem canhoto. E os filhos de Israel enviaram pela sua mão um presente a Eglom, rei dos moabitas.
text_el: καὶ ἐκέκραξαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ πρὸς κύριον καὶ ἤγειρεν αὐτοῖς κύριος σωτῆρα τὸν Αωδ υἱὸν Γηρα υἱοῦ τοῦ Ιεμενι ἄνδρα ἀμφοτεροδέξιον καὶ ἀπέστειλαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ δῶρα ἐν χειρὶ αὐτοῦ τῷ Εγλωμ βασιλεῖ Μωαβ

text_en: And he made himself a two-edged sword, with a haft in the midst of the length of the palm of the hand, and was girded therewith, under his garment, on the right thigh.
text_la: Qui fecit sibi gladium ancipitem, habentem in medio capulum longitudinis palmæ manus, et accinctus est eo subter sagum in dextro femore.
text_pt: E Eúde fez para si uma espada de dois fios, do comprimento de um côvado; e cingiu-a por baixo das suas vestes, à sua coxa direita.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν ἑαυτῷ Αωδ μάχαιραν δίστομον σπιθαμῆς τὸ μῆκος καὶ περιεζώσατο αὐτὴν ὑπὸ τὸν μανδύαν ἐπὶ τὸν μηρὸν τὸν δεξιὸν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he presented the gifts to Eglon, king of Moab . Now Eglon was exceeding fat.
text_la: Obtulitque munera Eglon regi Moab. Erat autem Eglon crassus nimis.
text_pt: E levou aquele presente a Eglom, rei dos moabitas; e era Eglom homem muito gordo.
text_el: καὶ προσήνεγκεν τὰ δῶρα τῷ Εγλωμ βασιλεῖ Μωαβ καὶ Εγλωμ ἀνὴρ ἀστεῖος σφόδρα

text_en: And when he had presented the gifts unto him he followed his companions that came along with him.
text_la: Cumque obtulisset ei munera, prosecutus est socios, qui cum eo venerant.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, acabando de entregar o presente, despediu a gente que o trouxera.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς συνετέλεσεν Αωδ προσφέρων τὰ δῶρα καὶ ἐξαπέστειλεν τοὺς αἴροντας τὰ δῶρα

text_en: Then returning from Galgal, where the idols were, he said to the king: I have a secret message to you, O king. And he commanded silence: and all being gone out that were about him,
text_la: Et reversus de Galgalis, ubi erant idola, dixit ad regem : Verbum secretum habeo ad te, o rex. Et ille imperavit silentium : egressisque omnibus qui circa eum erant,
text_pt: Porém ele mesmo voltou das imagens de escultura que estavam ao pé de Gilgal, e disse: Tenho uma palavra secreta para ti, ó rei. O qual disse: Cala-te. E todos os que lhe assistiam saíram de diante dele.
text_el: καὶ Εγλωμ ἀνέστρεψεν ἀπὸ τῶν γλυπτῶν μετὰ τῆς Γαλγαλ καὶ εἶπεν Αωδ λόγος μοι κρύφιος πρὸς σέ βασιλεῦ καὶ εἶπεν Εγλωμ πᾶσιν ἐκ μέσου καὶ ἐξῆλθον ἀπ' αὐτοῦ πάντες οἱ παραστήκοντες αὐτῷ

text_en: Aod went in to him: now he was sitting in a summer parlour alone, and he said: I have a word from God to you. And he forthwith rose up from his throne.
text_la: ingressus est Aod ad eum : sedebat autem in æstivo cœnaculo solus : dixitque : Verbum Dei habeo ad te. Qui statim surrexit de throno.
text_pt: E Eúde entrou numa sala de verão, que o rei tinha só para si, onde estava sentado, e disse: Tenho, para dizer-te, uma palavra de Deus. E levantou-se da cadeira.
text_el: καὶ Αωδ εἰσῆλθεν πρὸς αὐτόν καὶ αὐτὸς ἐκάθητο ἐν τῷ ὑπερῴῳ τῷ θερινῷ αὐτοῦ μονώτατος καὶ εἶπεν Αωδ λόγος θεοῦ μοι πρὸς σέ βασιλεῦ καὶ ἐξανέστη ἀπὸ τοῦ θρόνου Εγλωμ ἐγγὺς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Aod put forth his left hand, and took the dagger from his right thigh, and thrust it into his belly,
text_la: Extenditque Aod sinistram manum, et tulit sicam de dextro femore suo, infixitque eam in ventre ejus
text_pt: Então Eúde estendeu a sua mão esquerda, e tirou a espada de sobre sua coxa direita, e lha cravou no ventre,
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἅμα τοῦ ἀναστῆναι ἐξέτεινεν Αωδ τὴν χεῖρα τὴν ἀριστερὰν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔλαβεν τὴν μάχαιραν ἀπὸ τοῦ μηροῦ τοῦ δεξιοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐνέπηξεν αὐτὴν εἰς τὴν κοιλίαν Εγλωμ

text_en: with such force that the haft went in after the blade into the wound, and was closed up with the abundance of fat. So that he did not draw out the dagger, but left it in the body as he had struck it in: and forthwith, by the secret parts of nature, the excrements of the belly came out.
text_la: tam valide, ut capulus sequeretur ferrum in vulnere, ac pinguissimo adipe stringeretur. Nec eduxit gladium, sed ita ut percusserat, reliquit in corpore : statimque per secreta naturæ alvi stercora proruperunt.
text_pt: De tal maneira que entrou até o cabo após a lâmina, e a gordura encerrou a lâmina (porque não tirou a espada do ventre); e saiu-lhe o excremento.
text_el: καὶ ἐπεισήνεγκεν καί γε τὴν λαβὴν ὀπίσω τῆς φλογός καὶ ἀπέκλεισεν τὸ στέαρ κατὰ τῆς φλογός ὅτι οὐκ ἐξέσπασεν τὴν μάχαιραν ἐκ τῆς κοιλίας αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Aod carefully shutting the doors of the parlour, and locking them,
text_la: Aod autem clausis diligentissime ostiis cœnaculi, et obfirmatis sera,
text_pt: Então Eúde saiu ao pátio, e fechou as portas da sala e as trancou.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Αωδ εἰς τὴν προστάδα καὶ ἀπέκλεισεν τὰς θύρας τοῦ ὑπερῴου ἐπ' αὐτὸν καὶ ἐσφήνωσεν

text_en: went out by a postern door. And the king's servants going in, saw the doors of the parlour shut, and they said: Perhaps he is easing nature in his summer parlour.
text_la: per posticum egressus est. Servique regis ingressi viderunt clausas fores cœnaculi, atque dixerunt : Forsitan purgat alvum in æstivo cubiculo.
text_pt: E, saindo ele, vieram os servos do rei, e viram, e eis que as portas da sala estavam fechadas; e disseram: Sem dúvida está cobrindo seus pés na recâmara da sala de verão.
text_el: καὶ αὐτὸς ἐξῆλθεν καὶ οἱ παῖδες αὐτοῦ εἰσῆλθον καὶ εἶδον καὶ ἰδοὺ αἱ θύραι τοῦ ὑπερῴου ἀποκεκλεισμέναι καὶ εἶπαν μήποτε πρὸς δίφρους κάθηται ἐν τῇ ἀποχωρήσει τοῦ κοιτῶνος

text_en: And waiting a long time, till they were ashamed, and seeing that no man opened the door, they took a key: and opening, they found their lord lying dead on the ground.
text_la: Expectantesque diu donec erubescerent, et videntes quod nullus aperiret, tulerunt clavem : et aperientes invenerunt dominum suum in terra jacentem mortuum.
text_pt: E, esperando até se alarmarem, eis que ele não abria as portas da sala; então tomaram a chave, e abriram, e eis ali seu senhor estendido morto em terra.
text_el: καὶ προσέμειναν αἰσχυνόμενοι καὶ ἰδοὺ οὐκ ἦν ὁ ἀνοίγων τὰς θύρας τοῦ ὑπερῴου καὶ ἔλαβον τὴν κλεῖδα καὶ ἤνοιξαν καὶ ἰδοὺ ὁ κύριος αὐτῶν πεπτωκὼς ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν τεθνηκώς

text_en: But Aod, while they were in confusion, escaped, and passed by the place of the idols from whence he had returned. And he came to Seirath:
text_la: Aod autem, dum illi turbarentur, effugit, et pertransiit locum idolorum, unde reversus fuerat. Venitque in Seirath:
text_pt: E Eúde escapou, enquanto eles se demoravam; porque ele passou pelas imagens de escultura, e escapou para Seirá.
text_el: καὶ Αωδ διεσώθη ἕως ἐθορυβοῦντο καὶ οὐκ ἦν ὁ προσνοῶν αὐτῷ καὶ αὐτὸς παρῆλθεν τὰ γλυπτὰ καὶ διεσώθη εἰς Σεϊρωθα

text_en: And forthwith he sounded the trumpet in Mount Ephraim: and the children of Israel went down with him, he himself going in the front.
text_la: et statim insonuit buccina in monte Ephraim, descenderuntque cum eo filii Israël, ipso in fronte gradiente.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, chegando ele, tocou a buzina nas montanhas de Efraim, e os filhos de Israel desceram com ele das montanhas, e ele adiante deles.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἡνίκα ἦλθεν καὶ ἐσάλπισεν κερατίνῃ ἐν ὄρει Εφραιμ καὶ κατέβησαν σὺν αὐτῷ οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ καὶ αὐτὸς ἔμπροσθεν αὐτῶν

text_en: And he said to them: Follow me: for the Lord has delivered our enemies, the Moabites , into our hands. And they went down after him, and seized upon the fords of the Jordan , which are in the way to Moab : and they suffered no man to pass over:
text_la: Qui dixit ad eos : Sequimini me : tradidit enim Dominus inimicos nostros Moabitas in manus nostras. Descenderuntque post eum, et occupaverunt vada Jordanis quæ transmittunt in Moab : et non dimiserunt transire quemquam:
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Segui-me, porque o Senhor vos tem entregue vossos inimigos, os moabitas, nas vossas mãos; e desceram após ele, e tomaram os vaus do Jordão contra Moabe, e a ninguém deixaram passar.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς καταβαίνετε ὀπίσω μου ὅτι παρέδωκεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς τοὺς ἐχθροὺς ὑμῶν τὴν Μωαβ ἐν χειρὶ ὑμῶν καὶ κατέβησαν ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ καὶ προκατελάβοντο τὰς διαβάσεις τοῦ Ιορδάνου τῆς Μωαβ καὶ οὐκ ἀφῆκαν ἄνδρα διαβῆναι

text_en: But they slew of the Moabites at that time, about ten thousand, all strong and valiant men : none of them could escape.
text_la: sed percusserunt Moabitas in tempore illo, circiter decem millia, omnes robustos et fortes viros. Nullus eorum evadere potuit.
text_pt: E naquele tempo feriram dos moabitas uns dez mil homens, todos corpulentos, e todos homens valorosos; e não escapou nenhum.
text_el: καὶ ἐπάταξαν τὴν Μωαβ ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ ὡσεὶ δέκα χιλιάδας ἀνδρῶν πάντας τοὺς μαχητὰς τοὺς ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ πάντα ἄνδρα δυνάμεως καὶ οὐ διεσώθη ἀνήρ

text_en: And Moab was humbled that day under the hand of Israel : and the land rested eighty years.
text_la: Humiliatusque est Moab in die illo sub manu Israël : et quievit terra octoginta annis.
text_pt: Assim foi subjugado Moabe naquele dia debaixo da mão de Israel; e a terra sossegou oitenta anos.
text_el: καὶ ἐνετράπη Μωαβ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ὑπὸ τὴν χεῖρα Ισραηλ καὶ ἡσύχασεν ἡ γῆ ὀγδοήκοντα ἔτη καὶ ἔκρινεν αὐτοὺς Αωδ ἕως οὗ ἀπέθανεν

text_en: After him was Samgar, the son of Anath, who slew of the Philistines six hundred men with a ploughshare: and he also defended Israel .
text_la: Post hunc fuit Samgar filius Anath, qui percussit de Philisthiim sexcentos viros vomere : et ipse quoque defendit Israël.
text_pt: Depois dele foi Sangar, filho de Anate, que feriu a seiscentos homens dos filisteus com uma aguilhada de bois; e também ele libertou a Israel.
text_el: καὶ μετὰ τοῦτον ἀνέστη Σαμεγαρ υἱὸς Αναθ καὶ ἐπάταξεν τοὺς ἀλλοφύλους εἰς ἑξακοσίους ἄνδρας ἐκτὸς μόσχων τῶν βοῶν καὶ ἔσωσεν αὐτὸς τὸν Ισραηλ

text_en: And the children of Israel again did evil in the sight of the Lord after the death of Aod:
text_la: Addideruntque filii Israël facere malum in conspectu Domini post mortem Aod,
text_pt: Porém os filhos de Israel tornaram a fazer o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR, depois de falecer Eúde.
text_el: καὶ προσέθεντο οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ποιῆσαι τὸ πονηρὸν ἔναντι κυρίου

text_en: And the Lord delivered them up into the hands of Jabin, king of Chanaan , who reigned in Asor: and he had a general of his army named Sisara, and he dwelt in Haroseth of the Gentiles .
text_la: et tradidit illos Dominus in manus Jabin regis Chanaan, qui regnavit in Asor : habuitque ducem exercitus sui nomine Sisaram, ipse autem habitabat in Haroseth gentium.
text_pt: E vendeu-os o Senhor na mão de Jabim, rei de Canaã, que reinava em Hazor; e Sísera era o capitão do seu exército, o qual então habitava em Harosete dos gentios.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέδοτο αὐτοὺς κύριος ἐν χειρὶ Ιαβιν βασιλέως Χανααν ὃς ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν Ασωρ καὶ ὁ ἄρχων τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ Σισαρα καὶ αὐτὸς κατῴκει ἐν Αρισωθ τῶν ἐθνῶν

text_en: And the children of Israel cried to the Lord : for he had nine hundred chariots set with scythes and for twenty years had grievously oppressed them.
text_la: Clamaveruntque filii Israël ad Dominum : nongentos enim habebat falcatos currus, et per viginti annos vehementer oppresserat eos.
text_pt: Então os filhos de Israel clamaram ao Senhor, porquanto ele tinha novecentos carros de ferro, e por vinte anos oprimia violentamente os filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐκέκραξαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ πρὸς κύριον ὅτι ἐννακόσια ἅρματα σιδηρᾶ ἦν αὐτῷ καὶ αὐτὸς ἔθλιψεν τὸν Ισραηλ κατὰ κράτος εἴκοσι ἔτη

text_en: And there was at that time Debbora , a prophetess , the wife of Lapidoth, who judged the people.
text_la: Erat autem Debbora prophetis uxor Lapidoth, quæ judicabat populum in illo tempore.
text_pt: E Débora, mulher profetisa, mulher de Lapidote, julgava a Israel naquele tempo.
text_el: καὶ Δεββωρα γυνὴ προφῆτις γυνὴ Λαφιδωθ αὐτὴ ἔκρινεν τὸν Ισραηλ ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ

text_en: And she sat under a palm tree, which was called by her name , between Rama and Bethel , in Mount Ephraim: and the children of Israel came up to her for all judgment.
text_la: Et sedebat sub palma, quæ nomine illius vocabatur, inter Rama et Bethel in monte Ephraim : ascendebantque ad eam filii Israël in omne judicium.
text_pt: Ela assentava-se debaixo das palmeiras de Débora, entre Ramá e Betel, nas montanhas de Efraim; e os filhos de Israel subiam a ela a juízo.
text_el: καὶ αὐτὴ ἐκάθητο ὑπὸ φοίνικα Δεββωρα ἀνὰ μέσον Ραμα καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον Βαιθηλ ἐν ὄρει Εφραιμ καὶ ἀνέβαινον πρὸς αὐτὴν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἐκεῖ τοῦ κρίνεσθαι

text_en: And she sent and called Barac, the Son of Abinoem , out of Cedes , in Nephthali : and she said to him: The Lord God of Israel has commanded you: Go, and lead an army to Mount Thabor , and you shall take with you ten thousand fighting men of the children of Nephthali , and of the children of Zabulon :
text_la: Quæ misit et vocavit Barac filium Abinoëm de Cedes Nephthali : dixitque ad eum : Præcepit tibi Dominus Deus Israël : Vade, et duc exercitum in montem Thabor, tollesque tecum decem millia pugnatorum de filiis Nephthali, et de filiis Zabulon:
text_pt: E mandou chamar a Baraque, filho de Abinoão de Quedes de Naftali, e disse-lhe: Porventura o Senhor Deus de Israel não deu ordem, dizendo: Vai, e atrai gente ao monte Tabor, e toma contigo dez mil homens dos filhos de Naftali e dos filhos de Zebulom;
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Δεββωρα καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸν Βαρακ υἱὸν Αβινεεμ ἐκ Κεδες Νεφθαλι καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν οὐχὶ σοὶ ἐνετείλατο κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ καὶ ἀπελεύσῃ εἰς ὄρος Θαβωρ καὶ λήμψῃ μετὰ σεαυτοῦ δέκα χιλιάδας ἀνδρῶν ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν Νεφθαλι καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν Ζαβουλων

text_en: And I will bring unto you in the place of the torrent Cison, Sisara, the general of Jabin's army, and his chariots, and all his multitude, and will deliver them into your hand.
text_la: ego autem adducam ad te in loco torrentis Cison, Sisaram principem exercitus Jabin, et currus ejus, atque omnem multitudinem, et tradam eos in manu tua.
text_pt: E atrairei a ti para o ribeiro de Quisom, a Sísera, capitão do exército de Jabim, com os seus carros, e com a sua multidão; e o darei na tua mão.
text_el: καὶ ἀπάξω πρὸς σὲ εἰς τὸν χειμάρρουν Κισων τὸν Σισαρα ἄρχοντα τῆς δυνάμεως Ιαβιν καὶ τὰ ἅρματα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸ πλῆθος αὐτοῦ καὶ παραδώσω αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ χειρί σου

text_en: And Barac said to her: If you will come with me, I will go: if you will not come with me, I will not go.
text_la: Dixitque ad eam Barac : Si venis mecum, vadam : si nolueris venire mecum, non pergam.
text_pt: Então lhe disse Baraque: Se fores comigo, irei; porém, se não fores comigo, não irei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτὴν Βαρακ ἐὰν πορευθῇς μετ' ἐμοῦ πορεύσομαι καὶ ἐὰν μὴ πορευθῇς μετ' ἐμοῦ οὐ πορεύσομαι ὅτι οὐκ οἶδα τὴν ἡμέραν ἐν ᾗ εὐοδοῖ κύριος τὸν ἄγγελον μετ' ἐμοῦ

text_en: She said to him: I will go, indeed, with you, but at this time the victory shall not be attributed to you, because Sisara shall be delivered into the hand of a woman . Debbora therefore arose, and went with Barac to Cedes .
text_la: Quæ dixit ad eum : Ibo quidem tecum, sed in hac vice victoria non reputabitur tibi, quia in manu mulieris tradetur Sisara. Surrexit itaque Debbora, et perrexit cum Barac in Cedes.
text_pt: E disse ela: Certamente irei contigo, porém não será tua a honra da jornada que empreenderes; pois à mão de uma mulher o Senhor venderá a Sísera. E Débora se levantou, e partiu com Baraque para Quedes.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτὸν Δεββωρα πορευομένη πορεύσομαι μετὰ σοῦ πλὴν γίνωσκε ὅτι οὐκ ἔσται τὸ προτέρημά σου εἰς τὴν ὁδόν ἣν σὺ πορεύῃ ὅτι ἐν χειρὶ γυναικὸς ἀποδώσεται κύριος τὸν Σισαρα καὶ ἀνέστη Δεββωρα καὶ ἐπορεύθη μετὰ τοῦ Βαρακ εἰς Κεδες

text_en: And he called unto him Zabulon and Nephthali , and went up with ten thousand fighting men , having Debbora in his company.
text_la: Qui, accitis Zabulon et Nephthali, ascendit cum decem millibus pugnatorum, habens Debboram in comitatu suo.
text_pt: Então Baraque convocou a Zebulom e a Naftali em Quedes, e subiu com dez mil homens após ele; e Débora subiu com ele.
text_el: καὶ παρήγγειλεν Βαρακ τῷ Ζαβουλων καὶ τῷ Νεφθαλι εἰς Κεδες καὶ ἀνέβησαν κατὰ πόδας αὐτοῦ δέκα χιλιάδες ἀνδρῶν καὶ Δεββωρα ἀνέβη μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: Now Haber, the Cinite , had some time before departed from the rest of the Cinites , his brethren, the sons of Hobab, the kinsman of Moses : and had pitched his tents unto the valley, which is called Sennim, and was near Cedes .
text_la: Haber autem Cinæus recesserat quondam a ceteris Cinæis fratribus suis, filiis Hobab cognati Moysi : et tetenderat tabernacula usque ad vallem, quæ vocatur Sennim, et erat juxta Cedes.
text_pt: E Héber, queneu, se tinha apartado dos queneus, dos filhos de Hobabe, sogro de Moisés; e tinha estendido as suas tendas até ao carvalho de Zaanaim, que está junto a Quedes,
text_el: καὶ οἱ πλησίον τοῦ Κιναίου ἐχωρίσθησαν ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν Ιωβαβ γαμβροῦ Μωυσῆ καὶ ἔπηξεν τὴν σκηνὴν αὐτοῦ πρὸς δρῦν ἀναπαυομένων ἥ ἐστιν ἐχόμενα Κεδες

text_en: And it was told Sisara, that Barac, the son of Abinoem , had gone up to Mount Thabor :
text_la: Nuntiatumque est Sisaræ quod ascendisset Barac filius Abinoëm in montem Thabor:
text_pt: E anunciaram a Sísera que Baraque, filho de Abinoão, tinha subido ao monte Tabor.
text_el: καὶ ἀνήγγειλαν τῷ Σισαρα ὅτι ἀνέβη Βαρακ υἱὸς Αβινεεμ ἐπ' ὄρος Θαβωρ

text_en: And he gathered together his nine hundred chariots armed with scythes, and all his army, from Haroseth of the Gentiles , to the torrent Cison.
text_la: et congregavit nongentos falcatos currus, et omnem exercitum de Haroseth gentium ad torrentem Cison.
text_pt: E Sísera convocou todos os seus carros, novecentos carros de ferro, e todo o povo que estava com ele, desde Harosete dos gentios até ao ribeiro de Quisom.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Σισαρα πάντα τὰ ἅρματα αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἐννακόσια ἅρματα σιδηρᾶ ἦν αὐτῷ καὶ πάντα τὸν λαὸν τὸν μετ' αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ Αρισωθ τῶν ἐθνῶν εἰς τὸν χειμάρρουν Κισων

text_en: And Debbora said to Barac : Arise, for this is the day wherein the Lord has delivered Sisara into your hands: behold, he is your leader. And Barac went down from Mount Thabor , and ten thousand fighting men with him.
text_la: Dixitque Debbora ad Barac : Surge, hæc est enim dies, in qua tradidit Dominus Sisaram in manus tuas : en ipse ductor est tuus. Descendit itaque Barac de monte Thabor, et decem millia pugnatorum cum eo.
text_pt: Então disse Débora a Baraque: Levanta-te, porque este é o dia em que o Senhor tem dado a Sísera na tua mão; porventura o Senhor não saiu adiante de ti? Baraque, pois, desceu do monte Tabor, e dez mil homens após ele.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Δεββωρα πρὸς Βαρακ ἀνάστηθι ὅτι αὕτη ἡ ἡμέρα ἐν ᾗ παρέδωκεν κύριος τὸν Σισαρα ἐν χειρί σου οὐκ ἰδοὺ κύριος ἐλεύσεται ἔμπροσθέν σου καὶ κατέβη Βαρακ ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄρους Θαβωρ καὶ δέκα χιλιάδες ἀνδρῶν ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the Lord struck a terror into Sisara, and all his chariots, and all his multitude, with the edge of the sword, at the sight of Barac ; insomuch, that Sisara leaping down from off his chariot, fled away on foot,
text_la: Perterruitque Dominus Sisaram, et omnes currus ejus, universamque multitudinem in ore gladii ad conspectum Barac : in tantum, ut Sisara de curru desiliens, pedibus fugeret,
text_pt: E o Senhor derrotou a Sísera, e a todos os seus carros, e a todo o seu exército ao fio da espada, diante de Baraque; e Sísera desceu do carro, e fugiu a pé.
text_el: καὶ ἐξέστησεν κύριος τὸν Σισαρα καὶ πάντα τὰ ἅρματα αὐτοῦ καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν παρεμβολὴν αὐτοῦ ἐν στόματι ῥομφαίας ἐνώπιον Βαρακ καὶ κατέβη Σισαρα ἀπὸ τοῦ ἅρματος αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔφυγεν τοῖς ποσὶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: and Barac pursued after the fleeing chariots, and the army, unto Haroseth of the Gentiles ; and all the multitude of the enemies was utterly destroyed.
text_la: et Barac persequeretur fugientes currus, et exercitum usque ad Haroseth gentium, et omnis hostium multitudo usque ad internecionem caderet.
text_pt: E Baraque perseguiu os carros, e o exército, até Harosete dos gentios; e todo o exército de Sísera caiu ao fio da espada, até não ficar um só.
text_el: καὶ Βαρακ διώκων ὀπίσω τῶν ἁρμάτων καὶ ὀπίσω τῆς παρεμβολῆς ἕως δρυμοῦ τῶν ἐθνῶν καὶ ἔπεσεν πᾶσα ἡ παρεμβολὴ Σισαρα ἐν στόματι ῥομφαίας οὐ κατελείφθη ἕως ἑνός

text_en: But Sisara fleeing, came to the tent of Jahel, the wife of Haber, the Cinite , for there was peace between Jabin, the king of Asor, and the house of Haber, the Cinite .
text_la: Sisara autem fugiens pervenit ad tentorium Jahel uxoris Haber Cinæi. Erat enim pax inter Jabin regem Asor, et domum Haber Cinæi.
text_pt: Porém Sísera fugiu a pé à tenda de Jael, mulher de Héber, queneu; porquanto havia paz entre Jabim, rei de Hazor, e a casa de Héber, queneu.
text_el: καὶ Σισαρα ἀνεχώρησεν τοῖς ποσὶν αὐτοῦ εἰς σκηνὴν Ιαηλ γυναικὸς Χαβερ τοῦ Κιναίου ὅτι εἰρήνη ἀνὰ μέσον Ιαβιν βασιλέως Ασωρ καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον οἴκου Χαβερ τοῦ Κιναίου

text_en: And Jahel went forth to meet Sisara, and said to him: Come in to me, my lord; come in, fear not. He went into her tent, and being covered by her with a cloak,
text_la: Egressa igitur Jahel in occursum Sisaræ, dixit ad eum : Intra ad me, domine mi : intra, ne timeas. Qui ingressus tabernaculum ejus, et opertus ab ea pallio,
text_pt: E Jael saiu ao encontro de Sísera, e disse-lhe: Entra, senhor meu, entra aqui, não temas. Ele entrou na sua tenda, e ela o cobriu com uma coberta.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Ιαηλ εἰς ἀπάντησιν Σισαρα καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν ἔκνευσον κύριέ μου ἔκνευσον πρός με μὴ φοβοῦ καὶ ἐξένευσεν πρὸς αὐτὴν εἰς τὴν σκηνήν καὶ συνεκάλυψεν αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ δέρρει αὐτῆς

text_en: said to her: Give me, I beseech you, a little water, for I am very thirsty. She opened a bottle of milk, and gave him to drink, and covered him.
text_la: dixit ad eam : Da mihi, obsecro, paululum aquæ, quia sitio valde. Quæ aperuit utrem lactis, et dedit ei bibere, et operuit illum.
text_pt: Então ele lhe disse: Dá-me, peço-te, de beber um pouco de água, porque tenho sede. Então ela abriu um odre de leite, e deu-lhe de beber, e o cobriu.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Σισαρα πρὸς αὐτήν πότισόν με δὴ μικρὸν ὕδωρ ὅτι ἐδίψησα καὶ ἤνοιξεν τὸν ἀσκὸν τοῦ γάλακτος καὶ ἐπότισεν αὐτὸν καὶ συνεκάλυψεν τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Sisara said to her: Stand before the door of the tent, and when any shall come and inquire of you, saying: Is there any man here? You shall say: There is none.
text_la: Dixitque Sisara ad eam : Sta ante ostium tabernaculi : et cum venerit aliquis interrogans te, et dicens : Numquid hic est aliquis? respondebis : Nullus est.
text_pt: E ele lhe disse: Põe-te à porta da tenda; e há de ser que se alguém vier e te perguntar: Há aqui alguém? Responderás então: Não.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτήν στῆθι ἐν τῇ θύρᾳ τῆς σκηνῆς καὶ ἔσται ἐάν τις ἔλθῃ πρὸς σὲ καὶ ἐρωτήσῃ σε καὶ εἴπῃ σοι ἔστιν ἐνταῦθα ἀνήρ καὶ ἐρεῖς οὐκ ἔστιν καὶ συνεκάλυψεν αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ δέρρει αὐτῆς

text_en: So Jahel, Haber's wife, took a nail of the tent, and taking also a hammer: and going in softly, and with silence, she put the nail upon the temples of his head, and striking it with the hammer, drove it through his brain fast into the ground: and so passing from deep sleep to death, he fainted away and died.
text_la: Tulit itaque Jahel uxor Haber clavum tabernaculi, assumens pariter et malleum : et ingressa abscondite et cum silentio, posuit supra tempus capitis ejus clavum, percussumque malleo defixit in cerebrum usque ad terram : qui soporem morti consocians defecit, et mortuus est.
text_pt: Então Jael, mulher de Héber, tomou uma estaca da tenda, e lançou mão de um martelo, e chegou-se mansamente a ele, e lhe cravou a estaca na fonte, de sorte que penetrou na terra, estando ele, porém, num profundo sono, e já muito cansado; e assim morreu.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Ιαηλ γυνὴ Χαβερ τὸν πάσσαλον τῆς σκηνῆς καὶ ἔθηκεν τὴν σφῦραν ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτῆς καὶ εἰσῆλθεν πρὸς αὐτὸν ἡσυχῇ καὶ ἐνέκρουσεν τὸν πάσσαλον ἐν τῇ γνάθῳ αὐτοῦ καὶ διήλασεν ἐν τῇ γῇ καὶ αὐτὸς ἀπεσκάρισεν ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν γονάτων αὐτῆς καὶ ἐξέψυξεν καὶ ἀπέθανεν

text_en: And behold, Barac came pursuing after Sisara: and Jahel went out to meet him, and said to him: Come, and I will show you the man whom you seek. And when he came into her tent, he saw Sisara lying dead, and the nail fastened in his temples.
text_la: Et ecce Barac sequens Sisaram veniebat : egressaque Jahel in occursum ejus, dixit ei : Veni, et ostendam tibi virum quem quæris. Qui cum intrasset ad eam, vidit Sisaram jacentem mortuum, et clavum infixum in tempore ejus.
text_pt: E eis que, seguindo Baraque a Sísera, Jael lhe saiu ao encontro, e disse-lhe: Vem, e mostrar-te-ei o homem que buscas. E foi a ela, e eis que Sísera jazia morto, com a estaca na fonte.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ Βαρακ διώκων τὸν Σισαρα καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Ιαηλ εἰς ἀπαντὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ δεῦρο καὶ δείξω σοι τὸν ἄνδρα ὃν σὺ ζητεῖς καὶ εἰσῆλθεν πρὸς αὐτήν καὶ ἰδοὺ Σισαρα πεπτωκὼς νεκρός καὶ ὁ πάσσαλος ἐν τῇ γνάθῳ αὐτοῦ

text_en: So God that day humbled Jabin, the king of Chanaan , before the children of Israel :
text_la: Humiliavit ergo Deus in die illo Jabin regem Chanaan coram filiis Israël:
text_pt: Assim Deus naquele dia sujeitou a Jabim, rei de Canaã, diante dos filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐταπείνωσεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς τὸν Ιαβιν βασιλέα Χανααν ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἐνώπιον υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: Who grew daily stronger, and with a mighty hand overpowered Jabin, king of Chanaan , till they quite destroyed him.
text_la: qui crescebant quotidie, et forti manu opprimebant Jabin regem Chanaan, donec delerent eum.
text_pt: E continuou a mão dos filhos de Israel a pesar e a endurecer-se sobre Jabim, rei de Canaã; até que exterminaram a Jabim, rei de Canaã.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθη χεὶρ τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ πορευομένη καὶ σκληρυνομένη ἐπὶ Ιαβιν βασιλέα Χανααν ἕως ἐξωλέθρευσαν αὐτόν

text_en: In that day Debbora and Barac, son of Abinoem , sung, and said:
text_la: Cecineruntque Debbora et Barac filius Abinoëm in illo die, dicentes:
text_pt: E cantou Débora e Baraque, filho de Abinoão, naquele mesmo dia, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ᾖσεν Δεββωρα καὶ Βαρακ υἱὸς Αβινεεμ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ καὶ εἶπεν

text_en: O you of Israel , that have willingly offered your lives to danger, bless the Lord .
text_la: Qui sponte obtulistis de Israël animas vestras ad periculum, benedicite Domino.
text_pt: Louvai ao Senhor pela vingança de Israel, quando o povo se ofereceu voluntariamente.
text_el: ἐν τῷ ἄρξασθαι ἀρχηγοὺς ἐν Ισραηλ ἐν προαιρέσει λαοῦ εὐλογεῖτε τὸν κύριον

text_en: Hear, O you kings, give ear, O you princes: It is I, it is I, that will sing to the Lord , I will sing to the Lord , the God of Israel .
text_la: Audite, reges; auribus percipite, principes : ego sum, ego sum, quæ Domino canam, psallam Domino Deo Israël.
text_pt: Ouvi, reis; dai ouvidos, príncipes; eu, eu cantarei ao Senhor; salmodiarei ao Senhor Deus de Israel.
text_el: ἀκούσατε βασιλεῖς ἐνωτίζεσθε σατράπαι δυνατοί ἐγὼ τῷ κυρίῳ ᾄσομαι ψαλῶ τῷ θεῷ Ισραηλ

text_en: O Lord , when you went out of Seir, and passed by the regions of Edom , the earth trembled, and the heavens and clouds dropped water.
text_la: Domine, cum exires de Seir, et transires per regiones Edom, terra mota est, cælique ac nubes distillaverunt aquis.
text_pt: Ó Senhor, saindo tu de Seir, caminhando tu desde o campo de Edom, a terra estremeceu; até os céus gotejaram; até as nuvens gotejaram águas.
text_el: κύριε ἐν τῇ ἐξόδῳ σου ἐκ Σηιρ ἐν τῷ ἀπαίρειν σε ἐξ ἀγροῦ Εδωμ γῆ ἐσείσθη καὶ ὁ οὐρανὸς ἐξεστάθη καὶ αἱ νεφέλαι ἔσταξαν ὕδωρ

text_en: The mountains melted before the face of the Lord , and Sinai before the face of the Lord the God of Israel .
text_la: Montes fluxerunt a facie Domini, et Sinai a facie Domini Dei Israël.
text_pt: Os montes se derreteram diante do Senhor, e até Sinai diante do Senhor Deus de Israel.
text_el: ὄρη ἐσαλεύθησαν ἀπὸ προσώπου κυρίου τοῦτο Σινα ἀπὸ προσώπου κυρίου θεοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: In the days of Samgar, the son of Anath, in the days of Jahel, the paths rested: and they that went by them, walked through bye-ways.
text_la: In diebus Samgar filii Anath, in diebus Jahel quieverunt semitæ : et qui ingrediebantur per eas, ambulaverunt per calles devios.
text_pt: Nos dias de Sangar, filho de Anate, nos dias de Jael cessaram os caminhos; e os que andavam por veredas iam por caminhos torcidos.
text_el: ἐν ἡμέραις Σαμεγαρ υἱοῦ Αναθ ἐν ἡμέραις Ιαηλ ἐξέλιπον βασιλεῖς καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν τρίβους ἐπορεύθησαν ὁδοὺς διεστραμμένας

text_en: The valiant men ceased, and rested in Israel : until Debbora arose, a mother arose in Israel .
text_la: Cessaverunt fortes in Israël, et quieverunt : donec surgeret Debbora, surgeret mater in Israël.
text_pt: Cessaram as aldeias em Israel, cessaram; até que eu, Débora, me levantei, por mãe em Israel me levantei.
text_el: ἐξέλιπεν φραζων ἐν τῷ Ισραηλ ἐξέλιπεν ἕως οὗ ἐξανέστη Δεββωρα ὅτι ἀνέστη μήτηρ ἐν τῷ Ισραηλ

text_en: The Lord chose new wars , and he himself overthrew the gates of the enemies: a shield and spear was not seen among forty thousand of Israel .
text_la: Nova bella elegit Dominus, et portas hostium ipse subvertit : clypeus et hasta si apparuerint in quadraginta millibus Israël.
text_pt: E se escolhia deuses novos, logo a guerra estava às portas; via-se por isso escudo ou lança entre quarenta mil em Israel?
text_el: ᾑρέτισαν θεοὺς καινοὺς ὡς ἄρτον κρίθινον σκέπην ἐὰν ἴδω σιρομαστῶν ἐν τεσσαράκοντα χιλιάσιν

text_en: My heart loves the princes of Israel : O you, that of your own good will offered yourselves to danger, bless the Lord .
text_la: Cor meum diligit principes Israël : qui propria voluntate obtulistis vos discrimini, benedicite Domino.
text_pt: Meu coração é para os legisladores de Israel, que voluntariamente se ofereceram entre o povo; bendizei ao Senhor.
text_el: ἡ καρδία μου ἐπὶ τὰ διατεταγμένα τῷ Ισραηλ οἱ δυνάσται τοῦ λαοῦ εὐλογεῖτε τὸν κύριον

text_en: Speak, you that ride upon fair asses, and you that sit in judgment, and walk in the way.
text_la: Qui ascenditis super nitentes asinos, et sedetis in judicio, et ambulatis in via, loquimini.
text_pt: Vós os que cavalgais sobre jumentas brancas, que vos assentais em juízo, que andais pelo caminho, falai disto.
text_el: ἐπιβεβηκότες ἐπὶ ὑποζυγίων καθήμενοι ἐπὶ λαμπηνῶν

text_en: Where the chariots were dashed together, and the army of the enemies was choked, there let the justices of the Lord be rehearsed, and his clemency towards the brave men of Israel : then the people of the Lord went down to the gates, and obtained the sovereignty.
text_la: Ubi collisi sunt currus, et hostium suffocatus est exercitus, ibi narrentur justitiæ Domini, et clementia in fortes Israël : tunc descendit populus Domini ad portas, et obtinuit principatum.
text_pt: Donde se ouve o estrondo dos flecheiros, entre os lugares onde se tiram águas, ali falai das justiças do Senhor, das justiças que fez às suas aldeias em Israel; então o povo do Senhor descia às portas.
text_el: φθέγξασθε φωνὴν ἀνακρουομένων ἀνὰ μέσον εὐφραινομένων ἐκεῖ δώσουσιν δικαιοσύνην κυρίῳ δίκαιοι ἐνίσχυσαν ἐν τῷ Ισραηλ τότε κατέβη εἰς τὰς πόλεις αὐτοῦ ὁ λαὸς κυρίου

text_en: Arise, arise, O Debbora , arise, arise, and utter a canticle. Arise, Barac , and take hold of your captives, O son of Abinoem.
text_la: Surge, surge Debbora; surge, surge, et loquere canticum : surge Barac, et apprehende captivos tuos, fili Abinoëm.
text_pt: Desperta, desperta, Débora, desperta, desperta, entoa um cântico; levanta-te, Baraque, e leva presos os teus cativos, tu, filho de Abinoão.
text_el: ἐξεγείρου ἐξεγείρου Δεββωρα ἐξέγειρον μυριάδας μετὰ λαοῦ ἐξεγείρου ἐξεγείρου λάλει μετ' ᾠδῆς ἐνισχύων ἐξανίστασο Βαρακ καὶ ἐνίσχυσον Δεββωρα τὸν Βαρακ αἰχμαλώτιζε αἰχμαλωσίαν σου υἱὸς Αβινεεμ

text_en: The remnants of the people are saved, the Lord has fought among the valiant ones.
text_la: Salvatæ sunt reliquiæ populi : Dominus in fortibus dimicavit.
text_pt: Então fez dominar sobre os nobres entre o povo, aos que restaram; fez-me o Senhor dominar sobre os poderosos.
text_el: πότε ἐμεγαλύνθη ἡ ἰσχὺς αὐτοῦ κύριε ταπείνωσόν μοι τοὺς ἰσχυροτέρους μου

text_en: Out of Ephraim he destroyed them into Amalec , and after him out of Benjamin into your people, O Amalec : Out of Machir there came down princes, and out of Zabulon they that led the army to fight.
text_la: Ex Ephraim delevit eos in Amalec, et post eum ex Benjamin in populos tuos, o Amalec : de Machir principes descenderunt, et de Zabulon qui exercitum ducerent ad bellandum.
text_pt: De Efraim saiu a sua raiz contra Amaleque; e depois de ti vinha Benjamim dentre os teus povos; de Maquir desceram os legisladores, e de Zebulom os que levaram a cana do escriba.
text_el: λαὸς Εφραιμ ἐτιμωρήσατο αὐτοὺς ἐν κοιλάδι ἀδελφοῦ σου Βενιαμιν ἐν λαοῖς σου ἐξ ἐμοῦ Μαχιρ κατέβησαν ἐξερευνῶντες καὶ ἐκ Ζαβουλων κύριος ἐπολέμει μοι ἐν δυνατοῖς ἐκεῖθεν ἐν σκήπτρῳ ἐνισχύοντος ἡγήσεως

text_en: The captains of Issachar were with Debbora , and followed the steps of Barac , who exposed himself to danger, as one going headlong, and into a pit. Ruben being divided against himself, there was found a strife of courageous men .
text_la: Duces Issachar fuere cum Debbora, et Barac vestigia sunt secuti, qui quasi in præceps ac barathrum se discrimini dedit : diviso contra se Ruben, magnanimorum reperta est contentio.
text_pt: Também os principais de Issacar foram com Débora; e como Issacar, assim também Baraque, foi enviado a pé para o vale; nas divisões de Rúben foram grandes as resoluções do coração.
text_el: ἐν Ισσαχαρ μετὰ Δεββωρας ἐξαπέστειλεν πεζοὺς αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν κοιλάδα ἵνα τί σὺ κατοικεῖς ἐν μέσῳ χειλέων ἐξέτεινεν ἐν τοῖς ποσὶν αὐτοῦ ἐν διαιρέσεσιν Ρουβην μεγάλοι ἀκριβασμοὶ καρδίας

text_en: Why do you dwell between two borders, that you may hear the bleatings of the flocks? Ruben being divided against himself, there was found a strife of courageous men .
text_la: Quare habitas inter duos terminos, ut audias sibilos gregum? diviso contra se Ruben, magnanimorum reperta est contentio.
text_pt: Por que ficaste tu entre os currais para ouvires os balidos dos rebanhos? Nas divisões de Rúben tiveram grandes esquadrinhações do coração.
text_el: ἵνα τί μοι κάθησαι ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν μοσφαθαιμ τοῦ εἰσακούειν συρισμοὺς ἐξεγειρόντων τοῦ διελθεῖν εἰς τὰ τοῦ Ρουβην μεγάλοι ἐξιχνιασμοὶ καρδίας

text_en: Galaad rested beyond the Jordan , and Dan applied himself to ships: Aser dwelt on the sea shore, and abode in the havens.
text_la: Galaad trans Jordanem quiescebat, et Dan vacabat navibus : Aser habitabat in littore maris, et in portubus morabatur.
text_pt: Gileade ficou além do Jordão, e Dã por que se deteve nos navios? Aser se assentou na beira dos mares, e ficou junto às suas baías.
text_el: Γαλααδ ἐν τῷ πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου κατεσκήνωσεν καὶ Δαν ἵνα τί παροικεῖ πλοίοις Ασηρ παρῴκησεν παρ' αἰγιαλὸν θαλασσῶν καὶ ἐπὶ τὰς διακοπὰς αὐτοῦ κατεσκήνωσεν

text_en: But Zabulon and Nephthali offered their lives to death in the region of Merome.
text_la: Zabulon vero et Nephthali obtulerunt animas suas morti in regione Merome.
text_pt: Zebulom é um povo que expôs a sua vida à morte, como também Naftali, nas alturas do campo.
text_el: Ζαβουλων λαὸς ὀνειδίσας ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ εἰς θάνατον καὶ Νεφθαλιμ ἐπὶ ὕψη ἀγροῦ

text_en: The kings came and fought, the kings of Chanaan fought in Thanac, by the waters of Mageddo and yet they took no spoils.
text_la: Venerunt reges et pugnaverunt : pugnaverunt reges Chanaan in Thanach juxta aquas Mageddo, et tamen nihil tulere prædantes.
text_pt: Vieram reis, pelejaram; então pelejaram os reis de Canaã em Taanaque, junto às águas de Megido; não tomaram despojo de prata.
text_el: ἦλθον βασιλεῖς καὶ παρετάξαντο τότε ἐπολέμησαν βασιλεῖς Χανααν ἐν Θενναχ ἐπὶ ὕδατος Μαγεδδω πλεονεξίαν ἀργυρίου οὐκ ἔλαβον

text_en: There was war made against them from heaven : the stars, remaining in their order and courses, fought against Sisara.
text_la: De cælo dimicatum est contra eos : stellæ manentes in ordine et cursu suo, adversus Sisaram pugnaverunt.
text_pt: Desde os céus pelejaram; até as estrelas desde os lugares dos seus cursos pelejaram contra Sísera.
text_el: ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἐπολέμησαν ἀστέρες ἐκ τῆς τάξεως αὐτῶν ἐπολέμησαν μετὰ Σισαρα

text_en: The torrent of Cison dragged their carcasses, the torrent of Cadumim, the torrent of Cison: tread, my soul , upon the strong ones.
text_la: Torrens Cison traxit cadavera eorum, torrens Cadumim, torrens Cison : conculca, anima mea, robustos.
text_pt: O ribeiro de Quisom os arrastou, aquele antigo ribeiro, o ribeiro de Quisom. Pisaste, ó minha alma, à força.
text_el: χειμάρρους Κισων ἐξέβαλεν αὐτούς χειμάρρους καδημιμ χειμάρρους Κισων καταπατήσει αὐτοὺς ψυχή μου δυνατή

text_en: The hoofs of the horses were broken whilst the stoutest of the enemies fled amain, and fell headlong down.
text_la: Ungulæ equorum ceciderunt, fugientibus impetu, et per præceps ruentibus fortissimis hostium.
