text_pt: Então os cascos dos cavalos se despedaçaram; pelo galopar, o galopar dos seus valentes.
text_el: τότε ἀπεκόπησαν πτέρναι ἵππου αμαδαρωθ δυνατῶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Curse the land of Meroz, said the angel of the Lord : curse the inhabitants thereof, because they came not to the help of the Lord , to help his most valiant men .
text_la: Maledicite terræ Meroz, dixit angelus Domini : maledicite habitatoribus ejus, quia non venerunt ad auxilium Domini, in adjutorium fortissimorum ejus.
text_pt: Amaldiçoai a Meroz, diz o anjo do Senhor, acremente amaldiçoai aos seus moradores; porquanto não vieram ao socorro do Senhor, ao socorro do Senhor com os valorosos.
text_el: καταράσασθε Μαρωζ εἶπεν ὁ ἄγγελος κυρίου καταράσει καταράσασθε τοὺς ἐνοίκους αὐτῆς ὅτι οὐκ ἤλθοσαν εἰς τὴν βοήθειαν κυρίου βοηθὸς ἡμῶν κύριος ἐν μαχηταῖς δυνατός

text_en: Blessed among women be Jahel, the wife of Haber the Cinite , and blessed be she in her tent.
text_la: Benedicta inter mulieres Jahel uxor Haber Cinæi, et benedicatur in tabernaculo suo.
text_pt: Bendita seja entre as mulheres, Jael, mulher de Héber, o queneu; bendita seja entre as mulheres nas tendas.
text_el: εὐλογηθείη ἐκ γυναικῶν Ιαηλ γυνὴ Χαβερ τοῦ Κιναίου ἐκ γυναικῶν ἐν σκηνῇ εὐλογηθείη

text_en: He asked her water, and she gave him milk, and offered him butter in a dish fit for princes.
text_la: Aquam petenti lac dedit, et in phiala principum obtulit butyrum.
text_pt: Água pediu ele, leite lhe deu ela; em prato de nobres lhe ofereceu manteiga.
text_el: ὕδωρ ᾔτησεν αὐτήν καὶ γάλα ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ ἐν λακάνῃ ἰσχυρῶν προσήγγισεν βούτυρον

text_en: She put her left hand to the nail, and her right hand to the workman's hammer, and she struck Sisara, seeking in his head a place for the wound, and strongly piercing through his temples.
text_la: Sinistram manum misit ad clavum, et dexteram ad fabrorum malleos. Percussitque Sisaram quærens in capite vulneri locum, et tempus valide perforans :
text_pt: À estaca estendeu a sua mão esquerda, e ao martelo dos trabalhadores a sua direita; e matou a Sísera, e rachou-lhe a cabeça, quando lhe pregou e atravessou as fontes.
text_el: τὴν χεῖρα αὐτῆς τὴν ἀριστερὰν εἰς πάσσαλον ἐξέτεινεν τὴν δεξιὰν αὐτῆς εἰς ἀποτομὰς κατακόπων καὶ ἀπέτεμεν Σισαρα ἀπέτριψεν τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ συνέθλασεν καὶ διήλασεν τὴν γνάθον αὐτοῦ

text_en: Between her feet he fell: he fainted, and he died: he rolled before her feet, and there he lay lifeless and wretched.
text_la: inter pedes ejus ruit; defecit, et mortuus est : volvebatur ante pedes ejus, et jacebat exanimis et miserabilis.
text_pt: Entre os seus pés se encurvou, caiu, ficou estirado; entre os seus pés se encurvou, caiu; onde se encurvou, ali ficou abatido.
text_el: ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν ποδῶν αὐτῆς συγκάμψας ἔπεσεν ἐκοιμήθη μεταξὺ ποδῶν αὐτῆς ἐν ᾧ ἔκαμψεν ἐκεῖ ἔπεσεν ταλαίπωρος

text_en: His mother looked out at a window, and howled: and she spoke from the dining room: Why is his chariot so long in coming back? Why are the feet of his horses so slow?
text_la: Per fenestram respiciens, ululabat mater ejus : et de cœnaculo loquebatur : Cur moratur regredi currus ejus? quare tardaverunt pedes quadrigarum illius?
text_pt: A mãe de Sísera olhava pela janela, e exclamava pela grade: Por que tarda em vir o seu carro? Por que se demoram os ruídos dos seus carros?
text_el: διὰ τῆς θυρίδος διέκυπτεν ἡ μήτηρ Σισαρα διὰ τῆς δικτυωτῆς ἐπιβλέπουσα ἐπὶ τοὺς μεταστρέφοντας μετὰ Σισαρα διὰ τί ἠσχάτισεν τὸ ἅρμα αὐτοῦ παραγενέσθαι διὰ τί ἐχρόνισαν ἴχνη ἁρμάτων αὐτοῦ

text_en: One that was wiser than the rest of his wives, returned this answer to her mother in law:
text_la: Una sapientior ceteris uxoribus ejus, hæc socrui verba respondit :
text_pt: As mais sábias das suas damas responderam; e até ela respondia a si mesma:
text_el: σοφαὶ ἀρχουσῶν αὐτῆς ἀνταπεκρίναντο πρὸς αὐτήν καὶ αὐτὴ ἀπεκρίνατο ἐν ῥήμασιν αὐτῆς

text_en: Perhaps he is now dividing the spoils, and the fairest of the women is chosen out for him: garments of divers colours are given to Sisara for his prey, and furniture of different kinds is heaped together to adorn necks.
text_la: Forsitan nunc dividit spolia, et pulcherrima feminarum eligitur ei : vestes diversorum colorum Sisaræ traduntur in prædam, et supellex varia ad ornanda colla congeritur.
text_pt: Porventura não achariam e repartiriam despojos? Uma ou duas moças a cada homem? Para Sísera despojos de estofos coloridos, despojos de estofos coloridos bordados; de estofos coloridos bordados de ambos os lados como despojo para os pescoços.
text_el: οὐχὶ εὑρήσουσιν αὐτὸν διαμερίζοντα σκῦλα φιλιάζων φίλοις εἰς κεφαλὴν δυνατοῦ σκῦλα βαμμάτων Σισαρα σκῦλα βαμμάτων ποικιλίας βαφὴ ποικίλων περὶ τράχηλον αὐτοῦ σκῦλον

text_en: So let all your enemies perish, O Lord : but let them that love you shine, as the sun shines in his rising.
text_la: Sic pereant omnes inimici tui, Domine : qui autem diligunt te, sicut sol in ortu suo splendet, ita rutilent.
text_pt: Assim, ó Senhor, pereçam todos os teus inimigos! Porém os que te amam sejam como o sol quando sai na sua força.
text_el: οὕτως ἀπόλοιντο πάντες οἱ ἐχθροί σου κύριε καὶ οἱ ἀγαπῶντες αὐτὸν καθὼς ἡ ἀνατολὴ τοῦ ἡλίου ἐν δυναστείαις αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the children of Israel again did evil in the sight of the Lord : and he delivered them into the hand of Madian seven years,
text_la: Fecerunt autem filii Israël malum in conspectu Domini : qui tradidit illos in manu Madian septem annis,
text_pt: Porém os filhos de Israel fizeram o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR; e o SENHOR os deu nas mãos dos midianitas por sete anos.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ τὸ πονηρὸν ἔναντι κυρίου καὶ παρέδωκεν αὐτοὺς κύριος ἐν χειρὶ Μαδιαμ ἔτη ἑπτά

text_en: and they were grievously oppressed by them. And they made themselves dens and caves in the mountains, and strong holds to resist.
text_la: et oppressi sunt valde ab eis. Feceruntque sibi antra et speluncas in montibus, et munitissima ad repugnandum loca.
text_pt: E, prevalecendo a mão dos midianitas sobre Israel, fizeram os filhos de Israel para si, por causa dos midianitas, as covas que estão nos montes, as cavernas e as fortificações.
text_el: καὶ κατίσχυσεν χεὶρ Μαδιαμ ἐπὶ Ισραηλ καὶ ἐποίησαν ἑαυτοῖς οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἀπὸ προσώπου Μαδιαμ μάνδρας ἐν τοῖς ὄρεσιν καὶ τοῖς σπηλαίοις καὶ τοῖς ὀχυρώμασιν

text_en: And when Israel had sown, Madian and Amalec , and the rest of the eastern nations, came up:
text_la: Cumque sevisset Israël, ascendebat Madian et Amalec, ceterique orientalium nationum:
text_pt: Porque sucedia que, semeando Israel, os midianitas e os amalequitas, e também os do oriente, contra ele subiam.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὅταν ἔσπειρεν ἀνὴρ Ισραηλ καὶ ἀνέβαινεν Μαδιαμ καὶ Αμαληκ καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ ἀνατολῶν καὶ ἀνέβαινον ἐπ' αὐτόν

text_en: And pitching their tents among them, wasted all things as they were in the blade, even to the entrance of Gaza : and they left nothing at all in Israel for sustenance of life, nor sheep, nor oxen, nor asses.
text_la: et apud eos figentes tentoria, sicut erant in herbis cuncta vastabant usque ad introitum Gazæ : nihilque omnino ad vitam pertinens relinquebant in Israël, non oves, non boves, non asinos.
text_pt: E punham-se contra ele em campo, e destruíam os frutos da terra, até chegarem a Gaza; e não deixavam mantimento em Israel, nem ovelhas, nem bois, nem jumentos.
text_el: καὶ παρενέβαλλον ἐπ' αὐτοὺς καὶ διέφθειραν τὰ ἐκφόρια τῆς γῆς ἕως τοῦ ἐλθεῖν εἰς Γάζαν καὶ οὐχ ὑπελείποντο ὑπόστασιν ζωῆς ἐν Ισραηλ καὶ ποίμνιον καὶ μόσχον καὶ ὄνον

text_en: For they and all their flocks came with their tents, and like locusts filled all places, an innumerable multitude of men , and of camels, wasting whatsoever they touched.
text_la: Ipsi enim et universi greges eorum veniebant cum tabernaculis suis, et instar locustarum universa complebant, innumera multitudo hominum et camelorum, quidquid tetigerant devastantes.
text_pt: Porque subiam com os seus gados e tendas; vinham como gafanhotos, em grande multidão que não se podia contar, nem a eles nem aos seus camelos; e entravam na terra, para a destruir.
text_el: ὅτι αὐτοὶ καὶ τὰ κτήνη αὐτῶν ἀνέβαινον καὶ τὰς σκηνὰς αὐτῶν παρέφερον καὶ παρεγίνοντο ὡς ἀκρὶς εἰς πλῆθος καὶ αὐτοῖς καὶ ταῖς καμήλοις αὐτῶν οὐκ ἦν ἀριθμός καὶ παρεγίνοντο ἐν τῇ γῇ Ισραηλ τοῦ διαφθείρειν αὐτήν

text_en: And Israel was humbled exceedingly in the sight of Madian .
text_la: Humiliatusque est Israël valde in conspectu Madian.
text_pt: Assim Israel empobreceu muito pela presença dos midianitas; então os filhos de Israel clamaram ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐπτώχευσεν Ισραηλ σφόδρα ἀπὸ προσώπου Μαδιαμ καὶ ἐκέκραξαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ πρὸς κύριον

text_en: And he cried to the Lord , desiring help against the Madianites .
text_la: Et clamavit ad Dominum postulans auxilium contra Madianitas.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, clamando os filhos de Israel ao Senhor por causa dos midianitas,
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐπεὶ ἐκέκραξαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ πρὸς κύριον διὰ Μαδιαμ

text_en: And he sent unto them a prophet , and he spoke: Thus says the Lord , the God of Israel : I made you to come up out of Egypt , and brought you out of the house of bondage ,
text_la: Qui misit ad eos virum prophetam, et locutus est : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus Israël : Ego vos feci conscendere de Ægypto, et eduxi vos de domo servitutis,
text_pt: Enviou o Senhor um profeta aos filhos de Israel, que lhes disse: Assim diz o Senhor Deus de Israel: Do Egito eu vos fiz subir, e vos tirei da casa da servidão;
text_el: καὶ ἐξαπέστειλεν κύριος ἄνδρα προφήτην πρὸς τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς τάδε λέγει κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ἀναβιβάσας ὑμᾶς ἐξ Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἐξήγαγον ὑμᾶς ἐξ οἴκου δουλείας

text_en: and delivered you out of the hands of the Egyptians , and of all the enemies that afflicted you: and I cast them out at your coming in, and gave you their land.
text_la: et liberavi de manu Ægyptiorum, et omnium inimicorum qui affligebant vos : ejecique eos ad introitum vestrum, et tradidi vobis terram eorum.
text_pt: E vos livrei da mão dos egípcios, e da mão de todos quantos vos oprimiam; e os expulsei de diante de vós, e a vós dei a sua terra.
text_el: καὶ ἐξειλάμην ὑμᾶς ἐκ χειρὸς Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἐκ χειρὸς πάντων τῶν θλιβόντων ὑμᾶς καὶ ἐξέβαλον αὐτοὺς ἐκ προσώπου ὑμῶν καὶ ἔδωκα ὑμῖν τὴν γῆν αὐτῶν

text_en: And I said: I am the Lord your God , fear not the gods of the Amorrhites , in whose land you dwell. And you would not hear my voice.
text_la: Et dixi : Ego Dominus Deus vester : ne timeatis deos Amorrhæorum, in quorum terra habitatis. Et noluistis audire vocem meam.
text_pt: E vos disse: Eu sou o Senhor vosso Deus; não temais aos deuses dos amorreus, em cuja terra habitais; mas não destes ouvidos à minha voz.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα ὑμῖν ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν οὐ φοβηθήσεσθε τοὺς θεοὺς τοῦ Αμορραίου ἐν οἷς ὑμεῖς ἐνοικεῖτε ἐν τῇ γῇ αὐτῶν καὶ οὐκ εἰσηκούσατε τῆς φωνῆς μου

text_en: And an angel of the Lord came, and sat under an oak that was in Ephra, and belonged to Joas, the father of the family of Ezri. And when Gedeon , his son, was threshing and cleansing wheat by the winepress, to flee from Madian ,
text_la: Venit autem angelus Domini, et sedit sub quercu, quæ erat in Ephra, et pertinebat ad Joas patrem familiæ Ezri. Cumque Gedeon filius ejus excuteret atque purgaret frumenta in torculari, ut fugeret Madian,
text_pt: Então o anjo do Senhor veio, e assentou-se debaixo do carvalho que está em Ofra, que pertencia a Joás, abiezrita; e Gideão, seu filho, estava malhando o trigo no lagar, para o salvar dos midianitas.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν ἄγγελος κυρίου καὶ ἐκάθισεν ὑπὸ τὴν δρῦν τὴν οὖσαν ἐν Εφραθα τὴν τοῦ Ιωας πατρὸς Αβιεζρι καὶ Γεδεων ὁ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ ἐρράβδιζεν πυροὺς ἐν ληνῷ τοῦ ἐκφυγεῖν ἐκ προσώπου Μαδιαμ

text_en: the angel of the Lord appeared to him, and said: The Lord is with you, O most valiant of men .
text_la: apparuit ei angelus Domini, et ait : Dominus tecum, virorum fortissime.
text_pt: Então o anjo do Senhor lhe apareceu, e lhe disse: O Senhor é contigo, homem valoroso.
text_el: καὶ ὤφθη αὐτῷ ἄγγελος κυρίου καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν κύριος μετὰ σοῦ δυνατὸς τῇ ἰσχύι

text_en: And Gedeon said to him: I beseech you, my lord, if the Lord be with us, why have these evils fallen upon us? Where are his miracles , which our fathers have told us of, saying: The Lord brought us out of Egypt but now the Lord has forsaken us, and delivered us into the hand of Madian .
text_la: Dixitque ei Gedeon : Obsecro, mi domine, si Dominus nobiscum est, cur apprehenderunt nos hæc omnia? ubi sunt mirabilia ejus, quæ narraverunt patres nostri, atque dixerunt : De Ægypto eduxit nos Dominus? nunc autem dereliquit nos Dominus, et tradidit in manu Madian.
text_pt: Mas Gideão lhe respondeu: Ai, Senhor meu, se o Senhor é conosco, por que tudo isto nos sobreveio? E que é feito de todas as suas maravilhas que nossos pais nos contaram, dizendo: Não nos fez o Senhor subir do Egito? Porém agora o Senhor nos desamparou, e nos deu nas mãos dos midianitas.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτὸν Γεδεων ἐν ἐμοί κύριε καὶ εἰ ἔστιν κύριος μεθ' ἡμῶν ἵνα τί εὗρεν ἡμᾶς πάντα τὰ κακὰ ταῦτα καὶ ποῦ ἐστιν πάντα τὰ θαυμάσια αὐτοῦ ὅσα διηγήσαντο ἡμῖν οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν λέγοντες οὐχὶ ἐξ Αἰγύπτου ἀνήγαγεν ἡμᾶς κύριος καὶ νῦν ἀπώσατο ἡμᾶς καὶ παρέδωκεν ἡμᾶς ἐν χειρὶ Μαδιαμ

text_en: And the Lord looked upon him, and said: Go, in this your strength, and you shall deliver Israel out of the hand of Madian : know that I have sent you.
text_la: Respexitque ad eum Dominus, et ait : Vade in hac fortitudine tua, et liberabis Israël de manu Madian : scito quod miserim te.
text_pt: Então o Senhor olhou para ele, e disse: Vai nesta tua força, e livrarás a Israel das mãos dos midianitas; porventura não te enviei eu?
text_el: καὶ ἐπέβλεψεν πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ ἄγγελος κυρίου καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ πορεύου ἐν τῇ ἰσχύι σου καὶ σώσεις τὸν Ισραηλ καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐξαπέστειλά σε

text_en: He answered, and said: I beseech you, my lord wherewith shall I deliver Israel ? Behold, my family is the meanest in Manasses , and I am the least in my father's house.
text_la: Qui respondens ait : Obsecro, mi domine, in quo liberabo Israël? ecce familia mea infima est in Manasse, et ego minimus in domo patris mei.
text_pt: E ele lhe disse: Ai, Senhor meu, com que livrarei a Israel? Eis que a minha família é a mais pobre em Manassés, e eu o menor na casa de meu pai.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτὸν Γεδεων ἐν ἐμοί κύριε ἐν τίνι σώσω τὸν Ισραηλ ἰδοὺ ἡ χιλιάς μου ταπεινοτέρα ἐν Μανασση καὶ ἐγώ εἰμι μικρὸς ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ πατρός μου

text_en: And the Lord said to him: I will be with you: and you shall cut off Madian as one man .
text_la: Dixitque ei Dominus : Ego ero tecum : et percuties Madian quasi unum virum.
text_pt: E o Senhor lhe disse: Porquanto eu hei de ser contigo, tu ferirás aos midianitas como se fossem um só homem.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ ἄγγελος κυρίου κύριος ἔσται μετὰ σοῦ καὶ πατάξεις τὴν Μαδιαμ ὡσεὶ ἄνδρα ἕνα

text_en: And he said: If I have found grace before you, give me a sign that it is you that speak to me:
text_la: Et ille : Si inveni, inquit, gratiam coram te, da mihi signum quod tu sis qui loqueris ad me:
text_pt: E ele disse: Se agora tenho achado graça aos teus olhos, dá-me um sinal de que és tu que falas comigo.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτὸν Γεδεων καὶ εἰ εὗρον χάριν ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς σου καὶ ποιήσεις μοι σημεῖον ὅτι σὺ λαλεῖς μετ' ἐμοῦ

text_en: And depart not hence, till I return to you, and bring a sacrifice , and offer it to you. And he answered: I will wait your coming.
text_la: nec recedas hinc, donec revertar ad te, portans sacrificium, et offerens tibi. Qui respondit : Ego præstolabor adventum tuum.
text_pt: Rogo-te que daqui não te apartes, até que eu volte e traga o meu presente, e o ponha perante ti. E disse: Eu esperarei até que voltes.
text_el: μὴ κινηθῇς ἐντεῦθεν ἕως τοῦ ἐλθεῖν με πρὸς σέ καὶ οἴσω τὴν θυσίαν μου καὶ θήσω ἐνώπιόν σου καὶ εἶπεν ἐγώ εἰμι καθήσομαι ἕως τοῦ ἐπιστρέψαι σε

text_en: So Gedeon went in, and boiled a kid, and made unleavened loaves of a measure of flour: and putting the flesh in a basket, and the broth of the flesh into a pot, he carried all under the oak, and presented to him.
text_la: Ingressus est itaque Gedeon, et coxit hædum, et de farinæ modio azymos panes : carnesque ponens in canistro, et jus carnium mittens in ollam, tulit omnia sub quercu, et obtulit ei.
text_pt: E entrou Gideão e preparou um cabrito e pães ázimos de um efa de farinha; a carne pôs num cesto e o caldo pôs numa panela; e trouxe-lho até debaixo do carvalho, e lho ofereceu.
text_el: καὶ Γεδεων εἰσῆλθεν καὶ ἐποίησεν ἔριφον αἰγῶν καὶ οιφι ἀλεύρου ἄζυμα καὶ τὰ κρέα ἐπέθηκεν ἐπὶ τὸ κανοῦν καὶ τὸν ζωμὸν ἐνέχεεν εἰς χύτραν καὶ ἐξήνεγκεν πρὸς αὐτὸν ὑπὸ τὴν δρῦν καὶ προσεκύνησεν

text_en: And the angel of the Lord said to him: Take the flesh and the unleavened loaves , and lay them upon that rock, and pour out the broth thereon. And when he had done so,
text_la: Cui dixit angelus Domini : Tolle carnes et azymos panes, et pone supra petram illam, et jus desuper funde. Cumque fecisset ita,
text_pt: Porém o anjo de Deus lhe disse: Toma a carne e os pães ázimos, e põe-nos sobre esta penha e derrama-lhe o caldo. E assim fez.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ ἄγγελος κυρίου λαβὲ τὰ κρέα καὶ τοὺς ἄρτους τοὺς ἀζύμους καὶ θὲς πρὸς τὴν πέτραν ἐκείνην καὶ τὸν ζωμὸν ἔκχεον καὶ ἐποίησεν οὕτως

text_en: the angel of the Lord put forth the tip of the rod, which he held in his hand, and touched the flesh and the unleavened loaves : and there arose a fire from the rock, and consumed the flesh and the unleavened loaves : and the angel of the Lord vanished out of his sight.
text_la: extendit angelus Domini summitatem virgæ, quam tenebat in manu, et tetigit carnes et panes azymos : ascenditque ignis de petra, et carnes azymosque panes consumpsit : angelus autem Domini evanuit ex oculis ejus.
text_pt: E o anjo do Senhor estendeu a ponta do cajado, que estava na sua mão, e tocou a carne e os pães ázimos; então subiu o fogo da penha, e consumiu a carne e os pães ázimos; e o anjo do Senhor desapareceu de seus olhos.
text_el: καὶ ἐξέτεινεν ὁ ἄγγελος κυρίου τὸ ἄκρον τῆς ῥάβδου τῆς ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἥψατο τῶν κρεῶν καὶ τῶν ἀζύμων καὶ ἀνήφθη πῦρ ἐκ τῆς πέτρας καὶ κατέφαγεν τὰ κρέα καὶ τοὺς ἀζύμους καὶ ὁ ἄγγελος κυρίου ἀπῆλθεν ἐξ ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Gedeon seeing that it was the angel of the Lord , said: Alas, my Lord God : for I have seen the angel of the Lord face to face.
text_la: Vidensque Gedeon quod esset angelus Domini, ait : Heu mi Domine Deus : quia vidi angelum Domini facie ad faciem.
text_pt: Então viu Gideão que era o anjo do SENHOR e disse: Ah, Senhor DEUS, pois vi o anjo do SENHOR face a face.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν Γεδεων ὅτι ἄγγελος κυρίου ἐστίν καὶ εἶπεν Γεδεων ἆ ἆ κύριε κύριε ὅτι εἶδον τὸν ἄγγελον κυρίου πρόσωπον πρὸς πρόσωπον

text_en: And the Lord said to him: Peace be with you: fear not, you shall not die.
text_la: Dixitque ei Dominus : Pax tecum : ne timeas, non morieris.
text_pt: Porém o Senhor lhe disse: Paz seja contigo; não temas; não morrerás.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ κύριος εἰρήνη σοι μὴ φοβοῦ μὴ ἀποθάνῃς

text_en: And Gedeon built there an altar to the Lord , and called it the Lord's peace , until this present day. And when he was yet in Ephra, which is of the family of Ezri,
text_la: Ædificavit ergo ibi Gedeon altare Domino, vocavitque illud, Domini pax, usque in præsentem diem. Cumque adhuc esset in Ephra, quæ est familiæ Ezri,
text_pt: Então Gideão edificou ali um altar ao SENHOR, e chamou-lhe: O SENHOR É PAZ; e ainda até o dia de hoje está em Ofra dos abiezritas.
text_el: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν ἐκεῖ Γεδεων θυσιαστήριον τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ ἐκάλεσεν αὐτὸ Εἰρήνη κυρίου ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης ἔτι αὐτοῦ ὄντος ἐν Εφραθα πατρὸς τοῦ Εζρι

text_en: that night the Lord said to him: Take a bullock of your father's, and another bullock of seven years, and you shall destroy the altar of Baal , which is your father's: and cut down the grove that is about the altar :
text_la: nocte illa dixit Dominus ad eum : Tolle taurum patris tui, et alterum taurum annorum septem, destruesque aram Baal, quæ est patris tui, et nemus, quod circa aram est, succide.
text_pt: E aconteceu naquela mesma noite, que o Senhor lhe disse: Toma o boi que pertence a teu pai, a saber, o segundo boi de sete anos, e derruba o altar de Baal, que é de teu pai; e corta o bosque que está ao pé dele.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη τῇ νυκτὶ ἐκείνῃ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ κύριος λαβὲ τὸν μόσχον τὸν σιτευτὸν τοῦ πατρός σου μόσχον τὸν ἑπταετῆ καὶ καθελεῖς τὸ θυσιαστήριον τοῦ Βααλ ὅ ἐστιν τοῦ πατρός σου καὶ τὸ ἄλσος τὸ ἐπ' αὐτῷ ἐκκόψεις

text_en: And you shall build un altar to the Lord your God , in the top of this rock, whereupon you laid the sacrifice before: and you shall take the second bullock, and shall offer a holocaust upon a pile of the wood, which you shall cut down out of the grove.
text_la: Et ædificabis altare Domino Deo tuo in summitate petræ hujus, super quam ante sacrificium posuisti : tollesque taurum secundum, et offeres holocaustum super struem lignorum, quæ de nemore succideris.
text_pt: E edifica ao Senhor teu Deus um altar no cume deste lugar forte, num lugar conveniente; e toma o segundo boi, e o oferecerás em holocausto com a lenha que cortares do bosque.
text_el: καὶ οἰκοδομήσεις θυσιαστήριον κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ σου τῷ ὀφθέντι σοι ἐπὶ τῆς κορυφῆς τοῦ ὄρους Μαωζ τούτου ἐν τῇ παρατάξει καὶ λήμψῃ τὸν μόσχον καὶ ἀνοίσεις ὁλοκαύτωμα ἐν τοῖς ξύλοις τοῦ ἄλσους οὗ ἐκκόψεις

text_en: Then Gedeon , taking ten men of his servants, did as the Lord had commanded him. But fearing his father's house, and the men of that city, he would not do it by day, but did all by night.
text_la: Assumptis ergo Gedeon decem viris de servis suis, fecit sicut præceperat ei Dominus. Timens autem domum patris sui, et homines illius civitatis, per diem noluit id facere, sed omnia nocte complevit.
text_pt: Então Gideão tomou dez homens dentre os seus servos, e fez como o Senhor lhe dissera; e sucedeu que, temendo ele a casa de seu pai, e os homens daquela cidade, não o fez de dia, mas fê-lo de noite.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Γεδεων τρεῖς καὶ δέκα ἄνδρας ἀπὸ τῶν δούλων αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐποίησεν καθὰ ἐλάλησεν πρὸς αὐτὸν κύριος καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἐφοβήθη τὸν οἶκον τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ τοὺς ἄνδρας τῆς πόλεως μὴ ποιῆσαι ἡμέρας καὶ ἐποίησεν νυκτός

text_en: And when the men of that town were risen in the morning, they saw the altar of Baal destroyed, and the grove cut down, and the second bullock laid upon the altar , which then was built.
text_la: Cumque surrexissent viri oppidi ejus mane, viderunt destructam aram Baal, lucumque succisum, et taurum alterum impositum super altare, quod tunc ædificatum erat.
text_pt: Levantando-se, pois, os homens daquela cidade, de madrugada, eis que estava o altar de Baal derrubado, e o bosque estava ao pé dele, cortado; e o segundo boi oferecido no altar que fora edificado.
text_el: καὶ ὤρθρισαν οἱ ἄνδρες τῆς πόλεως τὸ πρωί καὶ ἰδοὺ κατεσκαμμένον τὸ θυσιαστήριον τοῦ Βααλ καὶ τὸ ἄλσος τὸ ἐπ' αὐτῷ ἐκκεκομμένον καὶ ὁ μόσχος ὁ σιτευτὸς ἀνηνεγμένος εἰς ὁλοκαύτωμα ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον τὸ ᾠκοδομημένον

text_en: And they said one to another: Who has done this? And when they inquired for the author of the fact, it was said: Gedeon, the son of Joas , did all this.
text_la: Dixeruntque ad invicem : Quis hoc fecit? Cumque perquirerent auctorem facti, dictum est : Gedeon filius Joas fecit hæc omnia.
text_pt: E uns aos outros disseram: Quem fez esta coisa? E, esquadrinhando, e inquirindo, disseram: Gideão, o filho de Joás, fez esta coisa.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ἀνὴρ πρὸς τὸν πλησίον αὐτοῦ τίς ἐποίησεν τὸ πρᾶγμα τοῦτο καὶ ἀνήταζον καὶ ἐξεζήτουν καὶ εἶπαν Γεδεων ὁ υἱὸς Ιωας ἐποίησεν τὸ πρᾶγμα τοῦτο

text_en: And they said to Joas: Bring out your son hither, that he may die: because he has destroyed the altar of Baal , and has cut down his grove.
text_la: Et dixerunt ad Joas : Produc filium tuum huc, ut moriatur : quia destruxit aram Baal, et succidit nemus.
text_pt: Então os homens daquela cidade disseram a Joás: Tira para fora a teu filho; para que morra; pois derribou o altar de Baal, e cortou o bosque que estava ao pé dele.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν οἱ ἄνδρες τῆς πόλεως πρὸς Ιωας ἐξάγαγε τὸν υἱόν σου καὶ ἀποθανέτω ὅτι κατέσκαψεν τὸ θυσιαστήριον τοῦ Βααλ καὶ ὅτι ἔκοψεν τὸ ἄλσος τὸ ἐπ' αὐτῷ

text_en: He answered them: Are you the avengers of Baal , that you fight for him? He that is his adversary, let him die before tomorrow light appear: if he be a god, let him revenge himself on him that has cast down his altar .
text_la: Quibus ille respondit : Numquid ultores estis Baal, ut pugnetis pro eo? qui adversarius est ejus, moriatur antequam lux crastina veniat : si deus est, vindicet se de eo, qui suffodit aram ejus.
text_pt: Porém Joás disse a todos os que se puseram contra ele: Contendereis vós por Baal? Livrá-lo-eis vós? Qualquer que por ele contender ainda esta manhã será morto; se é deus, por si mesmo contenda; pois derrubaram o seu altar.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιωας πρὸς τοὺς ἄνδρας τοὺς ἑσταμένους ἐπ' αὐτόν μὴ ὑμεῖς νῦν δικάζεσθε περὶ τοῦ Βααλ ἢ ὑμεῖς σῴζετε αὐτόν ὃς ἀντεδίκησεν αὐτόν ἀποθανεῖται ἕως πρωί εἰ ἔστιν θεός αὐτὸς ἐκδικήσει αὐτόν ὅτι κατέσκαψεν τὸ θυσιαστήριον αὐτοῦ

text_en: From that day Gedeon was called Jerobaal , because Joas had said: Let Baal revenge himself on him that has cast down his altar .
text_la: Ex illo die vocatus est Gedeon Jerobaal, eo quod dixisset Joas : Ulciscatur se de eo Baal, qui suffodit aram ejus.
text_pt: Por isso naquele dia lhe chamaram Jerubaal, dizendo: Baal contenda contra ele, pois derrubou o seu altar.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν αὐτὸ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ Δικαστήριον τοῦ Βααλ ὅτι κατέσκαψεν τὸ θυσιαστήριον αὐτοῦ

text_en: Now all Madian , and Amalec , and the eastern people, were gathered together, and passing over the Jordan , camped in the valley of Jezrael.
text_la: Igitur omnis Madian, et Amalec, et orientales populi, congregati sunt simul : et transeuntes Jordanem, castrametati sunt in valle Jezraël.
text_pt: E todos os midianitas e amalequitas, e os filhos do oriente se ajuntaram, e passaram, e acamparam no vale de Jizreel.
text_el: καὶ πᾶσα Μαδιαμ καὶ Αμαληκ καὶ υἱοὶ ἀνατολῶν συνήχθησαν ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ καὶ διέβησαν καὶ παρενέβαλον ἐν τῇ κοιλάδι Ιεζραελ

text_en: But the spirit of the Lord came upon Gedeon , and he sounded the trumpet, and called together the house of Abiezer, to follow him.
text_la: Spiritus autem Domini induit Gedeon, qui clangens buccina convocavit domum Abiezer, ut sequeretur se.
text_pt: Então o Espírito do SENHOR revestiu a Gideão, o qual tocou a buzina, e os abiezritas se ajuntaram após ele.
text_el: καὶ πνεῦμα θεοῦ ἐνέδυσεν τὸν Γεδεων καὶ ἐσάλπισεν ἐν κερατίνῃ καὶ ἐβόησεν Αβιεζερ ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he sent messengers into all Manasses , and they also followed him and other messengers into Aser and Zabulon , and Nephthali , and they came to meet him.
text_la: Misitque nuntios in universum Manassen, qui et ipse secutus est eum : et alios nuntios in Aser et Zabulon et Nephthali, qui occurrerunt ei.
text_pt: E enviou mensageiros por toda a tribo de Manassés, que também se ajuntou após ele; também enviou mensageiros a Aser, e a Zebulom, e a Naftali, que saíram-lhe ao encontro.
text_el: καὶ ἀγγέλους ἐξαπέστειλεν ἐν παντὶ Μανασση καὶ ἐβόησεν καὶ αὐτὸς ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξαπέστειλεν ἀγγέλους ἐν Ασηρ καὶ ἐν Ζαβουλων καὶ ἐν Νεφθαλι καὶ ἀνέβησαν εἰς συνάντησιν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Gedeon said to God : If you will save Israel by my hand, as you have said,
text_la: Dixitque Gedeon ad Deum : Si salvum facis per manum meam Israël, sicut locutus es,
text_pt: E disse Gideão a Deus: Se hás de livrar a Israel por minha mão, como disseste,
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Γεδεων πρὸς τὸν θεόν εἰ σῴζεις ἐν τῇ χειρί μου τὸν Ισραηλ ὃν τρόπον ἐλάλησας

text_en: I will put this fleece of wool on the floor: if there be dew in the fleece only, and it be dry on all the ground beside, I shall know that by my hand, as you have said, you will deliver Israel .
text_la: ponam hoc vellus lanæ in area : si ros in solo vellere fuerit, et in omni terra siccitas, sciam quod per manum meam, sicut locutus es, liberabis Israël.
text_pt: Eis que eu porei um velo de lã na eira; se o orvalho estiver somente no velo, e toda a terra ficar seca, então conhecerei que hás de livrar a Israel por minha mão, como disseste.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἀπερείδομαι τὸν πόκον τῶν ἐρίων ἐν τῷ ἅλωνι καὶ ἐὰν δρόσος γένηται ἐπὶ τὸν πόκον μόνον καὶ ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν ξηρασία καὶ γνώσομαι ὅτι σῴζεις ἐν τῇ χειρί μου τὸν Ισραηλ ὃν τρόπον ἐλάλησας

text_en: And it was so. And rising before day, wringing the fleece, he filled a vessel with the dew.
text_la: Factumque est ita. Et de nocte consurgens expresso vellere, concham rore implevit.
text_pt: E assim sucedeu; porque no outro dia se levantou de madrugada, e apertou o velo; e do orvalho que espremeu do velo, encheu uma taça de água.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο οὕτως καὶ ὤρθρισεν Γεδεων τῇ ἐπαύριον καὶ ἀπεπίασεν τὸν πόκον καὶ ἀπερρύη ἡ δρόσος ἐκ τοῦ πόκου πλήρης λεκάνη ὕδατος

text_en: And he said again to God : Let not your wrath be kindled against me, if I try once more, seeking a sign in the fleece. I pray that the fleece only may be dry, and all the ground wet with dew.
text_la: Dixitque rursus ad Deum : Ne irascatur furor tuus contra me si adhuc semel tentavero, signum quærens in vellere. Oro ut solum vellus siccum sit, et omnis terra rore madens.
text_pt: E disse Gideão a Deus: Não se acenda contra mim a tua ira, se ainda falar só esta vez; rogo-te que só esta vez faça a prova com o velo; rogo-te que só o velo fique seco, e em toda a terra haja o orvalho.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Γεδεων πρὸς τὸν θεόν μὴ ὀργισθήτω ὁ θυμός σου ἐν ἐμοί καὶ λαλήσω ἔτι ἅπαξ καὶ πειράσω ἔτι ἅπαξ ἐν τῷ πόκῳ καὶ γενηθήτω ξηρασία ἐπὶ τὸν πόκον μόνον ἐπὶ δὲ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν γενηθήτω δρόσος

text_en: And God did that night as he had requested: and it was dry on the fleece only, and there was dew on all the ground.
text_la: Fecitque Deus nocte illa ut postulaverat : et fuit siccitas in solo vellere, et ros in omni terra.
text_pt: E Deus assim fez naquela noite; pois só o velo ficou seco, e sobre toda a terra havia orvalho.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν ὁ θεὸς οὕτως ἐν τῇ νυκτὶ ἐκείνῃ καὶ ἐγένετο ξηρασία ἐπὶ τὸν πόκον μόνον ἐπὶ δὲ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν ἐγένετο δρόσος

text_en: Then Jerobaal , who is the same as Gedeon , rising up early, and all the people with him, came to the fountain that is called Harad. Now the camp of Madian was in the valley, on the north side of the high hill.
text_la: Igitur Jerobaal qui et Gedeon, de nocte consurgens, et omnis populus cum eo, venit ad fontem qui vocatur Harad. Erant autem castra Madian in valle ad septentrionalem plagam collis excelsi.
text_pt: Então Jerubaal (que é Gideão) se levantou de madrugada, e todo o povo que com ele havia, e se acamparam junto à fonte de Harode, de maneira que tinha o arraial dos midianitas para o norte, no vale, perto do outeiro de Moré.
text_el: καὶ ὤρθρισεν Ιεροβααλ αὐτός ἐστιν Γεδεων καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ὁ μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ παρενέβαλεν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν Αρωεδ καὶ παρεμβολὴ Μαδιαμ καὶ Αμαληκ ἦν αὐτῷ ἀπὸ βορρᾶ ἀπὸ τοῦ βουνοῦ τοῦ Αβωρ ἐν τῇ κοιλάδι

text_en: And the Lord said to Gedeon : The people that are with you are many, and Madian shall not be delivered into their hands: lest Israel should glory against me, and say: I was delivered by my own strength.
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad Gedeon : Multus tecum est populus, nec tradetur Madian in manus ejus : ne glorietur contra me Israël, et dicat : Meis viribus liberatus sum.
text_pt: E disse o Senhor a Gideão: Muito é o povo que está contigo, para eu dar aos midianitas em sua mão; a fim de que Israel não se glorie contra mim, dizendo: A minha mão me livrou.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Γεδεων πολὺς ὁ λαὸς ὁ μετὰ σοῦ ὥστε μὴ παραδοῦναί με τὴν Μαδιαμ ἐν χειρὶ αὐτῶν μήποτε καυχήσηται Ισραηλ ἐπ' ἐμὲ λέγων ἡ χείρ μου ἔσωσέν με

text_en: Speak to the people, and proclaim in the hearing of all: Whosoever is fearful and timorous, let him return. So two and twenty thousand men went away from Mount Galaad and returned home, and only ten thousand remained.
text_la: Loquere ad populum, et cunctis audientibus prædica : Qui formidolosus et timidus est, revertatur. Recesseruntque de monte Galaad, et reversi sunt de populo viginti duo millia virorum, et tantum decem millia remanserunt.
text_pt: Agora, pois, apregoa aos ouvidos do povo, dizendo: Quem for medroso e tímido, volte, e retire-se apressadamente das montanhas de Gileade. Então voltaram do povo vinte e dois mil, e dez mil ficaram.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς αὐτόν λάλησον δὴ εἰς τὰ ὦτα τοῦ λαοῦ λέγων τίς δειλὸς καὶ φοβούμενος ἀποστραφήτω καὶ ἐξώρμησαν ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄρους τοῦ Γαλααδ καὶ ἀπεστράφησαν ἀπὸ τοῦ λαοῦ εἴκοσι καὶ δύο χιλιάδες καὶ δέκα χιλιάδες ὑπελείφθησαν

text_en: And the Lord said to Gedeon : The people are still too many, bring them to the waters, and there I will try them: and of whom I shall say to you, This shall go with you, let him go: whom I shall forbid to go, let him return.
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad Gedeon : Adhuc populus multus est : duc eos ad aquas et ibi probabo illos : et de quo dixero tibi ut tecum vadat, ipse pergat; quem ire prohibuero, revertatur.
text_pt: E disse o Senhor a Gideão: Ainda há muito povo; faze-os descer às águas, e ali os provarei; e será que, daquele de que eu te disser: Este irá contigo, esse contigo irá; porém de todo aquele, de que eu te disser: Este não irá contigo, esse não irá.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Γεδεων ἔτι ὁ λαὸς πολύς κατάγαγε αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸ ὕδωρ καὶ δοκιμῶ αὐτούς σοι ἐκεῖ καὶ ἔσται ὃν ἐὰν εἴπω πρὸς σέ οὗτος πορεύσεται μετὰ σοῦ αὐτὸς πορεύσεται μετὰ σοῦ καὶ ὃν ἐὰν εἴπω σοι ὅτι οὐ πορεύσεται μετὰ σοῦ αὐτὸς οὐ πορεύσεται μετὰ σοῦ

text_en: And when the people had come down to the waters, the Lord said to Gedeon : They that shall lap the water with their tongues, as dogs are wont to lap, you shall set apart by themselves: but they that shall drink bowing down their knees, shall be on the other side.
text_la: Cumque descendisset populus ad aquas, dixit Dominus ad Gedeon : Qui lingua lambuerint aquas, sicut solent canes lambere, separabis eos seorsum : qui autem curvatis genibus biberint, in altera parte erunt.
text_pt: E fez descer o povo às águas. Então o Senhor disse a Gideão: Qualquer que lamber as águas com a sua língua, como as lambe o cão, esse porás à parte; como também a todo aquele que se abaixar de joelhos a beber.
text_el: καὶ κατεβίβασεν τὸν λαὸν εἰς τὸ ὕδωρ καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Γεδεων πᾶς ὃς ἂν λάψῃ τῇ γλώσσῃ αὐτοῦ ἐκ τοῦ ὕδατος ὡς ἐὰν λάψῃ ὁ κύων στήσεις αὐτὸν κατὰ μόνας καὶ πᾶς ὃς ἂν κάμψῃ ἐπὶ τὰ γόνατα αὐτοῦ τοῦ πιεῖν μεταστήσεις αὐτὸν καθ' αὑτόν

text_en: And the number of them that had lapped water; casting it with the hand to their mouth, was three hundred men : and all the rest of the multitude had drunk kneeling.
text_la: Fuit itaque numerus eorum qui manu ad os projiciente lambuerunt aquas, trecenti viri : omnis autem reliqua multitudo flexo poplite biberat.
text_pt: E foi o número dos que lamberam, levando a mão à boca, trezentos homens; e todo o restante do povo se abaixou de joelhos a beber as águas.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο πᾶς ὁ ἀριθμὸς τῶν λαψάντων ἐν τῇ γλώσσῃ αὐτῶν τριακόσιοι ἄνδρες καὶ πᾶς ὁ ἐπίλοιπος τοῦ λαοῦ ἔκαμψαν ἐπὶ τὰ γόνατα αὐτῶν τοῦ πιεῖν ὕδωρ

text_en: And the Lord said to Gedeon : By the three hundred men , that lapped water, I will save you, and deliver Madian into your hand: but let all the rest of the people return to their place.
text_la: Et ait Dominus ad Gedeon : In trecentis viris qui lambuerunt aquas, liberabo vos, et tradam in manu tua Madian : omnis autem reliqua multitudo revertatur in locum suum.
text_pt: E disse o Senhor a Gideão: Com estes trezentos homens que lamberam as águas vos livrarei, e darei os midianitas na tua mão; portanto, todos os demais se retirem, cada um ao seu lugar.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Γεδεων ἐν τοῖς τριακοσίοις ἀνδράσιν τοῖς λάψασιν σώσω ὑμᾶς καὶ παραδώσω τὴν Μαδιαμ ἐν χειρί σου καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ἀποτρεχέτω ἀνὴρ εἰς τὸν τόπον αὐτοῦ

text_en: So taking victuals and trumpets according to their number, he ordered all the rest of the multitude to depart to their tents: and he with the three hundred gave himself to the battle. Now the camp of Madia was beneath him in the valley.
text_la: Sumptis itaque pro numero cibariis et tubis, omnem reliquam multitudinem abire præcepit ad tabernacula sua : et ipse cum trecentis viris se certamini dedit. Castra autem Madian erant subter in valle.
text_pt: E o povo tomou na sua mão a provisão e as suas buzinas, e enviou a todos os outros homens de Israel cada um à sua tenda, porém os trezentos homens reteve; e estava o arraial dos midianitas embaixo, no vale.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβον τὸν ἐπισιτισμὸν τοῦ λαοῦ ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτῶν καὶ τὰς κερατίνας αὐτῶν καὶ πάντα ἄνδρα Ισραηλ ἐξαπέστειλεν ἄνδρα εἰς τὸ σκήνωμα αὐτοῦ τῶν δὲ τριακοσίων ἀνδρῶν ἐκράτησεν ἡ δὲ παρεμβολὴ Μαδιαμ ἦν ὑποκάτωθεν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ κοιλάδι

text_en: The same night the Lord said to him: Arise, and go down into the camp: because I have delivered them into your hand.
text_la: Eadem nocte dixit Dominus ad eum : Surge, et descende in castra : quia tradidi eos in manu tua.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, naquela mesma noite, o Senhor lhe disse: Levanta-te, e desce ao arraial, porque o tenho dado na tua mão.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη ἐν τῇ νυκτὶ ἐκείνῃ καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτὸν κύριος ἀνάστα κατάβηθι τὸ τάχος ἐντεῦθεν εἰς τὴν παρεμβολήν ὅτι παρέδωκα αὐτὴν ἐν τῇ χειρί σου

text_en: But if you be afraid to go alone, let Phara, your servant, go down with you.
text_la: Sin autem solus ire formidas, descendat tecum Phara puer tuus.
text_pt: E, se ainda temes descer, desce tu e teu moço Purá, ao arraial;
text_el: εἰ δὲ φοβῇ σὺ καταβῆναι κατάβηθι σὺ καὶ Φαρα τὸ παιδάριόν σου εἰς τὴν παρεμβολὴν

text_en: And when you shall hear what they are saying, then shall your hands be strengthened, and you shall go down more secure to the enemies' camp. And he went down with Phara his servant, into part of the camp, where was the watch of men in arms.
text_la: Et cum audieris quid loquantur, tunc confortabuntur manus tuæ, et securior ad hostium castra descendes. Descendit ergo ipse et Phara puer ejus in partem castrorum, ubi erant armatorum vigiliæ.
text_pt: E ouvirás o que dizem, e então, fortalecidas as tuas mãos descerás ao arraial. Então desceu ele com o seu moço Purá até ao extremo das sentinelas que estavam no arraial.
text_el: καὶ ἀκούσῃ τί λαλοῦσιν καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα ἰσχύσουσιν αἱ χεῖρές σου καὶ καταβήσῃ ἐν τῇ παρεμβολῇ καὶ κατέβη αὐτὸς καὶ Φαρα τὸ παιδάριον αὐτοῦ εἰς μέρος τῶν πεντήκοντα τῶν ἐν τῇ παρεμβολῇ

text_en: But Madian and Amalec , and all the eastern people, lay scattered in the valley, as a multitude of locusts: their camels also were innumerable, as the sand that lies on the sea shore.
text_la: Madian autem et Amalec, et omnes orientales populi, fusi jacebant in valle, ut locustarum multitudo : cameli quoque innumerabiles erant, sicut arena quæ jacet in littore maris.
text_pt: E os midianitas, os amalequitas, e todos os filhos do oriente jaziam no vale como gafanhotos em multidão; e eram inumeráveis os seus camelos, como a areia que há na praia do mar.
text_el: καὶ Μαδιαμ καὶ Αμαληκ καὶ πάντες οἱ υἱοὶ ἀνατολῶν παρεμβεβλήκεισαν ἐν τῇ κοιλάδι ὡς ἀκρὶς εἰς πλῆθος καὶ ταῖς καμήλοις αὐτῶν οὐκ ἦν ἀριθμός ἀλλ' ἦσαν ὥσπερ ἡ ἄμμος ἡ ἐπὶ τὸ χεῖλος τῆς θαλάσσης εἰς πλῆθος

text_en: And when Gedeon had come, one told his neighbour a dream : and in this manner related what he had seen: I dreamt a dream , and it seemed to me as if a hearth cake of barley bread rolled and came down into the camp of Madian : and when it had come to a tent, it struck it, and beat it down flat to the ground.
text_la: Cumque venisset Gedeon, narrabat aliquis somnium proximo suo : et in hunc modum referebat quod viderat : Vidi somnium, et videbatur mihi quasi subcinericius panis ex hordeo volvi, et in castra Madian descendere : cumque pervenisset ad tabernaculum, percussit illud, atque subvertit, et terræ funditus coæquavit.
text_pt: Chegando, pois, Gideão, eis que estava contando um homem ao seu companheiro um sonho, e dizia: Eis que tive um sonho, eis que um pão de cevada torrado rodava pelo arraial dos midianitas, e chegava até à tenda, e a feriu, e caiu, e a transtornou de cima para baixo; e ficou caída.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν Γεδεων καὶ ἰδοὺ ἀνὴρ ἐξηγεῖτο τῷ πλησίον αὐτοῦ τὸ ἐνύπνιον καὶ εἶπεν ἰδοὺ τὸ ἐνύπνιον ὃ ἠνυπνιάσθην καὶ ἰδοὺ μαγὶς ἄρτου κριθίνου κυλιομένη ἐν τῇ παρεμβολῇ Μαδιαμ καὶ ἦλθεν ἕως τῆς σκηνῆς Μαδιαμ καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτὴν καὶ κατέστρεψεν αὐτήν καὶ ἔπεσεν ἡ σκηνή

text_en: He to whom he spoke, answered: This is nothing else but the sword of Gedeon, the son of Joas , a man of Israel . For the Lord has delivered Madian , and all their camp into his hand.
text_la: Respondit is, cui loquebatur : Non est hoc aliud, nisi gladius Gedeonis filii Joas viri Israëlitæ : tradidit enim Dominus in manus ejus Madian, et omnia castra ejus.
text_pt: E respondeu o seu companheiro, e disse: Não é isto outra coisa, senão a espada de Gideão, filho de Joás, varão israelita. Deus tem dado na sua mão aos midianitas, e todo este arraial.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη ὁ πλησίον αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν οὐκ ἔστιν αὕτη ἀλλ' ἢ ῥομφαία Γεδεων υἱοῦ Ιωας ἀνδρὸς Ισραηλ παρέδωκεν κύριος ἐν χειρὶ αὐτοῦ τὴν Μαδιαμ καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν παρεμβολήν

text_en: And when Gedeon had heard the dream , and the interpretation thereof, he adored : and returned to the camp of Israel , and said: Arise, for the Lord has delivered the camp of Madian into our hands.
text_la: Cumque audisset Gedeon somnium, et interpretationem ejus, adoravit : et reversus est ad castra Israël, et ait : Surgite, tradidit enim Dominus in manus nostras castra Madian.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, ouvindo Gideão a narração deste sonho, e a sua explicação, adorou; e voltou ao arraial de Israel, e disse: Levantai-vos, porque o Senhor tem dado o arraial dos midianitas nas nossas mãos.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἤκουσεν Γεδεων τὴν διήγησιν τοῦ ἐνυπνίου καὶ τὴν σύγκρισιν αὐτοῦ καὶ προσεκύνησεν κύριον καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν εἰς τὴν παρεμβολὴν Ισραηλ καὶ εἶπεν ἀνάστητε ὅτι παρέδωκεν κύριος ἐν χερσὶν ὑμῶν τὴν παρεμβολὴν Μαδιαμ

text_en: And he divided the three hundred men into three parts, and gave them trumpets in their hands, and empty pitchers, and lamps within the pitchers.
text_la: Divisitque trecentos viros in tres partes, et dedit tubas in manibus eorum, lagenasque vacuas, ac lampades in medio lagenarum.
text_pt: Então dividiu os trezentos homens em três companhias; e deu-lhes a cada um, nas suas mãos, buzinas, e cântaros vazios, com tochas neles acesas.
text_el: καὶ διεῖλεν τοὺς τριακοσίους ἄνδρας τρεῖς ἀρχὰς καὶ ἔδωκεν κερατίνας ἐν χειρὶ πάντων καὶ ὑδρίας κενὰς καὶ λαμπάδας ἐν μέσῳ τῶν ὑδριῶν

text_en: And he said to them: What you shall see me do, do you the same: I will go into one part of the camp, and do you as I shall do.
text_la: Et dixit ad eos : Quod me facere videritis, hoc facite : ingrediar partem castrorum, et quod fecero, sectamini.
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Olhai para mim, e fazei como eu fizer; e eis que, chegando eu à extremidade do arraial, será que, como eu fizer, assim fareis vós.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς ἀπ' ἐμοῦ ὄψεσθε καὶ οὕτως ποιήσετε καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ εἰσπορεύομαι ἐν μέσῳ τῆς παρεμβολῆς καὶ ἔσται ὡς ἐὰν ποιήσω οὕτως ποιήσετε

text_en: When the trumpet shall sound in my hand, do you also blow the trumpets on every side of the camp, and shout together to the Lord and to Gedeon .
text_la: Quando personuerit tuba in manu mea, vos quoque per castrorum circuitum clangite, et conclamate : Domino et Gedeoni.
text_pt: Tocando eu a buzina, eu e todos os que comigo estiverem, então também vós tocareis a buzina ao redor de todo o arraial, e direis: Espada do Senhor, e de Gideão.
text_el: καὶ σαλπιῶ τῇ κερατίνῃ ἐγὼ καὶ πάντες οἱ μετ' ἐμοῦ καὶ σαλπιεῖτε ταῖς κερατίναις καὶ ὑμεῖς κύκλῳ τῆς παρεμβολῆς καὶ ἐρεῖτε τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ τῷ Γεδεων

text_en: And Gedeon , and the three hundred men that were with him, went into part of the camp, at the beginning of the midnight watch, and the watchmen being alarmed, they began to sound their trumpets, and to clap the pitchers one against another.
text_la: Ingressusque est Gedeon, et trecenti viri qui erant cum eo, in partem castrorum, incipientibus vigiliis noctis mediæ : et custodibus suscitatis, cœperunt buccinis clangere, et complodere inter se lagenas.
text_pt: Chegou, pois, Gideão, e os cem homens que com ele iam, ao extremo do arraial, ao princípio da vigília da meia-noite, havendo sido de pouco trocadas as guardas; então tocaram as buzinas, e quebraram os cântaros, que tinham nas mãos.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν Γεδεων καὶ ἑκατὸν ἄνδρες μετ' αὐτοῦ ἐν μέρει τῆς παρεμβολῆς ἀρχομένης τῆς φυλακῆς τῆς μεσούσης πλὴν ἐγέρσει ἤγειρεν τοὺς φυλάσσοντας καὶ ἐσάλπισαν ταῖς κερατίναις καὶ ἐξετίναξαν τὰς ὑδρίας τὰς ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτῶν

text_en: And when they sounded their trumpets in three places round about the camp, and had broken their pitchers, they held their lamps in their left hands, and with their right hands the trumpets which they blew, and they cried out: The sword of the Lord and of Gedeon :
text_la: Cumque per gyrum castrorum in tribus personarent locis, et hydrias confregissent, tenuerunt sinistris manibus lampades, et dextris sonantes tubas, clamaveruntque : Gladius Domini et Gedeonis:
text_pt: Assim tocaram as três companhias as buzinas, e quebraram os cântaros; e tinham nas suas mãos esquerdas as tochas acesas, e nas suas mãos direitas as buzinas, para tocarem, e clamaram: Espada do Senhor, e de Gideão.
text_el: καὶ ἐσάλπισαν αἱ τρεῖς ἀρχαὶ ἐν ταῖς κερατίναις καὶ συνέτριψαν τὰς ὑδρίας καὶ ἐλάβοντο ἐν τῇ χειρὶ τῇ ἀριστερᾷ αὐτῶν τῶν λαμπάδων καὶ ἐν τῇ χειρὶ τῇ δεξιᾷ αὐτῶν αἱ κερατίναι τοῦ σαλπίζειν καὶ ἀνέκραξαν ῥομφαία τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ τῷ Γεδεων

text_en: Standing every man in his place round about the enemies' camp. So all the camp was troubled, and crying out and howling, they fled away:
text_la: stantes singuli in loco suo per circuitum castrorum hostilium. Omnia itaque castra turbata sunt, et vociferantes ululantesque fugerunt:
text_pt: E conservou-se cada um no seu lugar ao redor do arraial; então todo o exército pôs-se a correr e, gritando, fugiu.
text_el: καὶ ἔστησαν ἕκαστος καθ' ἑαυτὸν κύκλῳ τῆς παρεμβολῆς καὶ ἔδραμον πᾶσα ἡ παρεμβολὴ καὶ ἐσήμαναν καὶ ἔφυγον

text_en: And the three hundred men nevertheless persisted sounding the trumpets. And the Lord sent the sword into all the camp, and they killed one another,
text_la: et nihilominus insistebant trecenti viri buccinis personantes. Immisitque Dominus gladium omnibus castris, et mutua se cæde truncabant,
text_pt: Tocando, pois, os trezentos as buzinas, o Senhor tornou a espada de um contra o outro, e isto em todo o arraial, que fugiu para Zererá, até Bete-Sita, até aos limites de Abel-Meolá, acima de Tabate.
text_el: καὶ ἐσάλπισαν αἱ τριακόσιαι κερατίναι καὶ ἔθετο κύριος μάχαιραν ἀνδρὸς ἐν τῷ πλησίον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ παρεμβολῇ καὶ ἔφυγεν ἡ παρεμβολὴ ἕως τῆς Βαιθασεττα καὶ συνηγμένη ἕως χείλους Αβελμεουλα καὶ ἐπὶ Ταβαθ

text_en: fleeing as far as Bethsetta, and the border of Abelmahula , in Tebbath. But the men of Israel , shouting from Nephthali , and Aser , and from all Manasses , pursued after Madian .
text_la: fugientes usque ad Bethsetta, et crepidinem Abelmehula in Tebbath. Conclamantes autem viri Israël de Nephthali, et Aser, et omni Manasse, persequebantur Madian.
text_pt: Então os homens de Israel, de Naftali, de Aser e de todo o Manassés foram convocados, e perseguiram aos midianitas.
text_el: καὶ ἐβόησεν ἀνὴρ Ισραηλ ἐκ Νεφθαλιμ καὶ ἐξ Ασηρ καὶ ἐκ παντὸς Μανασση καὶ κατεδίωξαν ὀπίσω Μαδιαμ

text_en: And Gedeon sent messengers into all Mount Ephraim, saying: Come down to meet Madian , and take the waters before them to Bethbera and the Jordan . And all Ephraim shouted, and took the waters before them and the Jordan as far as Bethbera.
text_la: Misitque Gedeon nuntios in omnem montem Ephraim, dicens : Descendite in occursum Madian, et occupate aquas usque Bethbera atque Jordanem. Clamavitque omnis Ephraim, et præoccupavit aquas atque Jordanem usque Bethbera.
text_pt: Também Gideão enviou mensageiros a todas as montanhas de Efraim, dizendo: Descei ao encontro dos midianitas, e tomai-lhes as águas até Bete-Bara, e também o Jordão. Convocados, pois, todos os homens de Efraim, tomaram-lhes as águas até Bete-Bara e o Jordão.
text_el: καὶ ἀγγέλους ἐξαπέστειλεν Γεδεων ἐν παντὶ ὁρίῳ Εφραιμ λέγων κατάβητε εἰς συνάντησιν Μαδιαμ καὶ καταλάβετε ἑαυτοῖς τὸ ὕδωρ ἕως Βαιθβηρα καὶ τὸν Ιορδάνην καὶ ἐβόησεν πᾶς ἀνὴρ Εφραιμ καὶ προκατελάβοντο τὸ ὕδωρ ἕως Βαιθβηρα καὶ τὸν Ιορδάνην

text_en: And having taken two men of Madian , Oreb and Zeb: Oreb they slew in the rock of Oreb, and Zeb in the winepress of Zeb. And they pursued Madian , carrying the heads of Oreb and Zeb to Gedeon , beyond the waters of the Jordan .
text_la: Apprehensosque duos viros Madian, Oreb et Zeb, interfecit Oreb in petra Oreb, Zeb vero in torculari Zeb. Et persecuti sunt Madian, capita Oreb et Zeb portantes ad Gedeon trans fluenta Jordanis.
text_pt: E prenderam a dois príncipes dos midianitas, a Orebe e a Zeebe; e mataram a Orebe na penha de Orebe, e a Zeebe mataram no lagar de Zeebe, e perseguiram aos midianitas; e trouxeram as cabeças de Orebe e de Zeebe a Gideão, além do Jordão.
text_el: καὶ συνέλαβον τοὺς δύο ἄρχοντας Μαδιαμ τὸν Ωρηβ καὶ τὸν Ζηβ καὶ ἀπέκτειναν τὸν Ωρηβ ἐν Σουριν καὶ τὸν Ζηβ ἀπέκτειναν ἐν Ιακεφζηβ καὶ κατεδίωξαν Μαδιαμ καὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν Ωρηβ καὶ Ζηβ ἤνεγκαν πρὸς Γεδεων ἐκ τοῦ πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου

text_en: And the men of Ephraim said to him: What is this that you mean to do, that you would not call us, when you went to fight against Madian ? And they chid him sharply, and almost offered violence .
text_la: Dixeruntque ad eum viri Ephraim : Quid est hoc quod facere voluisti, ut nos non vocares, cum ad pugnam pergeres contra Madian? jurgantes fortiter, et prope vim inferentes.
text_pt: Então os homens de Efraim lhe disseram: Que é isto que nos fizeste, que não nos chamaste, quando foste pelejar contra os midianitas? E contenderam com ele fortemente.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτὸν ἀνὴρ Εφραιμ τί τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο ἐποίησας ἡμῖν τοῦ μὴ καλέσαι ἡμᾶς ὅτε ἐξεπορεύου πολεμῆσαι ἐν τῇ Μαδιαμ καὶ ἐκρίνοντο μετ' αὐτοῦ κραταιῶς

text_en: And he answered them: What could I have done like to that which you have done? Is not one bunch of grapes of Ephraim better than the vintages of Abiezer?
text_la: Quibus ille respondit : Quod enim tale facere potui, quale vos fecistis? nonne melior est racemus Ephraim, vindemiis Abiezer?
text_pt: Porém ele lhes disse: Que mais fiz eu agora do que vós? Não são porventura os rabiscos de Efraim melhores do que a vindima de Abiezer?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς τί ἐποίησα νῦν καθὼς ὑμεῖς οὐχὶ κρείττω ἐπιφυλλίδες Εφραιμ ἢ τρυγητὸς Αβιεζερ

text_en: The Lord has delivered into your hands the princes of Madian , Oreb and Zeb: what could I have done like to what you have done? And when he had said this, their spirit was appeased, with which they swelled against him.
text_la: In manus vestras Dominus tradidit principes Madian, Oreb et Zeb : quid tale facere potui, quale vos fecistis? Quod cum locutus esset, requievit spiritus eorum, quo tumebant contra eum.
text_pt: Deus vos deu na vossa mão os príncipes dos midianitas, Orebe e Zeebe; que mais pude eu fazer do que vós? Então a sua ira se abrandou para com ele, quando falou esta palavra.
text_el: ἐν χειρὶ ὑμῶν παρέδωκεν κύριος τοὺς ἄρχοντας Μαδιαμ τὸν Ωρηβ καὶ τὸν Ζηβ καὶ τί ἠδυνάσθην ποιῆσαι καθὼς ὑμεῖς καὶ κατέπαυσαν τότε ἀνῆκε τὸ πνεῦμα αὐτῶν ἀπ' αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ λαλῆσαι αὐτὸν τὸν λόγον τοῦτον

text_en: And when Gedeon had come to the Jordan , he passed over it with the three hundred men that were with him: who were so weary that they could not pursue after them that fled.
text_la: Cumque venisset Gedeon ad Jordanem, transivit eum cum trecentis viris, qui secum erant : et præ lassitudine, fugientes persequi non poterant.
text_pt: E, como Gideão veio ao Jordão, passou com os trezentos homens que com ele estavam, já cansados, mas ainda perseguindo.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν Γεδεων ἐπὶ τὸν Ιορδάνην καὶ διέβη αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ τριακόσιοι ἄνδρες μετ' αὐτοῦ ὀλιγοψυχοῦντες καὶ πεινῶντες

text_en: And he said to the men of Soccoth: Give, I beseech you, bread to the people that is with me, for they are faint: that we may pursue Zebee, and Salmana, the kings of Madian .
text_la: Dixitque ad viros Soccoth : Date, obsecro, panes populo qui mecum est, quia valde defecerunt : ut possimus persequi Zebee et Salmana reges Madian.
text_pt: E disse aos homens de Sucote: Dai, peço-vos, alguns pedaços de pão ao povo, que segue as minhas pisadas; porque estão cansados, e eu vou ao encalço de Zeba e Salmuna, reis dos midianitas.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν τοῖς ἀνδράσιν Σοκχωθ δότε δὴ ἄρτους τῷ λαῷ τῷ μετ' ἐμοῦ ὅτι πεινῶσιν ἐγὼ δὲ διώκω ὀπίσω Ζεβεε καὶ Σαλμανα βασιλέων Μαδιαμ

text_en: The princes of Soccoth answered: Peradventure the palms of the hands of Zebee and Salmana are in your hand, and therefore you demand that we should give bread to your army.
text_la: Responderunt principes Soccoth : Forsitan palmæ manuum Zebee et Salmana in manu tua sunt, et idcirco postulas ut demus exercitui tuo panes.
text_pt: Porém os príncipes de Sucote disseram: Estão já, Zeba e Salmuna, em tua mão, para que demos pão ao teu exército?
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν οἱ ἄρχοντες Σοκχωθ μὴ χεὶρ Ζεβεε καὶ Σαλμανα νῦν ἐν τῇ χειρί σου ὅτι δώσομεν τῇ στρατιᾷ σου ἄρτους

text_en: And he said to them: When the Lord therefore shall have delivered Zebee and Salmana into my hands, I will thresh your flesh with the thorns and briers of the desert .
text_la: Quibus ille ait : Cum ergo tradiderit Dominus Zebee et Salmana in manus meas, conteram carnes vestras cum spinis tribulisque deserti.
text_pt: Então disse Gideão: Pois quando o Senhor der na minha mão a Zeba e a Salmuna, trilharei a vossa carne com os espinhos do deserto, e com os abrolhos.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Γεδεων οὐχ οὕτως ἐν τῷ δοῦναι κύριον τὸν Ζεβεε καὶ Σαλμανα ἐν τῇ χειρί μου καὶ καταξανῶ τὰς σάρκας ὑμῶν ἐν ταῖς ἀκάνθαις τῆς ἐρήμου καὶ ἐν ταῖς βαρκοννιμ

text_en: And going up from thence, he came to Phanuel: and he spoke the like things to the men of that place. And they also answered him, as the men of Soccoth had answered.
text_la: Et inde conscendens, venit in Phanuel : locutusque est ad viros loci illius similia. Cui et illi responderunt, sicut responderant viri Soccoth.
text_pt: E dali subiu a Penuel, e falou-lhes da mesma maneira; e os homens de Penuel lhe responderam como os homens de Sucote lhe haviam respondido.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβη ἐκεῖθεν εἰς Φανουηλ καὶ ἐλάλησεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς κατὰ ταῦτα καὶ ἀπεκρίθησαν αὐτῷ οἱ ἄνδρες Φανουηλ ὃν τρόπον ἀπεκρίθησαν αὐτῷ οἱ ἄνδρες Σοκχωθ

text_en: He said, therefore, to them also: When I shall return a conqueror in peace, I will destroy this tower.
text_la: Dixit itaque et eis : Cum reversus fuero victor in pace, destruam turrim hanc.
text_pt: Por isso também falou aos homens de Penuel, dizendo: Quando eu voltar em paz, derribarei esta torre.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν τοῖς ἀνδράσιν Φανουηλ λέγων ἐν τῷ ἐπιστρέφειν με μετ' εἰρήνης κατασκάψω τὸν πύργον τοῦτον

text_en: But Zebee and Salmana were resting with all their army. For fifteen thousand men were left of all the troops of the eastern people, and one hundred and twenty thousand warriors that drew the sword were slain.
text_la: Zebee autem et Salmana requiescebant cum omni exercitu suo. Quindecim enim millia viri remanserant ex omnibus turmis orientalium populorum, cæsis centum viginti millibus bellatorum educentium gladium.
text_pt: Estavam, pois, Zeba e Salmuna em Carcor, e os seus exércitos com eles, uns quinze mil homens, todos os que restaram do exército dos filhos do oriente; e os que caíram foram cento e vinte mil homens, que puxavam da espada.
text_el: καὶ Ζεβεε καὶ Σαλμανα ἐν Καρκαρ καὶ ἡ παρεμβολὴ αὐτῶν μετ' αὐτῶν ὡσεὶ πεντεκαίδεκα χιλιάδες οἱ καταλειφθέντες ἐν πάσῃ παρεμβολῇ υἱῶν ἀνατολῶν καὶ οἱ πεπτωκότες ἦσαν ἑκατὸν καὶ εἴκοσι χιλιάδες ἀνδρῶν ἐσπασμένων ῥομφαίαν

text_en: And Gedeon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents, on the east of Nobe and Jegbaa, and smote the camp of the enemies, who were secure, and suspected no hurt.
text_la: Ascendensque Gedeon per viam eorum, qui in tabernaculis morabantur, ad orientalem partem Nobe et Jegbaa, percussit castra hostium, qui securi erant, et nihil adversi suspicabantur.
text_pt: E subiu Gideão pelo caminho dos que habitavam em tendas, para o oriente de Nobá e Jogbeá; e feriu aquele exército, porquanto o exército estava descuidado.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβη Γεδεων ὁδὸν κατοικούντων ἐν σκηναῖς ἀνατολῶν τῆς Ναβεθ ἐξ ἐναντίας Ζεβεε καὶ ἐπάταξεν τὴν παρεμβολήν ἡ δὲ παρεμβολὴ ἦν πεποιθυῖα

text_en: And Zebee and Salmana fled, and Gedeon pursued and took them, all their host being put in confusion.
text_la: Fugeruntque Zebee et Salmana, quos persequens Gedeon comprehendit, turbato omni exercitu eorum.
text_pt: E fugiram Zeba e Salmuna; porém ele os perseguiu, e tomou presos a ambos os reis dos midianitas, a Zeba e a Salmuna, e afugentou a todo o exército.
text_el: καὶ ἔφυγεν Ζεβεε καὶ Σαλμανα καὶ ἐδίωξεν ὀπίσω αὐτῶν καὶ ἐκράτησεν τοὺς δύο βασιλεῖς Μαδιαμ τὸν Ζεβεε καὶ τὸν Σαλμανα καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν παρεμβολὴν αὐτῶν ἐξέτριψεν

text_en: And returning from the battle before the sun rising,
text_la: Revertensque de bello ante solis ortum,
text_pt: Voltando, pois, Gideão, filho de Joás, da peleja, antes do nascer do sol,
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστρεψεν Γεδεων υἱὸς Ιωας ἐκ τοῦ πολέμου ἀπὸ ἀναβάσεως Αρες

text_en: he took a boy of the men of Soccoth: and he asked him the names of the princes and ancients of Soccoth, and he described unto him seventy-seven men .
text_la: apprehendit puerum de viris Soccoth : interrogavitque eum nomina principum et seniorum Soccoth, et descripsit septuaginta septem viros.
text_pt: Tomou preso a um moço dos homens de Sucote, e lhe fez perguntas; o qual lhe deu por escrito os nomes dos príncipes de Sucote, e dos seus anciãos, setenta e sete homens.
text_el: καὶ συνέλαβον παιδάριον ἐκ τῶν ἀνδρῶν Σοκχωθ καὶ ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτόν καὶ ἀπεγράψατο πρὸς αὐτοὺς τοὺς ἄρχοντας Σοκχωθ καὶ τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους αὐτῆς ἑβδομήκοντα ἑπτὰ ἄνδρας

text_en: And he came to Soccoth, and said to them: Behold Zebee, and Salmana, concerning whom you upbraided me, saying: Peradventure the hands of Zebee and Salmana are in your hands, and therefore you demand that we should give bread to the men that are weary and faint.
text_la: Venitque ad Soccoth, et dixit eis : En Zebee et Salmana, super quibus exprobrastis mihi, dicentes : Forsitan manus Zebee et Salmana in manibus tuis sunt, et idcirco postulas ut demus viris, qui lassi sunt et defecerunt, panes.
text_pt: Então veio aos homens de Sucote, e disse: Vede aqui a Zeba e a Salmuna, a respeito dos quais desprezivelmente me escarnecestes, dizendo: Estão já, Zeba e Salmuna, na tua mão, para que demos pão aos teus homens, já cansados?
text_el: καὶ παρεγένετο Γεδεων πρὸς τοὺς ἄρχοντας Σοκχωθ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ἰδοὺ Ζεβεε καὶ Σαλμανα δι' οὓς ὠνειδίσατέ με λέγοντες μὴ χεὶρ Ζεβεε καὶ Σαλμανα νῦν ἐν τῇ χειρί σου ὅτι δώσομεν τοῖς ἀνδράσιν σου τοῖς ἐκλελυμένοις ἄρτους

text_en: So he took the ancients of the city, and thorns and briers of the desert , and tore them with the same, and cut in pieces the men of Soccoth.
text_la: Tulit ergo seniores civitatis et spinas deserti ac tribulos, et contrivit cum eis atque comminuit viros Soccoth.
text_pt: E tomou os anciãos daquela cidade, e os espinhos do deserto, e os abrolhos; e com eles ensinou aos homens de Sucote.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν τοὺς ἄρχοντας καὶ τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους τῆς πόλεως καὶ κατέξανεν αὐτοὺς ἐν ταῖς ἀκάνθαις τῆς ἐρήμου καὶ ταῖς βαρακηνιμ καὶ κατέξανεν ἐν αὐτοῖς ἄνδρας Σοκχωθ

text_en: And he demolished the tower of Phanuel, and slew the men of the city.
text_la: Turrim quoque Phanuel subvertit, occisis habitatoribus civitatis.
text_pt: E derrubou a torre de Penuel, e matou os homens da cidade.
text_el: καὶ τὸν πύργον Φανουηλ κατέσκαψεν καὶ ἀπέκτεινεν τοὺς ἄνδρας τῆς πόλεως

text_en: And he said to Zebee and Salmana: What manner of men were they, whom you slew in Thabor ? They answered: They were like you, and one of them as the son of a king.
text_la: Dixitque ad Zebee et Salmana : Quales fuerunt viri, quos occidistis in Thabor? Qui responderunt : Similes tui, et unus ex eis quasi filius regis.
text_pt: Depois perguntou a Zeba e a Salmuna: Que homens eram os que matastes em Tabor? E disseram: Como és tu, assim eram eles; cada um parecia filho de rei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς Ζεβεε καὶ Σαλμανα ποῦ οἱ ἄνδρες οὓς ἀπεκτείνατε ἐν Θαβωρ καὶ εἶπαν ὡσεὶ σύ ὅμοιος σοί ὅμοιος αὐτῶν ὡς εἶδος μορφὴ υἱῶν βασιλέων

text_en: He answered them: They were my brethren, the sons of my mother. As the Lord lives, if you had saved them, I would not kill you.
text_la: Quibus ille respondit : Fratres mei fuerunt, filii matris meæ. Vivit Dominus, quia si servassetis eos, non vos occiderem.
text_pt: Então disse ele: Meus irmãos eram, filhos de minha mãe; vive o Senhor, que, se os tivésseis deixado com vida, eu não vos mataria.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Γεδεων ἀδελφοί μου καὶ υἱοὶ τῆς μητρός μού εἰσιν καὶ ὤμοσεν αὐτοῖς ζῇ κύριος εἰ ἐζωογονήσατε αὐτούς οὐκ ἂν ἀπέκτεινα ὑμᾶς

text_en: And he said to Jether, his eldest son: Arise, and slay them. But he drew not his sword: for he was afraid, being but yet a boy.
text_la: Dixitque Jether primogenito suo : Surge, et interfice eos. Qui non eduxit gladium : timebat enim, quia adhuc puer erat.
text_pt: E disse a Jeter, seu primogênito: Levanta-te, mata-os. Porém o moço não puxou da sua espada, porque temia; porquanto ainda era jovem.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν τῷ Ιεθερ τῷ πρωτοτόκῳ αὐτοῦ ἀναστὰς ἀπόκτεινον αὐτούς καὶ οὐκ ἔσπασεν τὸ παιδάριον αὐτοῦ τὴν μάχαιραν αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἐφοβήθη ὅτι ἦν νεώτερος

text_en: And Zebee and Salmana said: Rise and run upon us: because the strength of a man is according to his age: Gedeon rose up, and slew Zebee and Salmana: and he took the ornaments and bosses, with which the necks of the camels of kings are wont to be adorned.
text_la: Dixeruntque Zebee et Salmana : Tu surge, et irrue in nos : quia juxta ætatem robur est hominis. Surrexit Gedeon, et interfecit Zebee et Salmana : et tulit ornamenta ac bullas quibus colla regalium camelorum decorari solent.
text_pt: Então disseram Zeba e Salmuna: Levanta-te, e acomete-nos; porque, qual o homem, tal a sua valentia. Levantou-se, pois, Gideão, e matou a Zeba e a Salmuna, e tomou os ornamentos que estavam nos pescoços dos seus camelos.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ζεβεε καὶ Σαλμανα ἀνάστα δὴ σὺ καὶ ἀπάντησον ἡμῖν ὅτι ὡς ἀνὴρ ἡ δύναμις αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀνέστη Γεδεων καὶ ἀνεῖλεν τὸν Ζεβεε καὶ τὸν Σαλμανα καὶ ἔλαβεν τοὺς μηνίσκους τοὺς ἐν τοῖς τραχήλοις τῶν καμήλων αὐτῶν

text_en: And all the men of Israel said to Gedeon : Rule over us, and your son, and your son's son: because you have delivered us from the hand of Madian .
text_la: Dixeruntque omnes viri Israël ad Gedeon : Dominare nostri tu, et filius tuus, et filius filii tui : quia liberasti nos de manu Madian.
text_pt: Então os homens de Israel disseram a Gideão: Domina sobre nós, tanto tu, como teu filho e o filho de teu filho; porquanto nos livraste da mão dos midianitas.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ἀνὴρ Ισραηλ πρὸς Γεδεων ἄρχε ἐν ἡμῖν σὺ καὶ οἱ υἱοί σου ὅτι σέσωκας ἡμᾶς ἐκ χειρὸς Μαδιαμ

text_en: And he said to them: I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you, but the Lord shall rule over you.
text_la: Quibus ille ait : Non dominabor vestri, nec dominabitur in vos filius meus, sed dominabitur vobis Dominus.
text_pt: Porém Gideão lhes disse: Sobre vós eu não dominarei, nem tampouco meu filho sobre vós dominará; o Senhor sobre vós dominará.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς Γεδεων οὐκ ἄρξω ἐγὼ ὑμῶν καὶ οὐκ ἄρξει ὁ υἱός μου ὑμῶν κύριος ἄρξει ὑμῶν

text_en: And he said to them: I desire one request of you: Give me the earlets of your spoils. For the Ismaelites were accustomed to wear golden earlets.
text_la: Dixitque ad eos : Unam petitionem postulo a vobis : date mihi inaures ex præda vestra. Inaures enim aureas Ismaëlitæ habere consueverant.
text_pt: E disse-lhes mais Gideão: Uma petição vos farei: Dá-me, cada um de vós, os pendentes do seu despojo (porque tinham pendentes de ouro, porquanto eram ismaelitas).
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς Γεδεων αἰτήσομαι παρ' ὑμῶν αἴτησιν καὶ δότε μοι ἀνὴρ ἐνώτιον τῶν σκύλων αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἐνώτια χρυσᾶ πολλὰ ἦν αὐτοῖς ὅτι Ισμαηλῖται ἦσαν

text_en: They answered: We will give them most willingly. And spreading a mantle on the ground, they cast upon it the earlets of the spoils.
text_la: Qui responderunt : Libentissime dabimus. Expandentesque super terram pallium, projecerunt in eo inaures de præda:
text_pt: E disseram eles: De boa vontade os daremos. E estenderam uma capa, e cada um deles deitou ali um pendente do seu despojo.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν διδόντες δώσομεν καὶ ἀνέπτυξεν τὸ ἱμάτιον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔρριψεν ἐκεῖ ἀνὴρ ἐνώτιον χρυσοῦν τῶν σκύλων αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the weight of the earlets that he requested, was a thousand seven hundred sicles of gold, besides the ornaments, and jewels, and purple raiment, which the kings of Madian were wont to use, and besides the golden chains that were about the camels necks.
text_la: et fuit pondus postulatarum inaurium, mille septingenti auri sicli, absque ornamentis, et monilibus, et veste purpurea, quibus reges Madian uti soliti erant, et præter torques aureas camelorum.
text_pt: E foi o peso dos pendentes de ouro, que pediu, mil e setecentos siclos de ouro, afora os ornamentos, e as cadeias, e as vestes de púrpura que traziam os reis dos midianitas, e afora as coleiras que os camelos traziam ao pescoço.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη ὁ σταθμὸς τῶν ἐνωτίων τῶν χρυσῶν ὧν ᾐτήσατο σίκλοι χίλιοι καὶ ἑπτακόσιοι χρυσοῦ πλὴν τῶν σιρώνων καὶ τῶν ὁρμίσκων ενφωθ καὶ τῶν περιβολαίων τῶν πορφυρῶν τῶν ἐπὶ τοῖς βασιλεῦσιν Μαδιαμ καὶ πλὴν τῶν κλοιῶν τῶν χρυσῶν τῶν ἐν τοῖς τραχήλοις τῶν καμήλων αὐτῶν

text_en: And Gedeon made an ephod thereof, and put it in his city Ephra. And all Israel committed fornication with it, and it became a ruin to Gedeon , and to all his house.
text_la: Fecitque ex eo Gedeon ephod, et posuit illud in civitate sua Ephra. Fornicatusque est omnis Israël in eo, et factum est Gedeoni et omni domui ejus in ruinam.
text_pt: E fez Gideão dele um éfode, e colocou-o na sua cidade, em Ofra; e todo o Israel prostituiu-se ali após ele; e foi por tropeço a Gideão e à sua casa.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν αὐτὸ Γεδεων εἰς εφουδ καὶ ἔστησεν αὐτὸ ἐν πόλει αὐτοῦ ἐν Εφραθα καὶ ἐξεπόρνευσεν πᾶς Ισραηλ ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ ἐκεῖ καὶ ἐγένετο τῷ Γεδεων καὶ τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ εἰς σκάνδαλον

text_en: But Madian was humbled before the children of Israel , neither could they any more lift up their heads: but the land rested for forty years, while Gedeon presided.
text_la: Humiliatus est autem Madian coram filiis Israël, nec potuerunt ultra cervices elevare : sed quievit terra per quadraginta annos, quibus Gedeon præfuit.
text_pt: Assim foram abatidos os midianitas diante dos filhos de Israel, e nunca mais levantaram a sua cabeça; e sossegou a terra quarenta anos nos dias de Gideão.
text_el: καὶ ἐνετράπη Μαδιαμ ἐνώπιον υἱῶν Ισραηλ καὶ οὐ προσέθεντο ἆραι κεφαλὴν αὐτῶν καὶ ἡσύχασεν ἡ γῆ ἔτη τεσσαράκοντα ἐν ἡμέραις Γεδεων

text_en: So Jerobaal, the son of Joas , went and dwelt in his own house:
text_la: Abiit itaque Jerobaal filius Joas, et habitavit in domo sua:
text_pt: E foi Jerubaal, filho de Joás, e habitou em sua casa.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθη Ιεροβααλ υἱὸς Ιωας καὶ κατῴκησεν ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he had seventy sons, who came out of his thigh, for he had many wives.
text_la: habuitque septuaginta filios, qui egressi sunt de femore ejus : eo quod plures haberet uxores.
text_pt: E teve Gideão setenta filhos, que procederam dele, porque tinha muitas mulheres.
text_el: καὶ τῷ Γεδεων ἦσαν ἑβδομήκοντα υἱοὶ ἐκπορευόμενοι ἐκ μηρῶν αὐτοῦ ὅτι γυναῖκες πολλαὶ ἦσαν αὐτῷ

text_en: And his concubine , that he had in Sichem , bore him a son, whose name was Abimelech.
text_la: Concubina autem illius, quam habebat in Sichem, genuit ei filium nomine Abimelech.
text_pt: E sua concubina, que estava em Siquém, lhe deu à luz também um filho; e pôs-lhe por nome Abimeleque.
text_el: καὶ ἡ παλλακὴ αὐτοῦ ἡ ἐν Σικιμοις ἔτεκεν αὐτῷ καί γε αὐτὴ υἱόν καὶ ἐπέθηκεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Αβιμελεχ

text_en: And Gedeon, the son of Joas died in a good old age, and was buried in the sepulchre of his father, in Ephra, of the family of Ezri.
text_la: Mortuusque est Gedeon filius Joas in senectute bona, et sepultus est in sepulchro Joas patris sui in Ephra de familia Ezri.
text_pt: E faleceu Gideão, filho de Joás, numa boa velhice; e foi sepultado no sepulcro de seu pai Joás, em Ofra dos abiezritas.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέθανεν Γεδεων υἱὸς Ιωας ἐν πολιᾷ ἀγαθῇ καὶ ἐτάφη ἐν τῷ τάφῳ Ιωας τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ ἐν Εφραθα πατρὸς Αβιεζρι

text_en: But after Gedeon was dead, the children of Israel turned again, and committed fornication with Baalim . And they made a covenant with Baal , that he should be their god :
text_la: Postquam autem mortuus est Gedeon, aversi sunt filii Israël, et fornicati sunt cum Baalim. Percusseruntque cum Baal fœdus, ut esset eis in deum:
text_pt: E sucedeu que, como Gideão faleceu, os filhos de Israel tornaram a se prostituir após os baalins; e puseram a Baal-Berite por deus.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη ὡς ἀπέθανεν Γεδεων καὶ ἀπεστράφησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ καὶ ἐξεπόρνευσαν ὀπίσω τῶν Βααλιμ καὶ ἔθεντο αὑτοῖς τὸν Βααλβεριθ εἰς διαθήκην τοῦ εἶναι αὐτοῖς αὐτὸν εἰς θεόν

text_en: And they remembered not the Lord their God , who delivered them out of the hands of all their enemies round about:
text_la: nec recordati sunt Domini Dei sui, qui eruit eos de manibus inimicorum suorum omnium per circuitum:
text_pt: E assim os filhos de Israel não se lembraram do Senhor seu Deus, que os livrara da mão de todos os seus inimigos ao redor.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἐμνήσθησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ αὐτῶν τοῦ ῥυσαμένου αὐτοὺς ἐκ χειρὸς πάντων τῶν ἐχθρῶν αὐτῶν κυκλόθεν

text_en: Neither did they show mercy to the house of Jerobaal Gedeon , according to all the good things he had done to Israel .
text_la: nec fecerunt misericordiam cum domo Jerobaal Gedeon, juxta omnia bona quæ fecerat Israëli.
text_pt: Nem usaram de beneficência com a casa de Jerubaal, a saber, de Gideão, conforme a todo o bem que ele havia feito a Israel.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἐποίησαν ἔλεος μετὰ τοῦ οἴκου Ιεροβααλ Γεδεων κατὰ πᾶσαν τὴν ἀγαθωσύνην ἣν ἐποίησεν μετὰ Ισραηλ

text_en: And Abimelech, the son of Jerobaal , went to Sichem , to his mother's brethren, and spoke to them, and to all the kindred of his mother's father, saying:
text_la: Abiit autem Abimelech filius Jerobaal in Sichem ad fratres matris suæ, et locutus est ad eos, et ad omnem cognationem domus patris matris suæ, dicens:
text_pt: E Abimeleque, filho de Jerubaal, foi a Siquém, aos irmãos de sua mãe, e falou-lhes e a toda a geração da casa do pai de sua mãe, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθη Αβιμελεχ υἱὸς Ιεροβααλ εἰς Σικιμα πρὸς τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐλάλησεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς καὶ πρὸς πᾶσαν τὴν συγγένειαν τοῦ οἴκου τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ λέγων

text_en: Speak to all the men of Sichem : whether is better for you that seventy men , all the sons of Jerobaal , should rule over you, or that one man should rule over you? And withal, consider that I am your bone, and your flesh.
text_la: Loquimini ad omnes viros Sichem : Quid vobis est melius, ut dominentur vestri septuaginta viri omnes filii Jerobaal, an ut dominetur unus vir? simulque considerate quod os vestrum et caro vestra sum.
text_pt: Falai, peço-vos, aos ouvidos de todos os cidadãos de Siquém: Qual é melhor para vós, que setenta homens, todos os filhos de Jerubaal, dominem sobre vós, ou que um homem sobre vós domine? Lembrai-vos também de que sou osso vosso e carne vossa.
text_el: λαλήσατε δὴ ἐν ὠσὶν τῶν ἀνδρῶν Σικιμων ποῖον βέλτιόν ἐστιν τὸ ἄρχειν ὑμῶν ἑβδομήκοντα ἄνδρας πάντας υἱοὺς Ιεροβααλ ἢ κυριεύειν ὑμῶν ἄνδρα ἕνα καὶ μνήσθητε ὅτι σὰρξ ὑμῶν καὶ ὀστοῦν ὑμῶν ἐγώ εἰμι

text_en: And his mother's brethren spoke of him to all the men of Sichem , all these words, and they inclined their hearts after Abimelech, saying: He is our brother:
text_la: Locutique sunt fratres matris ejus de eo ad omnes viros Sichem universos sermones istos, et inclinaverunt cor eorum post Abimelech, dicentes : Frater noster est.
text_pt: Então os irmãos de sua mãe falaram acerca dele perante os ouvidos de todos os cidadãos de Siquém todas aquelas palavras; e o coração deles se inclinou a seguir Abimeleque, porque disseram: É nosso irmão.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησαν περὶ αὐτοῦ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ ἐν τοῖς ὠσὶν πάντων τῶν ἀνδρῶν Σικιμων πάντας τοὺς λόγους τούτους καὶ ἔκλινεν καρδία αὐτῶν ὀπίσω Αβιμελεχ ὅτι εἶπαν ἀδελφὸς ἡμῶν ἐστιν

text_en: And they gave him seventy weight of silver out of the temple of Baalberith: wherewith he hired to himself men that were needy , and vagabonds, and they followed him.
text_la: Dederuntque illi septuaginta pondo argenti de fano Baalberit. Qui conduxit sibi ex eo viros inopes et vagos, secutique sunt eum.
text_pt: E deram-lhe setenta peças de prata, da casa de Baal-Berite; e com elas alugou Abimeleque uns homens ociosos e levianos, que o seguiram.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκαν αὐτῷ ἑβδομήκοντα ἀργυρίου ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου Βααλ διαθήκης καὶ ἐμισθώσατο ἐν αὐτοῖς Αβιμελεχ ἄνδρας κενοὺς καὶ θαμβουμένους καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he came to his father's house in Ephra, and slew his brethren, the sons of Jerobaal , seventy men , upon one stone: and there remained only Joatham, the youngest son of Jerobaal , who was hidden.
text_la: Et venit in domum patris sui in Ephra, et occidit fratres suos filios Jerobaal, septuaginta viros super lapidem unum : remansitque Joatham filius Jerobaal minimus, et absconditus est.
text_pt: E veio à casa de seu pai, a Ofra, e matou a seus irmãos, os filhos de Jerubaal, setenta homens, sobre uma pedra. Porém Jotão, filho menor de Jerubaal, ficou, porque se tinha escondido.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ εἰς Εφραθα καὶ ἀπέκτεινεν τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ υἱοὺς Ιεροβααλ ἑβδομήκοντα ἄνδρας ἐπὶ λίθον ἕνα καὶ ἀπελείφθη Ιωαθαμ υἱὸς Ιεροβααλ ὁ νεώτερος ὅτι ἐκρύβη

text_en: And all the men of Sichem were gathered together, and all the families of the city of Mello: and they went and made Abimelech king, by the oak that stood in Sichem .
text_la: Congregati sunt autem omnes viri Sichem, et universæ familiæ urbis Mello : abieruntque et constituerunt regem Abimelech, juxta quercum quæ stabat in Sichem.
text_pt: Então se ajuntaram todos os cidadãos de Siquém, e toda a casa de Milo; e foram, e constituíram a Abimeleque rei, junto ao carvalho alto que está perto de Siquém.
text_el: καὶ συνήχθησαν πάντες οἱ ἄνδρες Σικιμων καὶ πᾶς ὁ οἶκος Μααλλων καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν καὶ ἐβασίλευσαν τὸν Αβιμελεχ εἰς βασιλέα πρὸς τῇ βαλάνῳ τῆς στάσεως ἐν Σικιμοις

text_en: This being told to Joatham, he went, and stood on the top of Mount Garizim: and lifting up his voice, he cried, and said: Hear me, you men of Sichem , so may God hear you.
text_la: Quod cum nuntiatum esset Joatham, ivit, et stetit in vertice montis Garizim : elevataque voce, clamavit, et dixit : Audite me, viri Sichem; ita audiat vos Deus.
text_pt: E, dizendo-o a Jotão, foi e pôs-se no cume do monte de Gerizim, e levantou a sua voz, e clamou e disse-lhes: Ouvi-me, cidadãos de Siquém, e Deus vos ouvirá a vós;
text_el: καὶ ἀνήγγειλαν τῷ Ιωαθαμ καὶ ἐπορεύθη καὶ ἔστη ἐπὶ τῆς κορυφῆς τοῦ ὄρους Γαριζιν καὶ ἐπῆρεν τὴν φωνὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐκάλεσεν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ἀκούσατέ μου ἄνδρες Σικιμων καὶ ἀκούσαι ὑμῶν ὁ θεός

text_en: The trees went to anoint a king over them: and they said to the olive tree: Reign over us.
text_la: Ierunt ligna, ut ungerent super se regem : dixeruntque olivæ : Impera nobis.
text_pt: Foram uma vez as árvores a ungir para si um rei, e disseram à oliveira: Reina tu sobre nós.
text_el: πορευόμενα ἐπορεύθησαν τὰ ξύλα τοῦ χρῖσαι ἑαυτοῖς βασιλέα καὶ εἶπον τῇ ἐλαίᾳ βασίλευσον ἐφ' ἡμῶν

text_en: And it answered: Can I leave my fatness, which both gods and men make use of, to come to be promoted among the trees?
text_la: Quæ respondit : Numquid possum deserere pinguedinem meam, qua et dii utuntur et homines, et venire ut inter ligna promovear?
text_pt: Porém a oliveira lhes disse: Deixaria eu a minha gordura, que Deus e os homens em mim prezam, e iria pairar sobre as árvores?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ἡ ἐλαία ἀφεῖσα τὴν πιότητά μου ἣν ἐν ἐμοὶ ἐδόξασεν ὁ θεὸς καὶ ἄνθρωποι πορευθῶ ἄρχειν τῶν ξύλων

text_en: And the trees said to the fig tree: Come and reign over us.
text_la: Dixeruntque ligna ad arborem ficum : Veni, et super nos regnum accipe.
text_pt: Então disseram as árvores à figueira: Vem tu, e reina sobre nós.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν τὰ ξύλα τῇ συκῇ δεῦρο βασίλευσον ἐφ' ἡμῶν

text_en: And it answered them: Can I leave my sweetness, and my delicious fruits, and go to be promoted among the other trees?
text_la: Quæ respondit eis : Numquid possum deserere dulcedinem meam, fructusque suavissimos, et ire ut inter cetera ligna promovear?
text_pt: Porém a figueira lhes disse: Deixaria eu a minha doçura, o meu bom fruto, e iria pairar sobre as árvores?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ἡ συκῆ ἀφεῖσα τὴν γλυκύτητά μου καὶ τὸ γένημά μου τὸ ἀγαθὸν πορευθῶ ἄρχειν ἐπὶ ξύλων

text_en: And the trees said to the vine: Come and reign over us.
text_la: Locutaque sunt ligna ad vitem : Veni, et impera nobis.
text_pt: Então disseram as árvores à videira: Vem tu, e reina sobre nós.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν τὰ ξύλα τῇ ἀμπέλῳ δεῦρο βασίλευσον ἐφ' ἡμῶν

text_en: And it answered them: Can I forsake my wine, that cheers God and men , and be promoted among the other trees?
text_la: Quæ respondit eis : Numquid possum deserere vinum meum, quod lætificat Deum et homines, et inter ligna cetera promoveri?
text_pt: Porém a videira lhes disse: Deixaria eu o meu mosto, que alegra a Deus e aos homens, e iria pairar sobre as árvores?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ἡ ἄμπελος ἀφεῖσα τὸν οἶνόν μου τὴν εὐφροσύνην τὴν παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ τῶν ἀνθρώπων πορευθῶ ἄρχειν ξύλων

text_en: And all the trees said to the bramble: Come and reign over us.
text_la: Dixeruntque omnia ligna ad rhamnum : Veni, et impera super nos.
text_pt: Então todas as árvores disseram ao espinheiro: Vem tu, e reina sobre nós.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν τὰ ξύλα πρὸς τὴν ῥάμνον δεῦρο σὺ βασίλευσον ἐφ' ἡμῶν

text_en: And it answered them: If, indeed, you mean to make me king, come and rest under my shadow: but if you mean it not, let fire come out from the bramble, and devour the cedars of Libanus.
text_la: Quæ respondit eis : Si vere me regem vobis constituitis, venite, et sub umbra mea requiescite : si autem non vultis, egrediatur ignis de rhamno, et devoret cedros Libani.
text_pt: E disse o espinheiro às árvores: Se, na verdade, me ungis por rei sobre vós, vinde, e confiai-vos debaixo da minha sombra; mas, se não, saia fogo do espinheiro que consuma os cedros do Líbano.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ἡ ῥάμνος πρὸς τὰ ξύλα εἰ ἐν ἀληθείᾳ ὑμεῖς χρίετέ με εἰς βασιλέα ἐφ' ὑμῶν δεῦτε πεποίθατε ἐν τῇ σκέπῃ μου καὶ εἰ μή ἐξέλθοι πῦρ ἐκ τῆς ῥάμνου καὶ καταφάγοι τὰς κέδρους τοῦ Λιβάνου

text_en: Now, therefore, if you have done well, and without sin , in appointing Abimelech king over you, and have dealt well with Jerobaal , and with his house, and have made a suitable return for the benefits of him who fought for you,
text_la: Nunc igitur, si recte et absque peccato constituistis super vos regem Abimelech, et bene egistis cum Jerobaal, et cum domo ejus, et reddidistis vicem beneficiis ejus, qui pugnavit pro vobis,
text_pt: Agora, pois, se é que em verdade e sinceridade agistes, fazendo rei a Abimeleque, e se bem fizestes para com Jerubaal e para com a sua casa, e se com ele usastes conforme ao merecimento das suas mãos
text_el: καὶ νῦν εἰ ἐν ἀληθείᾳ καὶ ἐν τελειότητι ἐποιήσατε καὶ ἐβασιλεύσατε τὸν Αβιμελεχ καὶ εἰ καλῶς ἐποιήσατε μετὰ Ιεροβααλ καὶ μετὰ τοῦ οἴκου αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰ κατὰ τὸ ἀνταπόδομα τῆς χειρὸς αὐτοῦ ἐποιήσατε αὐτῷ
