text_en: and exposed his life to dangers, to deliver you from the hand of Madian ,
text_la: et animam suam dedit periculis, ut erueret vos de manu Madian,
text_pt: (Porque meu pai pelejou por vós, e desprezou a sua vida, e vos livrou da mão dos midianitas;
text_el: ὡς ἐπολέμησεν ὁ πατήρ μου ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν καὶ ἔρριψεν τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἐξ ἐναντίας καὶ ἐξείλατο ὑμᾶς ἐκ χειρὸς Μαδιαμ

text_en: and you are now risen up against my father's house, and have killed his sons, seventy men , upon one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his handmaid, king over the inhabitants of Sichem , because he is your brother:
text_la: qui nunc surrexistis contra domum patris mei, et interfecistis filios ejus septuaginta viros super unum lapidem, et constituistis regem Abimelech filium ancillæ ejus super habitatores Sichem, eo quod frater vester sit:
text_pt: Porém vós hoje vos levantastes contra a casa de meu pai, e matastes a seus filhos, setenta homens, sobre uma pedra; e a Abimeleque, filho da sua serva, fizestes reinar sobre os cidadãos de Siquém, porque é vosso irmão);
text_el: καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐπανέστητε ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον τοῦ πατρός μου σήμερον καὶ ἀπεκτείνατε τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ ἑβδομήκοντα ἄνδρας ἐπὶ λίθον ἕνα καὶ ἐβασιλεύσατε τὸν Αβιμελεχ υἱὸν τῆς παιδίσκης αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τοὺς ἄνδρας Σικιμων ὅτι ἀδελφὸς ὑμῶν ἐστιν

text_en: If therefore you have dealt well, and without fault, with Jerobaal and his house, rejoice this day, in Abimelech, and may he rejoice in you.
text_la: si ergo recte et absque vitio egistis cum Jerobaal et domo ejus, hodie lætamini in Abimelech, et ille lætetur in vobis.
text_pt: Pois, se em verdade e sinceridade usastes com Jerubaal e com a sua casa hoje, alegrai-vos com Abimeleque, e também ele se alegre convosco.
text_el: καὶ εἰ ἐν ἀληθείᾳ καὶ τελειότητι ἐποιήσατε μετὰ Ιεροβααλ καὶ τοῦ οἴκου αὐτοῦ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ταύτῃ εὐλογηθείητε ὑμεῖς καὶ εὐφρανθείητε ἐν Αβιμελεχ καὶ εὐφρανθείη καὶ αὐτὸς ἐν ὑμῖν

text_en: But if unjustly : let fire come out from him, and consume the inhabitants of Sichem , and the town of Mello: and let fire come out from the men of Sichem and from the town of Mello, and devour Abimelech.
text_la: Sin autem perverse : egrediatur ignis ex eo, et consumat habitatores Sichem, et oppidum Mello : egrediaturque ignis de viris Sichem, et de oppido Mello, et devoret Abimelech.
text_pt: Mas, se não, saia fogo de Abimeleque, e consuma aos cidadãos de Siquém, e a casa de Milo; e saia fogo dos cidadãos de Siquém, e da casa de Milo, que consuma a Abimeleque.
text_el: καὶ εἰ μή ἐξέλθοι πῦρ ἐξ Αβιμελεχ καὶ καταφάγοι τοὺς ἄνδρας Σικιμων καὶ τὸν οἶκον Μααλλων καὶ εἰ μή ἐξέλθοι πῦρ ἀπὸ ἀνδρῶν Σικιμων καὶ ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου Μααλλων καὶ καταφάγοι τὸν Αβιμελεχ

text_en: And when he had said thus, he fled, and went into Bera: and dwelt there for fear of Abimelech, his brother.
text_la: Quæ cum dixisset, fugit, et abiit in Bera : habitavitque ibi ob metum Abimelech fratris sui.
text_pt: Então partiu Jotão, e fugiu e foi para Beer; e ali habitou por medo de Abimeleque, seu irmão.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέδρα Ιωαθαμ καὶ ἐπορεύθη ἐν ὁδῷ καὶ ἔφυγεν εἰς Ραρα καὶ κατῴκησεν ἐκεῖ ἀπὸ προσώπου Αβιμελεχ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: So Abimelech reigned over Israel three years.
text_la: Regnavit itaque Abimelech super Israël tribus annis.
text_pt: Havendo, pois, Abimeleque dominado três anos sobre Israel,
text_el: καὶ ἦρξεν Αβιμελεχ ἐπὶ Ισραηλ τρία ἔτη

text_en: And the Lord sent a very evil spirit between Abimelech and the inhabitants of Sichem ; who began to detest him,
text_la: Misitque Dominus spiritum pessimum inter Abimelech et habitatores Sichem : qui cœperunt eum detestari,
text_pt: Enviou Deus um mau espírito entre Abimeleque e os cidadãos de Siquém; e estes se houveram aleivosamente contra Abimeleque;
text_el: καὶ ἐξαπέστειλεν ὁ θεὸς πνεῦμα πονηρὸν ἀνὰ μέσον Αβιμελεχ καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν ἀνδρῶν Σικιμων καὶ ἠθέτησαν οἱ ἄνδρες Σικιμων ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ Αβιμελεχ

text_en: and to lay the crime of the murder of the seventy sons of Jerobaal , and the shedding of their blood, upon Abimelech, their brother, and upon the rest of the princes of the Sichemites , who aided him.
text_la: et scelus interfectionis septuaginta filiorum Jerobaal, et effusionem sanguinis eorum conferre in Abimelech fratrem suum, et in ceteros Sichimorum principes, qui eum adjuverant.
text_pt: Para que a violência feita aos setenta filhos de Jerubaal viesse, e o seu sangue caísse sobre Abimeleque, seu irmão, que os matara, e sobre os cidadãos de Siquém, que fortaleceram as mãos dele para matar a seus irmãos;
text_el: τοῦ ἐπαγαγεῖν τὴν ἀδικίαν τῶν ἑβδομήκοντα υἱῶν Ιεροβααλ καὶ τὸ αἷμα αὐτῶν ἐπιθεῖναι ἐπὶ Αβιμελεχ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτῶν τὸν ἀποκτείναντα αὐτοὺς καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς ἄνδρας Σικιμων τοὺς κατισχύσαντας τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῦ ὥστε ἀποκτεῖναι τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And they set an ambush against him on the top of the mountains: and while they waited for his coming, they committed robberies , taking spoils of all that passed by: and it was told Abimelech.
text_la: Posueruntque insidias adversus eum in summitate montium : et dum illius præstolabantur adventum, exercebant latrocinia, agentes prædas de prætereuntibus : nuntiatumque est Abimelech.
text_pt: E os cidadãos de Siquém puseram contra ele quem lhe armasse emboscadas sobre os cumes dos montes; e a todo aquele que passava pelo caminho junto a eles o assaltavam; e contou-se isso a Abimeleque.
text_el: καὶ ἔθεντο αὐτῷ οἱ ἄνδρες Σικιμων ἔνεδρα ἐπὶ τὰς κεφαλὰς τῶν ὀρέων καὶ ἀνήρπαζον πάντας τοὺς διαπορευομένους ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ καὶ ἀπηγγέλη τῷ Αβιμελεχ

text_en: And Gaal, the son of Obed, came with his brethren, and went over to Sichem . And the inhabitants of Sichem , taking courage at his coming,
text_la: Venit autem Gaal filius Obed cum fratribus suis, et transivit in Sichimam. Ad cujus adventum erecti habitatores Sichem,
text_pt: Veio também Gaal, filho de Ebede, com seus irmãos, e passaram a Siquém; e os cidadãos de Siquém confiaram nele.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν Γααλ υἱὸς Αβεδ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ εἰς Σικιμα καὶ ἐπεποίθησαν ἐν αὐτῷ οἱ ἄνδρες Σικιμων

text_en: went out into the fields, wasting the vineyards, and treading down the grapes: and singing and dancing , they went into the temple of their god, and in their banquets and cups they cursed Abimelech.
text_la: egressi sunt in agros, vastantes vineas, uvasque calcantes : et factis cantantium choris, ingressi sunt fanum dei sui, et inter epulas et pocula maledicebant Abimelech,
text_pt: E saíram ao campo, e vindimaram as suas vinhas, e pisaram as uvas, e fizeram festas; e foram à casa de seu deus, e comeram, e beberam, e amaldiçoaram a Abimeleque.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθον εἰς ἀγρὸν καὶ ἐτρύγησαν τοὺς ἀμπελῶνας αὐτῶν καὶ κατεπάτουν καὶ ἐποίησαν χοροὺς καὶ εἰσῆλθον εἰς οἶκον θεοῦ αὐτῶν καὶ ἔφαγον καὶ ἔπιον καὶ κατηρῶντο τὸν Αβιμελεχ

text_en: And Gaal, the son of Obed, cried: Who is Abimelech, and what is Sichem , that we should serve him? Is he not the son of Jerobaal , and has made Zebul, his servant, ruler over the men of Emor, the father of Sichem ? Why then shall we serve him?
text_la: clamante Gaal filio Obed : Quis est Abimelech, et quæ est Sichem, ut serviamus ei? numquid non est filius Jerobaal, et constituit principem Zebul servum suum super viros Emor patris Sichem? cur ergo serviemus ei?
text_pt: E disse Gaal, filho de Ebede: Quem é Abimeleque, e quem é Siquém, para que o sirvamos? Não é porventura filho de Jerubaal? E não é Zebul o seu mordomo? Servi antes aos homens de Hamor, pai de Siquém; pois, por que razão serviríamos nós a ele?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Γααλ υἱὸς Αβεδ τί ἐστιν Αβιμελεχ καὶ τίς ἐστιν ὁ υἱὸς Συχεμ ὅτι δουλεύσομεν αὐτῷ οὐχ οὗτος υἱὸς Ιεροβααλ καὶ Ζεβουλ ἐπίσκοπος αὐτοῦ δοῦλος αὐτοῦ σὺν τοῖς ἀνδράσιν Εμμωρ πατρὸς Συχεμ καὶ τί ὅτι δουλεύσομεν αὐτῷ ἡμεῖς

text_en: Would to God that some man would put this people under my hand, that I might remove Abimelech out of the way. And it was said to Abimelech: Gather together the multitude of an army, and come.
text_la: utinam daret aliquis populum istum sub manu mea, ut auferrem de medio Abimelech. Dictumque est Abimelech : Congrega exercitus multitudinem, et veni.
text_pt: Ah! se este povo estivera na minha mão, eu expulsaria a Abimeleque. E diria a Abimeleque: Multiplica o teu exército, e sai.
text_el: καὶ τίς δῴη τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον ἐν χειρί μου καὶ μεταστήσω τὸν Αβιμελεχ καὶ ἐρῶ τῷ Αβιμελεχ πλήθυνον τὴν δύναμίν σου καὶ ἔξελθε

text_en: For Zebul, the ruler of the city, hearing the words of Gaal, the son of Obed, was very angry ,
text_la: Zebul enim princeps civitatis, auditis sermonibus Gaal filii Obed, iratus est valde,
text_pt: E, ouvindo Zebul, o maioral da cidade, as palavras de Gaal, filho de Ebede, se acendeu a sua ira;
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσεν Ζεβουλ ὁ ἄρχων τῆς πόλεως τοὺς λόγους Γααλ υἱοῦ Αβεδ καὶ ἐθυμώθη ὀργῇ

text_en: and sent messengers privately to Abimelech, saying: Behold, Gaal, the son of Obed, has come into Sichem with his brethren, and endeavours to set the city against you.
text_la: et misit clam ad Abimelech nuntios, dicens : Ecce Gaal filius Obed venit in Sichimam cum fratribus suis, et oppugnat adversum te civitatem.
text_pt: E enviou astutamente mensageiros a Abimeleque, dizendo: Eis que Gaal, filho de Ebede, e seus irmãos vieram a Siquém, e eis que eles estão sublevando esta cidade contra ti.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν ἀγγέλους πρὸς Αβιμελεχ μετὰ δώρων λέγων ἰδοὺ Γααλ υἱὸς Αβεδ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ παραγεγόνασιν εἰς Σικιμα καὶ οἵδε πολιορκοῦσιν τὴν πόλιν ἐπὶ σέ

text_en: Arise, therefore, in the night, with the people that is with you, and lie hid in the field:
text_la: Surge itaque nocte cum populo qui tecum est, et latita in agro:
text_pt: Levanta-te, pois, de noite, tu e o povo que tiveres contigo, e põe emboscadas no campo.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἀνάστηθι νυκτὸς σὺ καὶ ὁ λαὸς ὁ μετὰ σοῦ καὶ ἐνέδρευσον ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ

text_en: And betimes in the morning, at sun rising, set upon the city, and when he shall come out against you, with his people, do to him what you shall be able.
text_la: et primo mane, oriente sole, irrue super civitatem. Illo autem egrediente adversum te cum populo suo, fac ei quod potueris.
text_pt: E levanta-te pela manhã ao sair o sol, e dá de golpe sobre a cidade; e eis que, saindo contra ti, ele e o povo que tiver com ele, faze-lhe como puderes.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται τὸ πρωὶ ἅμα τῷ ἀνατεῖλαι τὸν ἥλιον καὶ ὀρθρίσεις καὶ ἐκτενεῖς ἐπὶ τὴν πόλιν καὶ ἰδοὺ αὐτὸς καὶ ὁ λαὸς ὁ μετ' αὐτοῦ ἐκπορεύονται πρὸς σέ καὶ ποιήσεις αὐτῷ καθάπερ ἐὰν εὕρῃ ἡ χείρ σου

text_en: Abimelech, therefore, arose with all his army, by night, and laid ambushes near Sichem in four places.
text_la: Surrexit itaque Abimelech cum omni exercitu suo nocte, et tetendit insidias juxta Sichimam in quatuor locis.
text_pt: Levantou-se, pois, Abimeleque, e todo o povo que com ele havia, de noite, e puseram emboscadas a Siquém, com quatro tropas.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστη Αβιμελεχ καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ὁ μετ' αὐτοῦ νυκτὸς καὶ ἐνήδρευσαν ἐπὶ Σικιμα τέσσαρας ἀρχάς

text_en: And Gaal, the son of Obed, went out, and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city. And Abimelech rose up, and all his army with him, from the places of the ambushes.
text_la: Egressusque est Gaal filius Obed, et stetit in introitu portæ civitatis. Surrexit autem Abimelech, et omnis exercitus cum eo, de insidiarum loco.
text_pt: E Gaal, filho de Ebede, saiu, e pôs-se à entrada da porta da cidade; e Abimeleque, e todo o povo que com ele havia, se levantou das emboscadas.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο πρωὶ καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Γααλ υἱὸς Αβεδ καὶ ἔστη πρὸς τῇ θύρᾳ τῆς πύλης τῆς πόλεως καὶ ἀνέστη Αβιμελεχ καὶ ὁ λαὸς ὁ μετ' αὐτοῦ ἐκ τῶν ἐνέδρων

text_en: And when Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul: Behold, a multitude comes down from the mountains. And he answered him: You see the shadows of the mountains as if they were the heads of men , and this is your mistake.
text_la: Cumque vidisset populum Gaal, dixit ad Zebul : Ecce de montibus multitudo descendit. Cui ille respondit : Umbras montium vides quasi capita hominum, et hoc errore deciperis.
text_pt: E, vendo Gaal aquele povo, disse a Zebul: Eis que desce gente dos cumes dos montes. Zebul, ao contrário, lhe disse: As sombras dos montes vês como se fossem homens.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν Γααλ υἱὸς Αβεδ τὸν λαὸν καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς Ζεβουλ ἰδοὺ λαὸς καταβαίνων ἀπὸ τῶν κορυφῶν τῶν ὀρέων καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτὸν Ζεβουλ τὴν σκιὰν τῶν ὀρέων σὺ ὁρᾶς ὡς ἄνδρας

text_en: Again Gaal said: Behold, there comes people down from the midst of the land, and one troop comes by the way that looks towards the oak.
text_la: Rursumque Gaal ait : Ecce populus de umbilico terræ descendit, et unus cuneus venit per viam quæ respicit quercum.
text_pt: Porém Gaal ainda tornou a falar, e disse: Eis ali desce gente do meio da terra, e uma tropa vem do caminho do carvalho de Meonenim.
text_el: καὶ προσέθετο ἔτι Γααλ τοῦ λαλῆσαι καὶ εἶπεν ἰδοὺ λαὸς καταβαίνων κατὰ θάλασσαν ἀπὸ τοῦ ἐχόμενα τοῦ ὀμφαλοῦ τῆς γῆς καὶ ἀρχὴ μία παραγίνεται ἀπὸ ὁδοῦ δρυὸς ἀποβλεπόντων

text_en: And Zebul said to him: Where is now your mouth, wherewith you said: Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him? Is not this the people which you despised ? Go out, and fight against him.
text_la: Cui dixit Zebul : Ubi est nunc os tuum, quo loquebaris : Quis est Abimelech ut serviamus ei? nonne hic populus est, quem despiciebas? egredere, et pugna contra eum.
text_pt: Então lhe disse Zebul: Onde está agora a tua boca, com a qual dizias: Quem é Abimeleque, para que o sirvamos? Não é este porventura o povo que desprezaste? Sai pois, peço-te, e peleja contra ele.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτὸν Ζεβουλ ποῦ ἐστιν νῦν τὸ στόμα σου τὸ λέγον τίς ἐστιν Αβιμελεχ ὅτι δουλεύσομεν αὐτῷ οὐκ ἰδοὺ οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ λαός ὃν ἐξουδένωσας ἔξελθε νῦν καὶ πολέμει πρὸς αὐτόν

text_en: So Gaal went out, in the sight of the people of Sichem , and fought against Abimelech,
text_la: Abiit ergo Gaal, spectante Sichimorum populo, et pugnavit contra Abimelech,
text_pt: E saiu Gaal à vista dos cidadãos de Siquém, e pelejou contra Abimeleque.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Γααλ ἀπὸ προσώπου τῶν ἀνδρῶν Σικιμων καὶ ἐπολέμησεν ἐν Αβιμελεχ

text_en: who chased and put him to flight, and drove him to the city: and many were slain of his people, even to the gate of the city:
text_la: qui persecutus est eum fugientem, et in urbem compulit : cecideruntque ex parte ejus plurimi, usque ad portam civitatis.
text_pt: E Abimeleque o perseguiu porquanto fugiu de diante dele; e muitos feridos caíram até à entrada da porta da cidade.
text_el: καὶ κατεδίωξεν αὐτὸν Αβιμελεχ καὶ ἔφυγεν ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔπεσον τραυματίαι πολλοὶ ἕως θυρῶν τῆς πόλεως

text_en: And Abimelech sat down in Ruma: but Zebul drove Gaal, and his companions, out of the city, and would not suffer them to abide in it.
text_la: Et Abimelech sedit in Ruma : Zebul autem Gaal et socios ejus expulit de urbe, nec in ea passus est commorari.
text_pt: E Abimeleque ficou em Aruma. E Zebul expulsou a Gaal e a seus irmãos, para que não pudessem habitar em Siquém.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάθισεν Αβιμελεχ ἐν Αριμα καὶ ἐξέβαλεν Ζεβουλ τὸν Γααλ καὶ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ τοῦ μὴ οἰκεῖν ἐν Σικιμοις

text_en: So the day following the people went out into the field. And it was told to Abimelech,
text_la: Sequenti ergo die, egressus est populus in campum. Quod cum nuntiatum esset Abimelech,
text_pt: E sucedeu no dia seguinte que o povo saiu ao campo; disto foi avisado Abimeleque.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη τῇ ἐπαύριον καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ λαὸς εἰς τὸ πεδίον καὶ ἀπηγγέλη τῷ Αβιμελεχ

text_en: and he took his army, and divided it into three companies, and laid ambushes in the fields. And seeing that the people came out of the city, he arose, and set upon them,
text_la: tulit exercitum suum, et divisit in tres turmas, tendens insidias in agris. Vidensque quod egrederetur populus de civitate, surrexit, et irruit in eos
text_pt: Então tomou o povo, e o repartiu em três tropas, e pôs emboscadas no campo; e olhou, e eis que o povo saía da cidade, e levantou-se contra ele, e o feriu.
text_el: καὶ παρέλαβεν τὸν λαὸν καὶ διεῖλεν αὐτὸν τρεῖς ἀρχὰς καὶ ἐνήδρευσεν ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ εἶδεν καὶ ἰδοὺ λαὸς ἐξῆλθεν ἐκ τῆς πόλεως καὶ ἐπανέστη αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτούς

text_en: with his own company, assaulting and besieging the city: whilst the two other companies chased the enemies that were scattered about the field.
text_la: cum cuneo suo, oppugnans et obsidens civitatem : duæ autem turmæ palantes per campum adversarios persequebantur.
text_pt: Porque Abimeleque, e as tropas que com ele havia, romperam de improviso, e pararam à entrada da porta da cidade; e as outras duas tropas deram de improviso sobre todos quantos estavam no campo, e os feriram.
text_el: καὶ Αβιμελεχ καὶ αἱ ἀρχαὶ αἱ μετ' αὐτοῦ ἐξετάθησαν καὶ ἔστησαν παρὰ τὴν πύλην τῆς πόλεως καὶ αἱ δύο ἀρχαὶ ἐξεχύθησαν ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτούς

text_en: And Abimelech assaulted the city all that day: and took it, and killed the inhabitants thereof, and demolished it, so that he sowed salt in it.
text_la: Porro Abimelech omni die illo oppugnabat urbem : quam cepit, interfectis habitatoribus ejus, ipsaque destructa, ita ut sal in ea dispergeret.
text_pt: E Abimeleque pelejou contra a cidade todo aquele dia, e tomou a cidade, e matou o povo que nela havia; e assolou a cidade, e a semeou de sal.
text_el: καὶ Αβιμελεχ ἐπολέμει ἐν τῇ πόλει ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν ἐκείνην καὶ κατελάβοντο τὴν πόλιν καὶ τὸν λαὸν τὸν ἐν αὐτῇ ἀνεῖλεν καὶ τὴν πόλιν καθεῖλεν καὶ ἔσπειρεν αὐτὴν ἅλας

text_en: And when they who dwelt in the tower of Sichem , had heard this, they went into the temple of their god Berith, where they had made a covenant with him, and from thence the place had taken its name , and it was exceeding strong.
text_la: Quod cum audissent qui habitabant in turre Sichimorum, ingressi sunt fanum dei sui Berith, ubi fœdus cum eo pepigerant, et ex eo locus nomen acceperat : qui erat munitus valde.
text_pt: O que ouvindo todos os cidadãos da torre de Siquém, entraram na fortaleza, na casa do deus Berite.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσαν πάντες οἱ ἄνδρες πύργου Σικιμων καὶ εἰσῆλθον εἰς τὸ ὀχύρωμα οἴκου τοῦ Βααλ διαθήκης

text_en: Abimelech also hearing that the men of the tower of Sichem were gathered together,
text_la: Abimelech quoque audiens viros turris Sichimorum pariter conglobatos,
text_pt: E contou-se a Abimeleque que todos os cidadãos da torre de Siquém se haviam congregado.
text_el: καὶ ἀπηγγέλη τῷ Αβιμελεχ ὅτι συνήχθησαν πάντες οἱ ἄνδρες τοῦ πύργου Σικιμων

text_en: went up into mount Selmon, he and all his people with him: and taking an axe, he cut down the bough of a tree, and laying it on his shoulder, and carrying it, he said to his companions: What you see me do, do out of hand.
text_la: ascendit in montem Selmon cum omni populo suo : et arrepta securi, præcidit arboris ramum, impositumque ferens humero, dixit ad socios : Quod me videtis facere, cito facite.
text_pt: Subiu, pois, Abimeleque ao monte Salmom, ele e todo o povo que com ele havia; e Abimeleque tomou na sua mão um machado, e cortou um ramo de árvore, e o levantou, e pô-lo ao seu ombro, e disse ao povo, que com ele havia: O que me vistes fazer apressai-vos a fazê-lo assim como eu.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβη Αβιμελεχ εἰς ὄρος Σελμων αὐτὸς καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ὁ μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔλαβεν Αβιμελεχ ἀξίνην ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔκοψεν φορτίον ξύλων καὶ ἔλαβεν αὐτὸ καὶ ἐπέθηκεν ἐπὶ τοὺς ὤμους αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς τὸν λαὸν τὸν μετ' αὐτοῦ τί εἴδετέ με ποιοῦντα ταχέως ποιήσατε ὡς καὶ ἐγώ

text_en: So they cut down boughs from the trees, every man as fast as he could, and followed their leader. And surrounding the fort, they set it on fire: and so it came to pass, that with the smoke and with the fire a thousand persons were killed, men and women together, of the inhabitants of the town of Sichem .
text_la: Igitur certatim ramos de arboribus præcidentes, sequebantur ducem. Qui circumdantes præsidium, succenderunt : atque ita factum est, ut fumo et igne mille homines necarentur, viri pariter et mulieres, habitatorum turris Sichem.
text_pt: Assim, pois, cada um de todo o povo, também cortou o seu ramo e seguiu a Abimeleque; e pondo os ramos junto da fortaleza, queimaram-na a fogo com os que nela estavam, de modo que todos os da torre de Siquém morreram, uns mil homens e mulheres.
text_el: καὶ ἔκοψαν καὶ αὐτοὶ ἕκαστος φορτίον καὶ ἦραν καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν ὀπίσω Αβιμελεχ καὶ ἐπέθηκαν ἐπὶ τὸ ὀχύρωμα καὶ ἐνέπρησαν ἐπ' αὐτοὺς τὸ ὀχύρωμα ἐν πυρί καὶ ἀπέθανον πάντες οἱ ἄνδρες πύργου Σικιμων ὡσεὶ χίλιοι ἄνδρες καὶ γυναῖκες

text_en: Then Abimelech, departing from thence, came to the town of Thebes, which he surrounded and besieged with his army.
text_la: Abimelech autem inde proficiscens venit ad oppidum Thebes, quod circumdans obsidebat exercitu.
text_pt: Então Abimeleque foi a Tebes e a sitiou, e a tomou.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθη Αβιμελεχ εἰς Θεβες καὶ περιεκάθισεν ἐπ' αὐτὴν καὶ προκατελάβετο αὐτήν

text_en: And there was in the midst of the city a high tower, to which both the men and the women were fled together, and all the princes of the city, and having shut and strongly barred the gate, they stood upon the battlements of the tower to defend themselves.
text_la: Erat autem turris excelsa in media civitate, ad quam confugerant simul viri ac mulieres, et omnes principes civitatis, clausa firmissime janua, et super turris tectum stantes per propugnacula.
text_pt: Havia, porém, no meio da cidade uma torre forte; e todos os homens e mulheres, e todos os cidadãos da cidade se refugiaram nela, e fecharam após si as portas, e subiram ao eirado da torre.
text_el: καὶ πύργος ἦν ὀχυρὸς ἐν μέσῳ τῆς πόλεως καὶ ἔφυγον ἐκεῖ πάντες οἱ ἄνδρες καὶ αἱ γυναῖκες καὶ πάντες οἱ ἡγούμενοι τῆς πόλεως καὶ ἀπέκλεισαν ἐφ' ἑαυτοὺς καὶ ἀνέβησαν ἐπὶ τὸ δῶμα τοῦ πύργου

text_en: And Abimelech, coming near the tower, fought stoutly: and, approaching to the gate, endeavoured to set fire to it:
text_la: Accedensque Abimelech juxta turrim, pugnabat fortiter : et appropinquans ostio, ignem supponere nitebatur:
text_pt: E Abimeleque veio até à torre, e a combateu; e chegou-se até à porta da torre, para a incendiar.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν Αβιμελεχ ἕως τοῦ πύργου καὶ ἐξεπολέμησαν αὐτόν καὶ ἤγγισεν Αβιμελεχ ἕως τῆς θύρας τοῦ πύργου ἐμπρῆσαι αὐτὸν ἐν πυρί

text_en: And behold, a certain woman casting a piece of a millstone from above, dashed it against the head of Abimelech, and broke his skull.
text_la: et ecce una mulier fragmen molæ desuper jaciens, illisit capiti Abimelech, et confregit cerebrum ejus.
text_pt: Porém uma mulher lançou um pedaço de uma mó sobre a cabeça de Abimeleque; e quebrou-lhe o crânio.
text_el: καὶ ἔρριψεν γυνὴ μία κλάσμα μύλου ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν Αβιμελεχ καὶ συνέθλασεν τὸ κρανίον αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he called hastily to his armourbearer, and said to him: Draw your sword, and kill me: lest it should be said that I was slain by a woman . He did as he was commanded, and slew him.
text_la: Qui vocavit cito armigerum suum, et ait ad eum : Evagina gladium tuum, et percute me, ne forte dicatur quod a femina interfectus sim. Qui jussa perficiens, interfecit eum.
text_pt: Então chamou logo ao moço, que levava as suas armas, e disse-lhe: Desembainha a tua espada, e mata-me; para que não se diga de mim: Uma mulher o matou. E o moço o atravessou e ele morreu.
text_el: καὶ ἐβόησεν τὸ τάχος πρὸς τὸ παιδάριον τὸν αἴροντα τὰ σκεύη αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ σπάσαι τὴν μάχαιράν σου καὶ θανάτωσόν με μήποτε εἴπωσιν γυνὴ ἀπέκτεινεν αὐτόν καὶ ἐξεκέντησεν αὐτὸν τὸ παιδάριον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀπέθανεν Αβιμελεχ

text_en: And when he was dead all the men of Israel that were with him, returned to their homes.
text_la: Illoque mortuo, omnes qui cum eo erant de Israël, reversi sunt in sedes suas:
text_pt: Vendo, pois, os homens de Israel que Abimeleque já era morto, foram-se cada um para o seu lugar.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν ἀνὴρ Ισραηλ ὅτι ἀπέθανεν Αβιμελεχ καὶ ἀπῆλθον ἀνὴρ εἰς τὸν τόπον αὐτοῦ

text_en: And God repaid the evil that Abimelech had done against his father, killing his seventy brethren.
text_la: et reddidit Deus malum quod fecerat Abimelech contra patrem suum, interfectis septuaginta fratribus suis.
text_pt: Assim Deus fez tornar sobre Abimeleque o mal que tinha feito a seu pai, matando a seus setenta irmãos.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστρεψεν ὁ θεὸς τὴν κακίαν Αβιμελεχ ἣν ἐποίησεν τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ ἀποκτεῖναι τοὺς ἑβδομήκοντα ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ

text_en: The Sichemites also were rewarded for what they had done, and the curse of Joatham, the son of Jerobaal , came upon them.
text_la: Sichimitis quoque quod operati erant, retributum est, et venit super eos maledictio Joatham filii Jerobaal.
text_pt: Como também todo o mal dos homens de Siquém fez tornar sobre a cabeça deles; e a maldição de Jotão, filho de Jerubaal, veio sobre eles.
text_el: καὶ πᾶσαν κακίαν ἀνδρῶν Σικιμων ἐπέστρεψεν ὁ θεὸς εἰς τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπῆλθεν ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ἡ κατάρα Ιωαθαμ τοῦ υἱοῦ Ιεροβααλ

text_en: After Abimelech, there arose a ruler in Israel , Thola, son of Phua, the uncle of Abimelech, a man of Issachar , who dwelt in Samir of mount Ephraim:
text_la: Post Abimelech surrexit dux in Israël Thola filius Phua patrui Abimelech, vir de Issachar, qui habitavit in Samir montis Ephraim:
text_pt: E depois de Abimeleque, se levantou, para livrar a Israel, Tola, filho de Puá, filho de Dodo, homem de Issacar; e habitava em Samir, na montanha de Efraim.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστη μετὰ Αβιμελεχ τοῦ σῶσαι τὸν Ισραηλ Θωλα υἱὸς Φουα υἱὸς πατραδέλφου αὐτοῦ ἀνὴρ Ισσαχαρ καὶ αὐτὸς κατῴκει ἐν Σαμαρείᾳ ἐν ὄρει Εφραιμ

text_en: And he judged Israel three and twenty years, and he died, and was buried in Samir.
text_la: et judicavit Israëlem viginti et tribus annis, mortuusque est, ac sepultus in Samir.
text_pt: E julgou a Israel vinte e três anos; e morreu, e foi sepultado em Samir.
text_el: καὶ ἔκρινεν τὸν Ισραηλ εἴκοσι καὶ τρία ἔτη καὶ ἀπέθανεν καὶ ἐτάφη ἐν Σαμαρείᾳ

text_en: To him succeeded Jair, the Galaadite, who judged Israel for two and twenty years,
text_la: Huic successit Jair Galaadites, qui judicavit Israël per viginti et duos annos,
text_pt: E depois dele se levantou Jair, gileadita, e julgou a Israel vinte e dois anos.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστη μετ' αὐτὸν Ιαϊρ ὁ Γαλααδίτης καὶ ἔκρινεν τὸν Ισραηλ εἴκοσι καὶ δύο ἔτη

text_en: having thirty sons, that rode on thirty ass colts, and were princes of thirty cities, which from his name were called Havoth Jair, that is, the towns of Jair, until this present day, in the land of Galaad.
text_la: habens triginta filios sedentes super triginta pullos asinarum, et principes triginta civitatum, quæ ex nomine ejus sunt appellatæ Havoth Jair, id est, oppida Jair, usque in præsentem diem, in terra Galaad.
text_pt: E tinha este trinta filhos, que cavalgavam sobre trinta jumentos; e tinham trinta cidades, a que chamaram Havote-Jair, até ao dia de hoje; as quais estão na terra de Gileade.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένοντο αὐτῷ τριάκοντα καὶ δύο υἱοὶ ἐπιβεβηκότες ἐπὶ τριάκοντα καὶ δύο πώλους καὶ τριάκοντα καὶ δύο πόλεις αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐκάλεσεν αὐτὰς Ἐπαύλεις Ιαϊρ ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης αἵ εἰσιν ἐν τῇ γῇ Γαλααδ

text_en: And Jair died, and was buried in the place which is called Camon.
text_la: Mortuusque est Jair, ac sepultus in loco cui est vocabulum Camon.
text_pt: E morreu Jair, e foi sepultado em Camom.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέθανεν Ιαϊρ καὶ ἐτάφη ἐν Ραμμω

text_en: But the children of Israel , adding new sins to their old ones, did evil in the sight of the Lord , and served idols , Baalim and Astaroth, and the gods of Syria , and of Sidon , and of Moab , and of the children of Ammon , and of the Philistines : and they left the Lord , and did not serve him.
text_la: Filii autem Israël peccatis veteribus jungentes nova, fecerunt malum in conspectu Domini, et servierunt idolis, Baalim et Astaroth, et diis Syriæ ac Sidonis et Moab et filiorum Ammon et Philisthiim : dimiseruntque Dominum, et non coluerunt eum.
text_pt: Então tornaram os filhos de Israel a fazer o que era mau aos olhos do Senhor, e serviram aos baalins, e a Astarote, e aos deuses da Síria, e aos deuses de Sidom, e aos deuses de Moabe, e aos deuses dos filhos de Amom, e aos deuses dos filisteus; e deixaram ao Senhor, e não o serviram.
text_el: καὶ προσέθεντο οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ποιῆσαι τὸ πονηρὸν ἔναντι κυρίου καὶ ἐλάτρευσαν ταῖς Βααλιμ καὶ ταῖς Ασταρωθ καὶ τοῖς θεοῖς Σιδῶνος καὶ τοῖς θεοῖς Μωαβ καὶ τοῖς θεοῖς υἱῶν Αμμων καὶ τοῖς θεοῖς τῶν ἀλλοφύλων καὶ ἐγκατέλιπον τὸν κύριον καὶ οὐκ ἐδούλευσαν αὐτῷ

text_en: And the Lord being angry with them, delivered them into the hands of the Philistines , and of the children of Ammon .
text_la: Contra quos Dominus iratus, tradidit eos in manus Philisthiim et filiorum Ammon.
text_pt: E a ira do Senhor se acendeu contra Israel; e vendeu-os nas mãos dos filisteus, e nas mãos dos filhos de Amom.
text_el: καὶ ἐθυμώθη ὀργῇ κύριος ἐν τῷ Ισραηλ καὶ ἀπέδοτο αὐτοὺς ἐν χειρὶ ἀλλοφύλων καὶ ἐν χειρὶ υἱῶν Αμμων

text_en: And they were afflicted, and grievously oppressed for eighteen years, all they that dwelt beyond the Jordan in the land of the Amorrhite , who is in Galaad:
text_la: Afflictique sunt, et vehementer oppressi per annos decem et octo, omnes qui habitabant trans Jordanem in terra Amorrhæi, qui est in Galaad:
text_pt: E naquele mesmo ano oprimiram e vexaram aos filhos de Israel; dezoito anos oprimiram a todos os filhos de Israel que estavam além do Jordão, na terra dos amorreus, que está em Gileade.
text_el: καὶ ἐσάθρωσαν καὶ ἔθλασαν τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ ἐν τῷ ἐνιαυτῷ ἐκείνῳ ὀκτωκαίδεκα ἔτη πάντας τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ ἐν τῷ πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου ἐν τῇ γῇ τοῦ Αμορραίου ἐν τῇ Γαλααδίτιδι

text_en: Insomuch that the children of Ammon , passing over the Jordan , wasted Juda , and Benjamin , and Ephraim: and Israel was distressed exceedingly.
text_la: in tantum ut filii Ammon, Jordane transmisso, vastarent Judam et Benjamin et Ephraim : afflictusque est Israël nimis.
text_pt: Até os filhos de Amom passaram o Jordão, para pelejar também contra Judá, e contra Benjamim, e contra a casa de Efraim; de modo que Israel ficou muito angustiado.
text_el: καὶ διέβησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Αμμων τὸν Ιορδάνην ἐκπολεμῆσαι καὶ ἐν τῷ Ιουδα καὶ Βενιαμιν καὶ ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ Εφραιμ καὶ ἐθλίβησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ σφόδρα

text_en: And they cried to the Lord , and said, We have sinned against you, because we have forsaken the Lord our God , and have served Baalim .
text_la: Et clamantes ad Dominum, dixerunt : Peccavimus tibi, quia dereliquimus Dominum Deum nostrum, et servivimus Baalim.
text_pt: Então os filhos de Israel clamaram ao Senhor, dizendo: Contra ti havemos pecado, visto que deixamos a nosso Deus, e servimos aos baalins.
text_el: καὶ ἐκέκραξαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ πρὸς κύριον λέγοντες ἡμάρτομέν σοι ὅτι ἐγκατελίπομεν τὸν θεὸν ἡμῶν καὶ ἐλατρεύσαμεν ταῖς Βααλιμ

text_en: And the Lord said to them: Did not the Egyptians , and the Amorrhites , and the children of Ammon , and the Philistines ,
text_la: Quibus locutus est Dominus : Numquid non Ægyptii et Amorrhæi, filiique Ammon et Philisthiim,
text_pt: Porém o Senhor disse aos filhos de Israel: Porventura dos egípcios, e dos amorreus, e dos filhos de Amom, e dos filisteus,
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ οὐχὶ οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι καὶ οἱ Αμορραῖοι καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Αμμων καὶ Μωαβ καὶ οἱ ἀλλόφυλοι

text_en: the Sidonians also, and Amalec , and Chanaan , oppress you, and you cried to me, and I delivered you out of their hand?
text_la: Sidonii quoque et Amalec et Chanaan oppresserunt vos, et clamastis ad me, et erui vos de manu eorum?
text_pt: E dos sidônios, e dos amalequitas, e dos maonitas, que vos oprimiam, quando a mim clamastes, não vos livrei das suas mãos?
text_el: καὶ Σιδώνιοι καὶ Μαδιαμ καὶ Αμαληκ ἐξέθλιψαν ὑμᾶς καὶ ἐκεκράξατε πρός με καὶ ἔσωσα ὑμᾶς ἐκ χειρὸς αὐτῶν

text_en: And yet you have forsaken me, and have worshipped strange gods : therefore I will deliver you no more:
text_la: Et tamen reliquistis me, et coluistis deos alienos : idcirco non addam ut ultra vos liberem:
text_pt: Contudo vós me deixastes a mim, e servistes a outros deuses; pelo que não vos livrarei mais.
text_el: καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐγκατελίπετέ με καὶ ἐλατρεύσατε θεοῖς ἑτέροις διὰ τοῦτο οὐ προσθήσω τοῦ σῶσαι ὑμᾶς

text_en: Go, and call upon the gods which you have chosen: let them deliver you in the time of distress.
text_la: ite, et invocate deos quos elegistis : ipsi vos liberent in tempore angustiæ.
text_pt: Ide, e clamai aos deuses que escolhestes; que eles vos livrem no tempo do vosso aperto.
text_el: βαδίζετε καὶ βοᾶτε πρὸς τοὺς θεούς οὓς ἐξελέξασθε ἑαυτοῖς καὶ αὐτοὶ σωσάτωσαν ὑμᾶς ἐν καιρῷ θλίψεως ὑμῶν

text_en: And the children of Israel said to the Lord : We have sinned , do unto us whatsoever pleases you: only deliver us this time.
text_la: Dixeruntque filii Israël ad Dominum : Peccavimus, redde tu nobis quidquid tibi placet : tantum nunc libera nos.
text_pt: Mas os filhos de Israel disseram ao Senhor: Pecamos; faze-nos conforme a tudo quanto te parecer bem aos teus olhos; tão-somente te rogamos que nos livres nesta vez.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ πρὸς κύριον ἡμάρτομεν ποίησον σὺ ἡμῖν κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἂν ἀρέσκῃ ἐνώπιόν σου πλήν κύριε ἐξελοῦ ἡμᾶς ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ταύτῃ

text_en: And saying these things, they cast away out of their coasts all the idols of strange gods , and served the Lord their God : and he was touched with their miseries.
text_la: Quæ dicentes, omnia de finibus suis alienorum deorum idola projecerunt, et servierunt Domino Deo : qui doluit super miseriis eorum.
text_pt: E tiraram os deuses alheios do meio de si, e serviram ao Senhor; então se angustiou a sua alma por causa da desgraça de Israel.
text_el: καὶ μετέστησαν τοὺς θεοὺς τοὺς ἀλλοτρίους ἐκ μέσου αὐτῶν καὶ ἐλάτρευσαν τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ οὐκ εὐηρέστησεν ἐν τῷ λαῷ καὶ ὠλιγοψύχησεν ἐν τῷ κόπῳ Ισραηλ

text_en: And the children of Ammon shouting together, pitched their tents in Galaad: against whom the children of Israel assembled themselves together, and camped in Maspha .
text_la: Itaque filii Ammon conclamantes in Galaad fixere tentoria, contra quos congregati filii Israël in Maspha castrametati sunt.
text_pt: E os filhos de Amom se reuniram e se acamparam em Gileade; e também os de Israel se congregaram, e se acamparam em Mizpá.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Αμμων καὶ παρενέβαλον ἐν Γαλααδ καὶ ἐξῆλθον οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ καὶ παρενέβαλον ἐν τῇ Μασσηφα

text_en: And the princes of Galaad said one to another: Whosoever of us shall first begin to fight against the children of Ammon , he shall be the leader of the people of Galaad.
text_la: Dixeruntque principes Galaad singuli ad proximos suos : Qui primus ex nobis contra filios Ammon cœperit dimicare, erit dux populi Galaad.
text_pt: Então o povo e os príncipes de Gileade disseram uns aos outros: Quem será o homem que começará a pelejar contra os filhos de Amom? Ele será por cabeça de todos os moradores de Gileade.
text_el: καὶ εἶπον οἱ ἄρχοντες τοῦ λαοῦ Γαλααδ ἀνὴρ πρὸς τὸν πλησίον αὐτοῦ τίς ἀνήρ ὃς ἄρξεται πολεμῆσαι ἐν τοῖς υἱοῖς Αμμων καὶ ἔσται εἰς κεφαλὴν πᾶσιν τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν Γαλααδ

text_en: There was at that time Jephte , the Galaadite, a most valiant man , and a warrior, the son of a woman that was a harlot, and his father was Galaad.
text_la: Fuit illo tempore Jephte Galaadites vir fortissimus atque pugnator, filius mulieris meretricis, qui natus est de Galaad.
text_pt: Era então Jefté, o gileadita, homem valoroso, porém filho de uma prostituta; mas Gileade gerara a Jefté.
text_el: καὶ Ιεφθαε ὁ Γαλααδίτης δυνατὸς ἐν ἰσχύι καὶ αὐτὸς ἦν υἱὸς γυναικὸς πόρνης καὶ ἔτεκεν τῷ Γαλααδ τὸν Ιεφθαε

text_en: Now Galaad had a wife of whom he had sons: who, after they were grown up, thrust out Jephte , saying: You can not inherit in the house of our father, because you are born of another mother.
text_la: Habuit autem Galaad uxorem, de qua suscepit filios : qui postquam creverant, ejecerunt Jephte, dicentes : Hæres in domo patris nostri esse non poteris, quia de altera matre natus es.
text_pt: Também a mulher de Gileade lhe deu filhos, e, sendo os filhos desta mulher já grandes, expulsaram a Jefté, e lhe disseram: Não herdarás na casa de nosso pai, porque és filho de outra mulher.
text_el: καὶ ἔτεκεν ἡ γυνὴ Γαλααδ αὐτῷ υἱούς καὶ ἡδρύνθησαν οἱ υἱοὶ τῆς γυναικὸς καὶ ἐξέβαλον τὸν Ιεφθαε καὶ εἶπον αὐτῷ οὐ κληρονομήσεις ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν ὅτι γυναικὸς υἱὸς ἑταίρας εἶ σύ

text_en: Then he fled and avoided them, and dwelt in the land of Tob: and there were gathered to him needy men and robbers, and they followed him as their prince.
text_la: Quos ille fugiens atque devitans, habitavit in terra Tob : congregatique sunt ad eum viri inopes, et latrocinantes, et quasi principem sequebantur.
text_pt: Então Jefté fugiu de diante de seus irmãos, e habitou na terra de Tobe; e homens levianos se ajuntaram a Jefté, e saíam com ele.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέδρα Ιεφθαε ἐκ προσώπου τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ κατῴκησεν ἐν γῇ Τωβ καὶ συνελέγοντο πρὸς τὸν Ιεφθαε ἄνδρες λιτοὶ καὶ συνεξεπορεύοντο μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: In those days the children of Ammon made war against Israel .
text_la: In illis diebus pugnabant filii Ammon contra Israël.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, depois de algum tempo, os filhos de Amom pelejaram contra Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο μεθ' ἡμέρας καὶ ἐπολέμησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Αμμων μετὰ Ισραηλ

text_en: And as they pressed hard upon them, the ancients of Galaad went to fetch Jephte out of the land of Tob to help them:
text_la: Quibus acriter instantibus perrexerunt majores natu de Galaad, ut tollerent in auxilium sui Jephte de terra Tob:
text_pt: E sucedeu que, como os filhos de Amom pelejassem contra Israel, foram os anciãos de Gileade buscar a Jefté na terra de Tobe.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη ἡνίκα ἐπολέμουν οἱ υἱοὶ Αμμων μετὰ Ισραηλ καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν οἱ πρεσβύτεροι Γαλααδ παραλαβεῖν τὸν Ιεφθαε ἐν γῇ Τωβ

text_en: And they said to him: Come, and be our prince, and fight against the children of Ammon .
text_la: dixeruntque ad eum : Veni et esto princeps noster, et pugna contra filios Ammon.
text_pt: E disseram a Jefté: Vem, e sê o nosso chefe; para que combatamos contra os filhos de Amom.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς Ιεφθαε δεῦρο καὶ ἔσῃ ἡμῖν εἰς ἡγούμενον καὶ πολεμήσωμεν ἐν τοῖς υἱοῖς Αμμων

text_en: And he answered them: Are not you the men that hated me, and cast me out of my father's house, and now you have come to me, constrained by necessity?
text_la: Quibus ille respondit : Nonne vos estis, qui odistis me, et ejecistis de domo patris mei? et nunc venistis ad me necessitate compulsi.
text_pt: Porém Jefté disse aos anciãos de Gileade: Porventura não me odiastes a mim, e não me expulsastes da casa de meu pai? Por que, pois, agora viestes a mim, quando estais em aperto?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιεφθαε τοῖς πρεσβυτέροις Γαλααδ οὐχ ὑμεῖς ἐμισήσατέ με καὶ ἐξεβάλετέ με ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ πατρός μου καὶ ἐξαπεστείλατέ με ἀφ' ὑμῶν καὶ τί ὅτι ἤλθατε πρός με ἡνίκα ἐθλίβητε

text_en: And the princes of Galaad said to Jephte : For this cause we are now come to you, that you may go with us, and fight against the children of Ammon , and be head over all the inhabitants of Galaad.
text_la: Dixeruntque principes Galaad ad Jephte : Ob hanc igitur causam nunc ad te venimus, ut proficiscaris nobiscum, et pugnes contra filios Ammon, sisque dux omnium qui habitant in Galaad.
text_pt: E disseram os anciãos de Gileade a Jefté: Por isso tornamos a ti, para que venhas conosco, e combatas contra os filhos de Amom; e nos sejas por chefe sobre todos os moradores de Gileade.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν οἱ πρεσβύτεροι Γαλααδ πρὸς Ιεφθαε οὐχ οὕτως νῦν ἤλθομεν πρὸς σέ καὶ συμπορεύσῃ ἡμῖν καὶ πολεμήσομεν ἐν τοῖς υἱοῖς Αμμων καὶ ἔσῃ ἡμῖν εἰς κεφαλήν πᾶσιν τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν Γαλααδ

text_en: Jephte also said to them: If you be come to me sincerely, that I should fight for you against the children of Ammon , and the Lord shall deliver them into my hand, shall I be your prince?
text_la: Jephte quoque dixit eis : Si vere venistis ad me, ut pugnem pro vobis contra filios Ammon, tradideritque eos Dominus in manus meas, ego ero vester princeps?
text_pt: Então Jefté disse aos anciãos de Gileade: Se me levardes de volta para combater contra os filhos de Amom, e o Senhor mos der diante de mim, então eu vos serei por chefe?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιεφθαε πρὸς τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους Γαλααδ εἰ ἐπιστρέφετέ με ὑμεῖς πολεμῆσαι ἐν τοῖς υἱοῖς Αμμων καὶ παραδῷ κύριος αὐτοὺς ἐνώπιον ἐμοῦ ἐγὼ ὑμῖν ἔσομαι εἰς κεφαλήν

text_en: They answered him: The Lord , who hears these things, he himself is mediator and witness that we will do as we have promised.
text_la: Qui responderunt ei : Dominus, qui hæc audit, ipse mediator ac testis est quod nostra promissa faciemus.
text_pt: E disseram os anciãos de Gileade a Jefté: O Senhor será testemunha entre nós, e assim o faremos conforme a tua palavra.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν οἱ πρεσβύτεροι Γαλααδ πρὸς Ιεφθαε κύριος ἔσται ὁ ἀκούων ἀνὰ μέσον ἡμῶν εἰ μὴ κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμά σου οὕτως ποιήσομεν

text_en: Jephte therefore went with the princes of Galaad, and all the people made him their prince. And Jephte spoke all his words before the Lord in Maspha .
text_la: Abiit itaque Jephte cum principibus Galaad, fecitque eum omnis populus principem sui. Locutusque est Jephte omnes sermones suos coram Domino in Maspha.
text_pt: Assim Jefté foi com os anciãos de Gileade, e o povo o pôs por chefe e príncipe sobre si; e Jefté falou todas as suas palavras perante o Senhor em Mizpá.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθη Ιεφθαε μετὰ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων Γαλααδ καὶ κατέστησαν αὐτὸν ἐπ' αὐτῶν εἰς κεφαλὴν εἰς ἡγούμενον καὶ ἐλάλησεν Ιεφθαε πάντας τοὺς λόγους αὐτοῦ ἐνώπιον κυρίου ἐν Μασσηφα

text_en: And he sent messengers to the king of the children of Ammon , to say in his name : What have you to do with me, that you have come against me, to waste my land?
text_la: Et misit nuntios ad regem filiorum Ammon, qui ex persona sua dicerent : Quid mihi et tibi est, quia venisti contra me, ut vastares terram meam?
text_pt: E enviou Jefté mensageiros ao rei dos filhos de Amom, dizendo: Que há entre mim e ti, que vieste a mim a pelejar contra a minha terra?
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Ιεφθαε ἀγγέλους πρὸς βασιλέα υἱῶν Αμμων λέγων τί ἐμοὶ καὶ σοί ὅτι ἥκεις πρός με σὺ πολεμῆσαί με ἐν τῇ γῇ μου

text_en: And he answered them: Because Israel took away my land, when he came up out of Egypt , from the confines of the Arnon unto the Jaboc and the Jordan : now, therefore, restore the same peaceably to me.
text_la: Quibus ille respondit : Quia tulit Israël terram meam, quando ascendit de Ægypto, a finibus Arnon usque Jaboc atque Jordanem : nunc ergo cum pace redde mihi eam.
text_pt: E disse o rei dos filhos de Amom aos mensageiros de Jefté: É porque, saindo Israel do Egito, tomou a minha terra, desde Arnom até Jaboque, e ainda até ao Jordão: Restitui-ma agora, em paz.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν βασιλεὺς υἱῶν Αμμων πρὸς τοὺς ἀγγέλους Ιεφθαε διότι ἔλαβεν Ισραηλ τὴν γῆν μου ἐν τῇ ἀναβάσει αὐτοῦ ἐξ Αἰγύπτου ἀπὸ Αρνων ἕως Ιαβοκ καὶ ἕως τοῦ Ιορδάνου καὶ νῦν ἐπίστρεψον αὐτὰς μετ' εἰρήνης

text_en: And Jephte again sent word by them, and commanded them to say to the king of Ammon :
text_la: Per quos rursum mandavit Jephte, et imperavit eis ut dicerent regi Ammon:
text_pt: Porém Jefté prosseguiu ainda em enviar mensageiros ao rei dos filhos de Amom,
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστρεψαν οἱ ἄγγελοι πρὸς Ιεφθαε καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Ιεφθαε ἀγγέλους πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα υἱῶν Αμμων

text_en: Thus says Jephte : Israel did not take away the land of Moab , nor the land of the children of Ammon :
text_la: Hæc dicit Jephte : Non tulit Israël terram Moab, nec terram filiorum Ammon:
text_pt: Dizendo-lhe: Assim diz Jefté: Israel não tomou, nem a terra dos moabitas, nem a terra dos filhos de Amom.
text_el: λέγων τάδε λέγει Ιεφθαε οὐκ ἔλαβεν Ισραηλ τὴν γῆν Μωαβ καὶ τὴν γῆν υἱῶν Αμμων

text_en: But when they came up out of Egypt , he walked through the desert to the Red Sea , and came into Cades .
text_la: sed quando de Ægypto conscenderunt, ambulavit per solitudinem usque ad mare Rubrum, et venit in Cades.
text_pt: Porque, subindo Israel do Egito, andou pelo deserto até ao Mar Vermelho, e chegou até Cades.
text_el: ἐν τῇ ἀναβάσει αὐτῶν ἐξ Αἰγύπτου ἀλλ' ἐπορεύθη Ισραηλ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ἕως θαλάσσης ἐρυθρᾶς καὶ ἦλθεν ἕως Καδης

text_en: And he sent messengers to the king of Edom , saying: Suffer me to pass through your land. But he would not condescend to his request. He sent also to the king of Moab , who, likewise, refused to give him passage. He abode, therefore, in Cades ,
text_la: Misitque nuntios ad regem Edom, dicens : Dimitte me ut transeam per terram tuam. Qui noluit acquiescere precibus ejus. Misit quoque ad regem Moab, qui et ipse transitum præbere contempsit. Mansit itaque in Cades,
text_pt: E Israel enviou mensageiros ao rei dos edomitas, dizendo: Rogo-te que me deixes passar pela tua terra. Porém o rei dos edomitas não lhe deu ouvidos; enviou também ao rei dos moabitas, o qual igualmente não consentiu; e assim Israel ficou em Cades.
text_el: καὶ ἐξαπέστειλεν Ισραηλ ἀγγέλους πρὸς βασιλέα Εδωμ λέγων παρελεύσομαι διὰ τῆς γῆς σου καὶ οὐκ ἤκουσεν βασιλεὺς Εδωμ καί γε πρὸς βασιλέα Μωαβ ἀπέστειλεν καὶ οὐκ ἠθέλησεν καὶ ἐκάθισεν Ισραηλ ἐν Καδης

text_en: and went round the land of Edom at the side, and the land of Moab : and came over against the east coast of the land of Moab , and camped on the other side of the Arnon: and he would not enter the bounds of Moab .
text_la: et circuivit ex latere terram Edom et terram Moab : venitque contra orientalem plagam terræ Moab, et castrametatus est trans Arnon : nec voluit intrare terminos Moab. (Arnon quippe confinium est terræ Moab.)
text_pt: Depois andou pelo deserto e rodeou a terra dos edomitas e a terra dos moabitas, e veio do nascente do sol à terra dos moabitas, e alojou-se além de Arnom; porém não entrou nos limites dos moabitas, porque Arnom é limite dos moabitas.
text_el: καὶ διῆλθεν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ καὶ ἐκύκλωσεν τὴν γῆν Εδωμ καὶ τὴν γῆν Μωαβ καὶ παρεγένετο κατ' ἀνατολὰς ἡλίου τῆς γῆς Μωαβ καὶ παρενέβαλον ἐν τῷ πέραν Αρνων καὶ οὐκ εἰσῆλθον εἰς τὸ ὅριον Μωαβ ὅτι Αρνων ἦν ὅριον Μωαβ

text_en: So Israel sent messengers to Sehon, king of the Amorrhites , who dwelt in Hesebon , and they said to him: Suffer me to pass through your land to the river.
text_la: Misit itaque Israël nuntios ad Sehon regem Amorrhæorum, qui habitabat in Hesebon, et dixerunt ei : Dimitte ut transeam per terram tuam usque ad fluvium.
text_pt: Mas Israel enviou mensageiros a Siom, rei dos amorreus, rei de Hesbom; e disse-lhe Israel: Deixa-nos, peço-te, passar pela tua terra até ao meu lugar.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Ισραηλ ἀγγέλους πρὸς Σηων βασιλέα Εσεβων τὸν Αμορραῖον καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ισραηλ παρελεύσομαι διὰ τῆς γῆς σου ἕως τοῦ τόπου μου

text_en: But he, also despising the words of Israel , allowed him not to pass through his borders: but gathering an infinite multitude, went out against him to Jasa, and made strong opposition.
text_la: Qui et ipse Israël verba despiciens, non dimisit eum transire per terminos suos : sed infinita multitudine congregata, egressus est contra eum in Jasa, et fortiter resistebat.
text_pt: Porém Siom não confiou em Israel para este passar nos seus limites; antes Siom ajuntou todo o seu povo, e se acamparam em Jasa, e combateu contra Israel.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἠθέλησεν Σηων διελθεῖν τὸν Ισραηλ διὰ τῶν ὁρίων αὐτοῦ καὶ συνήγαγεν Σηων πάντα τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ παρενέβαλεν εἰς Ιασσα καὶ ἐπολέμησεν μετὰ Ισραηλ

text_en: And the Lord delivered him, with all his army, into the hands of Israel , and he slew him, and possessed all the land of the Amorrhite , the inhabitant of that country,
text_la: Tradiditque eum Dominus in manus Israël cum omni exercitu suo : qui percussit eum, et possedit omnem terram Amorrhæi habitatoris regionis illius,
text_pt: E o Senhor Deus de Israel deu a Siom, com todo o seu povo, na mão de Israel, que os feriu; e Israel tomou por herança toda a terra dos amorreus que habitavam naquela região.
text_el: καὶ παρέδωκεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ τὸν Σηων καὶ πάντα τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ ἐν χειρὶ Ισραηλ καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτούς καὶ ἐκληρονόμησεν Ισραηλ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν τοῦ Αμορραίου τοῦ κατοικοῦντος ἐν τῇ γῇ

text_en: and all the coasts thereof from the Arnon to the Jaboc, and from the wilderness to the Jordan .
text_la: et universos fines ejus, de Arnon usque Jaboc, et de solitudine usque ad Jordanem.
text_pt: E por herança tomaram todos os limites dos amorreus, desde Arnom até Jaboque, e desde o deserto até ao Jordão.
text_el: καὶ ἐκληρονόμησεν πᾶν τὸ ὅριον τοῦ Αμορραίου ἀπὸ Αρνων καὶ ἕως τοῦ Ιαβοκ καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς ἐρήμου καὶ ἕως τοῦ Ιορδάνου

text_en: So the Lord , the God of Israel , destroyed the Amorrhite , his people of Israel fighting against him, and will you now possess his land?
text_la: Dominus ergo Deus Israël subvertit Amorrhæum, pugnante contra illum populo suo Israël, et tu nunc vis possidere terram ejus?
text_pt: Assim o Senhor Deus de Israel desapossou os amorreus de diante do seu povo de Israel; e os possuirias tu?
text_el: καὶ νῦν κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ ἐξῆρεν τὸν Αμορραῖον ἐκ προσώπου τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτοῦ Ισραηλ καὶ σὺ κληρονομήσεις αὐτὸν ἐπὶ σοῦ

text_en: Are not those things which your god Chamos possesses, due to you by right? But what the Lord our God has obtained by conquest, shall be our possession:
text_la: nonne ea quæ possidet Chamos deus tuus, tibi jure debentur? quæ autem Dominus Deus noster victor obtinuit, in nostram cedent possessionem:
text_pt: Não possuirias tu aquilo que Quemós, teu deus, desapossasse de diante de ti? Assim possuiremos nós todos quantos o Senhor nosso Deus desapossar de diante de nós.
text_el: οὐχὶ ὅσα κατεκληρονόμησέν σοι Χαμως ὁ θεός σου αὐτὰ κληρονομήσεις καὶ πάντα ὅσα κατεκληρονόμησεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν ἀπὸ προσώπου ἡμῶν αὐτὰ κληρονομήσομεν

text_en: Unless, perhaps, you are better than Balac, the son of Sephor, king of Moab : or can show that he strove against Israel , and fought against him,
text_la: nisi forte melior es Balac filio Sephor rege Moab; aut docere potes, quod jurgatus sit contra Israël, et pugnaverit contra eum,
text_pt: Agora, pois, és tu ainda melhor do que Balaque, filho de Zipor, rei dos moabitas? Porventura contendeu ele em algum tempo com Israel, ou pelejou alguma vez contra ele?
text_el: καὶ νῦν μὴ κρείσσων εἶ σὺ τοῦ Βαλακ υἱοῦ Σεπφωρ βασιλέως Μωαβ μὴ μάχῃ ἐμαχέσατο μετὰ Ισραηλ ἢ πολεμῶν ἐπολέμησεν αὐτοῖς

text_en: whereas he has dwelt in Hesebon , and the villages thereof, and in Aroer, and its villages , and in all the cities near the Jordan , for three hundred years. Why have you for so long a time attempted nothing about this claim?
text_la: quando habitavit in Hesebon et viculis ejus, et in Aroër et villis illius, vel in cunctis civitatibus juxta Jordanem, per trecentos annos. Quare tanto tempore nihil super hac repetitione tentastis?
text_pt: Enquanto Israel habitou trezentos anos em Hesbom e nas suas vilas, e em Aroer e nas suas vilas, em todas as cidades que estão ao longo de Arnom, por que o não recuperastes naquele tempo?
text_el: ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ Ισραηλ ἐν Εσεβων καὶ ἐν ταῖς θυγατράσιν αὐτῆς καὶ ἐν Ιαζηρ καὶ ἐν ταῖς θυγατράσιν αὐτῆς καὶ ἐν πάσαις ταῖς πόλεσιν ταῖς παρὰ τὸν Ιορδάνην τριακόσια ἔτη τί ὅτι οὐκ ἐρρύσαντο αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ

text_en: Therefore I do not trespass against you, but you wrong me by declaring an unjust war against me. The Lord be judge, and decide this day, between Israel and the children of Ammon .
text_la: Igitur non ego pecco in te, sed tu contra me male agis, indicens mihi bella non justa. Judicet Dominus arbiter hujus diei inter Israël, et inter filios Ammon.
text_pt: Tampouco pequei eu contra ti! Porém tu usas mal comigo em pelejar contra mim; o Senhor, que é juiz julgue hoje entre os filhos de Israel e entre os filhos de Amom.
text_el: καὶ ἐγὼ οὐχ ἥμαρτόν σοι καὶ σὺ ποιεῖς μετ' ἐμοῦ πονηρίαν τοῦ πολεμῆσαι ἐν ἐμοί κρίναι κύριος ὁ κρίνων σήμερον ἀνὰ μέσον υἱῶν Ισραηλ καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον υἱῶν Αμμων

text_en: And the king of the children of Ammon would not hearken to the words of Jephte , which he sent him by the messengers.
text_la: Noluitque acquiescere rex filiorum Ammon verbis Jephte, quæ per nuntios mandaverat.
text_pt: Porém o rei dos filhos de Amom não deu ouvidos às palavras que Jefté lhe enviou.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ εἰσήκουσεν βασιλεὺς υἱῶν Αμμων καὶ οὐκ εἰσήκουσεν τῶν λόγων Ιεφθαε ὧν ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς αὐτόν

text_en: Therefore the spirit of the Lord came upon Jephte , and going round Galaad, and Manasses , and Maspha of Galaad , and passing over from thence to the children of Ammon ,
text_la: Factus est ergo super Jephte spiritus Domini, et circuiens Galaad et Manasse, Maspha quoque Galaad, et inde transiens ad filios Ammon,
text_pt: Então o Espírito do Senhor veio sobre Jefté, e atravessou ele por Gileade e Manassés, passando por Mizpá de Gileade, e de Mizpá de Gileade passou até aos filhos de Amom.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη ἐπὶ Ιεφθαε πνεῦμα κυρίου καὶ διέβη τὴν γῆν Γαλααδ καὶ τὸν Μανασση καὶ διέβη τὴν σκοπιὰν Γαλααδ καὶ ἀπὸ σκοπιᾶς Γαλααδ εἰς τὸ πέραν υἱῶν Αμμων

text_en: he made a vow to the Lord , saying: If you will deliver the children of Ammon into my hands,
text_la: votum vovit Domino, dicens : Si tradideris filios Ammon in manus meas,
text_pt: E Jefté fez um voto ao Senhor, e disse: Se totalmente deres os filhos de Amom na minha mão,
text_el: καὶ ηὔξατο Ιεφθαε εὐχὴν τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ εἶπεν ἐὰν παραδώσει παραδῷς μοι τοὺς υἱοὺς Αμμων ἐν χειρί μου

text_en: whosoever shall first come forth out of the doors of my house, and shall meet me, when I return in peace from the children of Ammon , the same will I offer a holocaust to the Lord .
text_la: quicumque primus fuerit egressus de foribus domus meæ, mihique occurrerit revertenti cum pace a filiis Ammon, eum holocaustum offeram Domino.
text_pt: Aquilo que, saindo da porta de minha casa, me vier ao encontro, voltando eu dos filhos de Amom em paz, isso será do Senhor, e o oferecerei em holocausto.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὃς ἂν ἐξέλθῃ ἐκ τῶν θυρῶν τοῦ οἴκου μου εἰς ἀπάντησίν μου ἐν τῷ ἐπιστρέψαι με ἐν εἰρήνῃ ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν Αμμων καὶ ἔσται τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ ἀνοίσω αὐτὸν ὁλοκαύτωμα

text_en: And Jephte passed over to the children of Ammon to fight against them: and the Lord delivered them into his hands.
text_la: Transivitque Jephte ad filios Ammon, ut pugnaret contra eos : quos tradidit Dominus in manus ejus.
text_pt: Assim Jefté passou aos filhos de Amom, a combater contra eles; e o Senhor os deu na sua mão.
text_el: καὶ διέβη Ιεφθαε πρὸς τοὺς υἱοὺς Αμμων τοῦ πολεμῆσαι πρὸς αὐτούς καὶ παρέδωκεν αὐτοὺς κύριος ἐν χειρὶ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he smote them from Aroer till you come to Mennith, twenty cities, and as far as Abel , which is set with vineyards, with a very great slaughter: and the children of Ammon were humbled by the children of Israel .
text_la: Percussitque ab Aroër usque dum venias in Mennith, viginti civitates, et usque ad Abel, quæ est vineis consita, plaga magna nimis : humiliatique sunt filii Ammon a filiis Israël.
text_pt: E os feriu com grande mortandade, desde Aroer até chegar a Minite, vinte cidades, e até Abel-Queramim; assim foram subjugados os filhos de Amom diante dos filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ Αροηρ καὶ ἕως τοῦ ἐλθεῖν εἰς Σεμωιθ εἴκοσι πόλεις ἕως Αβελ ἀμπελώνων πληγὴν μεγάλην σφόδρα καὶ ἐνετράπησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Αμμων ἀπὸ προσώπου υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: And when Jephte returned into Maspha , to his house, his only daughter met him with timbrels and with dances : for he had no other children.
text_la: Revertente autem Jephte in Maspha domum suam, occurrit ei unigenita filia sua cum tympanis et choris : non enim habebat alios liberos.
text_pt: Vindo, pois, Jefté a Mizpá, à sua casa, eis que a sua filha lhe saiu ao encontro com adufes e com danças; e era ela a única filha; não tinha ele outro filho nem filha.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν Ιεφθαε εἰς Μασσηφα εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἰδοὺ ἡ θυγάτηρ αὐτοῦ ἐξεπορεύετο εἰς ἀπάντησιν αὐτοῦ ἐν τυμπάνοις καὶ χοροῖς καὶ αὕτη μονογενὴς αὐτῷ ἀγαπητή καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν αὐτῷ πλὴν αὐτῆς υἱὸς ἢ θυγάτηρ

text_en: And when he saw her, he rent his garments, and said: Alas! My daughter, you have deceived me, and you yourself are deceived : for I have opened my mouth to the Lord , and I can do no other thing.
text_la: Qua visa, scidit vestimenta sua, et ait : Heu me, filia mea! decepisti me, et ipsa decepta es : aperui enim os meum ad Dominum, et aliud facere non potero.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, quando a viu, rasgou as suas vestes, e disse: Ah! filha minha, muito me abateste, e estás entre os que me turbam! Porque eu abri a minha boca ao Senhor, e não tornarei atrás.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη ἡνίκα εἶδεν αὐτήν καὶ διέρρηξεν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν οἴμμοι θύγατέρ μου ἐμπεποδοστάτηκάς με εἰς σκῶλον ἐγένου ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς μου ἐγὼ δὲ ἤνοιξα τὸ στόμα μου περὶ σοῦ πρὸς κύριον καὶ οὐ δυνήσομαι ἀποστρέψαι

text_en: And she answered him: My father, if you have opened your mouth to the Lord , do unto me whatsoever you have promised, since the victory has been granted to you, and revenge of your enemies.
text_la: Cui illa respondit : Pater mi, si aperuisti os tuum ad Dominum, fac mihi quodcumque pollicitus es, concessa tibi ultione atque victoria de hostibus tuis.
text_pt: E ela lhe disse: Meu pai, tu deste a palavra ao Senhor, faze de mim conforme o que prometeste; pois o Senhor te vingou dos teus inimigos, os filhos de Amom.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν πάτερ μου εἰ ἐν ἐμοὶ ἤνοιξας τὸ στόμα σου πρὸς κύριον ποίει μοι ὃν τρόπον ἐξῆλθεν ἐκ τοῦ στόματός σου ἀνθ' ὧν ἐποίησέν σοι κύριος ἐκδικήσεις ἐκ τῶν ἐχθρῶν σου ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Αμμων

text_en: And she said to her father: Grant me only this, which I desire: Let me go, that I may go about the mountains for two months, and may bewail my virginity with my companions.
text_la: Dixitque ad patrem : Hoc solum mihi præsta quod deprecor : dimitte me ut duobus mensibus circumeam montes, et plangam virginitatem meam cum sodalibus meis.
text_pt: Disse mais a seu pai: Concede-me isto: Deixa-me por dois meses que vá, e desça pelos montes, e chore a minha virgindade, eu e as minhas companheiras.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς τὸν πατέρα αὐτῆς καὶ ποίησόν μοι τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο ἔασόν με δύο μῆνας καὶ πορεύσομαι καὶ καταβήσομαι ἐπὶ τὰ ὄρη καὶ κλαύσομαι ἐπὶ τὰ παρθένιά μου καὶ ἐγὼ καὶ αἱ συνεταιρίδες μου

text_en: And he answered her: Go. And he sent her away for two months. And when she had gone with her comrades and companions, she mourned her virginity in the mountains.
text_la: Cui ille respondit : Vade. Et dimisit eam duobus mensibus. Cumque abiisset cum sociis ac sodalibus suis, flebat virginitatem suam in montibus.
text_pt: E disse ele: Vai. E deixou-a ir por dois meses; então foi ela com as suas companheiras, e chorou a sua virgindade pelos montes.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πορεύου καὶ ἐξαπέστειλεν αὐτὴν δύο μῆνας καὶ ἐπορεύθη αὐτὴ καὶ αἱ συνεταιρίδες αὐτῆς καὶ ἔκλαυσεν ἐπὶ τὰ παρθένια αὐτῆς ἐπὶ τὰ ὄρη

text_en: And the two months being expired, she returned to her father, and he did to her as he had vowed , and she knew no man . From thence came a fashion in Israel , and a custom has been kept:
text_la: Expletisque duobus mensibus, reversa est ad patrem suum, et fecit ei sicut voverat, quæ ignorabat virum. Exinde mos increbruit in Israël, et consuetudo servata est,
text_pt: E sucedeu que, ao fim de dois meses, tornou ela para seu pai, o qual cumpriu nela o seu voto que tinha feito; e ela não conheceu homem; e daí veio o costume de Israel,
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ τέλος δύο μηνῶν καὶ ἀνέκαμψεν πρὸς τὸν πατέρα αὐτῆς καὶ ἐπετέλεσεν Ιεφθαε τὴν εὐχὴν αὐτοῦ ἣν ηὔξατο καὶ αὐτὴ οὐκ ἔγνω ἄνδρα καὶ ἐγενήθη εἰς πρόσταγμα ἐν Ισραηλ

text_en: That, from year to year, the daughters of Israel assemble together, and lament the daughter of Jephte the Galaadite, for four days.
text_la: ut post anni circulum conveniant in unum filiæ Israël, et plangant filiam Jephte Galaaditæ diebus quatuor.
text_pt: Que as filhas de Israel iam de ano em ano lamentar, por quatro dias, a filha de Jefté, o gileadita.
text_el: ἐξ ἡμερῶν εἰς ἡμέρας συνεπορεύοντο αἱ θυγατέρες Ισραηλ θρηνεῖν τὴν θυγατέρα Ιεφθαε τοῦ Γαλααδίτου τέσσαρας ἡμέρας ἐν τῷ ἐνιαυτῷ

text_en: But behold there arose a sedition in Ephraim. And passing towards the north, they said to Jephte : When you went to fight against the children of Ammon , why would you not call us, that we might go with you? Therefore we will burn your house.
text_la: Ecce autem in Ephraim orta est seditio : nam transeuntes contra aquilonem, dixerunt ad Jephte : Quare vadens ad pugnam contra filios Ammon, vocare nos noluisti, ut pergeremus tecum? igitur incendemus domum tuam.
text_pt: Então se convocaram os homens de Efraim, e passaram para o norte, e disseram a Jefté: Por que passaste a combater contra os filhos de Amom, e não nos chamaste para ir contigo? Queimaremos a fogo a tua casa contigo.
text_el: καὶ συνήχθησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Εφραιμ καὶ ἦλθον εἰς Σεφινα καὶ εἶπον πρὸς Ιεφθαε τί ὅτι ἐπορεύθης πολεμεῖν ἐν τοῖς υἱοῖς Αμμων καὶ ἡμᾶς οὐ κέκληκας πορευθῆναι μετὰ σοῦ τὸν οἶκόν σου ἐμπρήσομεν ἐν πυρί

text_en: And he answered them: I and my people were at great strife with the children of Ammon : and I called you to assist me, and you would not do it.
text_la: Quibus ille respondit : Disceptatio erat mihi et populo meo contra filios Ammon vehemens : vocavique vos, ut præberetis mihi auxilium, et facere noluistis.
text_pt: E Jefté lhes disse: Eu e o meu povo tivemos grande contenda com os filhos de Amom; e chamei-vos, e não me livrastes da sua mão;
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς Ιεφθαε ἀνὴρ ἀντιδικῶν ἤμην ἐγὼ καὶ ὁ λαός μου καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Αμμων ἐταπείνουν με σφόδρα καὶ ἐβόησα πρὸς ὑμᾶς καὶ οὐκ ἐσώσατέ με ἐκ χειρὸς αὐτῶν

text_en: And when I saw this, I put my life in my own hands, and passed over against the children of Ammon and the Lord delivered them into my hands. What have I deserved, that you should rise up to fight against me?
text_la: Quod cernens, posui animam meam in manibus meis, transivique ad filios Ammon, et tradidit eos Dominus in manus meas. Quid commerui, ut adversum me consurgatis in prælium?
text_pt: E, vendo eu que não me livráveis, arrisquei a minha vida, e passei contra os filhos de Amom, e o Senhor mos entregou nas mãos; por que, pois, subistes vós hoje, para combater contra mim?
text_el: καὶ εἶδον ὅτι οὐκ ἦν ὁ σῴζων καὶ ἐθέμην τὴν ψυχήν μου ἐν τῇ χειρί μου καὶ διέβην πρὸς τοὺς υἱοὺς Αμμων καὶ παρέδωκεν αὐτοὺς κύριος ἐν χειρί μου καὶ ἵνα τί ἀνέβητε πρός με τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ταύτῃ τοῦ πολεμεῖν ἐν ἐμοί

text_en: Then calling to him all the men of Galaad, he fought against Ephraim: and the men of Galaad defeated Ephraim, because he had said: Galaad is a fugitive of Ephraim, and dwells in the midst of Ephraim and Manasses .
text_la: Vocatis itaque ad se cunctis viris Galaad, pugnabat contra Ephraim : percusseruntque viri Galaad Ephraim, quia dixerat : Fugitivus est Galaad de Ephraim, et habitat in medio Ephraim et Manasse.
text_pt: E ajuntou Jefté a todos os homens de Gileade, e combateu contra Efraim; e os homens de Gileade feriram a Efraim; porque este dissera-lhe: Fugitivos sois de Efraim, vós gileaditas que habitais entre Efraim e Manassés,
text_el: καὶ συνήθροισεν Ιεφθαε πάντας τοὺς ἄνδρας Γαλααδ καὶ ἐπολέμει τὸν Εφραιμ καὶ ἐπάταξαν ἄνδρες Γαλααδ τὸν Εφραιμ ὅτι εἶπαν οἱ διασεσῳσμένοι τοῦ Εφραιμ ὑμεῖς Γαλααδ ἐν μέσῳ Εφραιμ καὶ ἐν μέσῳ Μανασση

text_en: And the Galaadites secured the fords of the Jordan , by which Ephraim was to return. And when any one of the number of Ephraim came thither in the flight, and said: I beseech you let me pass: the Galaadites said to him: Are you not an Ephraimite? If he said: I am not:
text_la: Occupaveruntque Galaaditæ vada Jordanis, per quæ Ephraim reversurus erat. Cumque venisset ad ea de Ephraim numero, fugiens, atque dixisset : Obsecro ut me transire permittatis : dicebant ei Galaaditæ : Numquid Ephrathæus es? quo dicente : Non sum:
text_pt: Porque tomaram os gileaditas aos efraimitas os vaus do Jordão; e sucedeu que, quando algum dos fugitivos de Efraim dizia: Deixai-me passar; então os gileaditas perguntavam: És tu efraimita? E dizendo ele: Não,
text_el: καὶ προκατελάβοντο ἄνδρες Γαλααδ τὰς διαβάσεις τοῦ Ιορδάνου τοῦ Εφραιμ καὶ ἐγενήθη ὅτι εἶπαν οἱ διασεσῳσμένοι τοῦ Εφραιμ διαβῶμεν καὶ εἶπαν αὐτοῖς οἱ ἄνδρες Γαλααδ μὴ ὑμεῖς ἐκ τοῦ Εφραιμ καὶ εἶπαν οὔκ ἐσμεν

text_en: They asked him: Say then, Scibboleth , which is interpreted, An ear of corn . But he answered, Sibboleth , not being able to express an ear of corn by the same letter. Then presently they took him and killed him in the very passage of the Jordan . And there fell at that time of Ephraim, two and forty thousand.
text_la: interrogabant eum : Dic ergo Scibboleth, quod interpretatur Spica. Qui respondebat : Sibboleth : eadem littera spicam exprimere non valens. Statimque apprehensum jugulabant in ipso Jordanis transitu. Et ceciderunt in illo tempore de Ephraim quadraginta duo millia.
text_pt: Então lhe diziam: Dize, pois, Chibolete; porém ele dizia: Sibolete; porque não o podia pronunciar bem; então pegavam dele, e o degolavam nos vaus do Jordão; e caíram de Efraim naquele tempo quarenta e dois mil.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν αὐτοῖς εἴπατε δὴ σύνθημα καὶ οὐ κατηύθυναν τοῦ λαλῆσαι οὕτως καὶ ἐπελάβοντο αὐτῶν καὶ ἔσφαξαν αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ τὰς διαβάσεις τοῦ Ιορδάνου καὶ ἔπεσαν ἐξ Εφραιμ ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ δύο τεσσαράκοντα χιλιάδες

text_en: And Jephte , the Galaadite, judged Israel six years: and he died, and was buried in his city of Galaad.
text_la: Judicavit itaque Jephte Galaadites Israël sex annis : et mortuus est, ac sepultus in civitate sua Galaad.
text_pt: E Jefté julgou a Israel seis anos; e Jefté, o gileadita, faleceu, e foi sepultado numa das cidades de Gileade.
text_el: καὶ ἔκρινεν Ιεφθαε τὸν Ισραηλ ἓξ ἔτη καὶ ἀπέθανεν Ιεφθαε ὁ Γαλααδίτης καὶ ἐτάφη ἐν τῇ πόλει αὐτοῦ Γαλααδ

text_en: After him Abesan of Bethlehem judged Israel :
text_la: Post hunc judicavit Israël Abesan de Bethlehem:
text_pt: E depois dele julgou a Israel Ibzã de Belém.
text_el: καὶ ἔκρινεν μετ' αὐτὸν τὸν Ισραηλ Εσεβων ἐκ Βαιθλεεμ

text_en: He had thirty sons, and as many daughters, whom he sent abroad, and gave to husbands, and took wives for his sons, of the same number, bringing them into his house. And he judged Israel seven years:
text_la: qui habuit triginta filios, et totidem filias, quas emittens foras, maritis dedit, et ejusdem numeri filiis suis accepit uxores, introducens in domum suam. Qui septem annis judicavit Israël:
text_pt: E tinha este trinta filhos, e trinta filhas que casou fora; e trinta filhas trouxe de fora para seus filhos; e julgou a Israel sete anos.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένοντο αὐτῷ τριάκοντα υἱοὶ καὶ τριάκοντα θυγατέρες ἐξαπεσταλμέναι ἔξω καὶ τριάκοντα γυναῖκας εἰσήγαγεν τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ ἔξωθεν καὶ ἔκρινεν τὸν Ισραηλ ἑπτὰ ἔτη

text_en: And he died, and was buried in Bethlehem .
text_la: mortuusque est, ac sepultus in Bethlehem.
text_pt: Então faleceu Ibzã, e foi sepultado em Belém.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέθανεν Εσεβων καὶ ἐτάφη ἐν Βηθλεεμ

text_en: To him succeeded Ahialon, a Zabulonite : and he judged Israel ten years:
text_la: Cui successit Ahialon Zabulonites: et judicavit Israël decem annis:
text_pt: E depois dele julgou a Israel Elom, o zebulonita; e julgou a Israel dez anos.
text_el: καὶ ἔκρινεν μετ' αὐτὸν τὸν Ισραηλ Αιλων ὁ Ζαβουλωνίτης καὶ ἔκρινεν τὸν Ισραηλ δέκα ἔτη

text_en: And he died, and was buried in Zabulon .
text_la: mortuusque est, ac sepultus in Zabulon.
text_pt: E faleceu Elom, o zebulonita, e foi sepultado em Aijalom, na terra de Zebulom.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέθανεν Αιλων ὁ Ζαβουλωνίτης ἐν Αιλιμ καὶ ἔθαψαν αὐτὸν ἐν γῇ Ζαβουλων

text_en: After him, Abdon, the son of Illel, a Pharathonite, judged Israel :
text_la: Post hunc judicavit Israël Abdon filius Illel Pharathonites:
text_pt: E depois dele julgou a Israel Abdom, filho de Hilel, o piratonita.
text_el: καὶ ἔκρινεν μετ' αὐτὸν τὸν Ισραηλ Λαβδων υἱὸς Σελλημ ὁ Φρααθωνίτης

text_en: And he had forty sons, and of them thirty grandsons, mounted upon seventy ass colts, and he judged Israel eight years:
text_la: qui habuit quadraginta filios, et triginta ex eis nepotes, ascendentes super septuaginta pullos asinarum. Et judicavit Israël octo annis:
text_pt: E tinha este quarenta filhos, e trinta netos, que cavalgavam sobre setenta jumentos; e julgou a Israel oito anos.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένοντο αὐτῷ τεσσαράκοντα υἱοὶ καὶ τριάκοντα υἱοὶ τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ ἐπιβεβηκότες ἐπὶ ἑβδομήκοντα πώλους καὶ ἔκρινεν τὸν Ισραηλ ὀκτὼ ἔτη

text_en: And he died, and was buried in Pharathon, in the land of Ephraim, in the mount of Amalech.
text_la: mortuusque est, ac sepultus in Pharathon terræ Ephraim, in monte Amalec.
text_pt: Então faleceu Abdom, filho de Hilel, o piratonita; e foi sepultado em Piratom, na terra de Efraim, no monte dos amalequitas.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέθανεν Λαβδων υἱὸς Σελλημ ὁ Φρααθωνίτης καὶ ἐτάφη ἐν Φρααθων ἐν γῇ Εφραιμ ἐν ὄρει Λανακ

text_en: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the Lord : and he delivered them into the hands of the Philistines forty years.
text_la: Rursumque filii Israël fecerunt malum in conspectu Domini : qui tradidit eos in manus Philisthinorum quadraginta annis.
text_pt: E os filhos de Israel tornaram a fazer o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR, e o SENHOR os entregou na mão dos filisteus por quarenta anos.
text_el: καὶ προσέθεντο οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ποιῆσαι τὸ πονηρὸν ἐναντίον κυρίου καὶ παρέδωκεν αὐτοὺς κύριος ἐν χειρὶ ἀλλοφύλων τεσσαράκοντα ἔτη

text_en: Now there was a certain man of Saraa, and of the race of Dan , whose name was Manue, and his wife was barren.
text_la: Erat autem quidam vir de Saraa, et de stirpe Dan, nomine Manue, habens uxorem sterilem.
text_pt: E havia um homem de Zorá, da tribo de Dã, cujo nome era Manoá; e sua mulher, sendo estéril, não tinha filhos.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἀνὴρ ἐκ Σαραα ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς τοῦ Δαν καὶ ὄνομα αὐτῷ Μανωε καὶ ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ στεῖρα καὶ οὐκ ἔτικτεν

text_en: And an angel of the Lord appeared to her, and said: You are barren and without children: but you shall conceive and bear a son.
text_la: Cui apparuit angelus Domini, et dixit ad eam : Sterilis es et absque liberis : sed concipies, et paries filium.
text_pt: E o anjo do Senhor apareceu a esta mulher, e disse-lhe: Eis que agora és estéril, e nunca tens concebido; porém conceberás, e terás um filho.
text_el: καὶ ὤφθη ἄγγελος κυρίου πρὸς τὴν γυναῖκα καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτήν ἰδοὺ δὴ σὺ στεῖρα καὶ οὐ τέτοκας καὶ ἐν γαστρὶ ἕξεις καὶ τέξῃ υἱόν

text_en: Now therefore beware, and drink no wine nor strong drink, and eat not any unclean thing.
text_la: Cave ergo ne bibas vinum ac siceram, nec immundum quidquam comedas:
text_pt: Agora, pois, guarda-te de beber vinho, ou bebida forte, ou comer coisa imunda.
text_el: καὶ νῦν φύλαξαι καὶ μὴ πίῃς οἶνον καὶ σικερα καὶ μὴ φάγῃς πᾶν ἀκάθαρτον

text_en: Because you shall conceive, and bear a son, and no razor shall touch his head: for he shall be a Nazarite of God , from his infancy, and from his mother's womb, and he shall begin to deliver Israel from the hands of the Philistines .
text_la: quia concipies, et paries filium, cujus non tanget caput novacula : erit enim nazaræus Dei ab infantia sua et ex matris utero, et ipse incipiet liberare Israël de manu Philisthinorum.
text_pt: Porque eis que tu conceberás e terás um filho sobre cuja cabeça não passará navalha; porquanto o menino será nazireu de Deus desde o ventre; e ele começará a livrar a Israel da mão dos filisteus.
text_el: ὅτι ἰδοὺ σὺ ἐν γαστρὶ ἕξεις καὶ τέξῃ υἱόν καὶ οὐκ ἀναβήσεται σίδηρος ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἡγιασμένον ναζιραῖον ἔσται τῷ θεῷ τὸ παιδάριον ἐκ τῆς γαστρός καὶ αὐτὸς ἄρξεται σῴζειν τὸν Ισραηλ ἐκ χειρὸς ἀλλοφύλων

text_en: And when she had come to her husband, she said to him: A man of God came to me, having the countenance of an angel , very awful. And when I asked him whence he came, and by what name he was called, he would not tell me:
text_la: Quæ cum venisset ad maritum suum, dixit ei : Vir Dei venit ad me, habens vultum angelicum, terribilis nimis. Quem cum interrogassem quis esset, et unde venisset, et quo nomine vocaretur, noluit mihi dicere:
text_pt: Então a mulher entrou, e falou a seu marido, dizendo: Um homem de Deus veio a mim, cuja aparência era semelhante a de um anjo de Deus, terribilíssima; e não lhe perguntei donde era, nem ele me disse o seu nome.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν ἡ γυνὴ καὶ εἶπεν τῷ ἀνδρὶ αὐτῆς λέγουσα ὅτι ἄνθρωπος τοῦ θεοῦ ἦλθεν πρός με καὶ ἡ ὅρασις αὐτοῦ ὡς ὅρασις ἀγγέλου τοῦ θεοῦ ἐπιφανὴς σφόδρα καὶ ἠρώτων πόθεν ἐστίν καὶ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἀπήγγειλέν μοι

text_en: But he answered thus: Behold you shall conceive and bear a son: beware that you drink no wine, nor strong drink, nor eat any unclean thing: for the child shall be a Nazarite of God from his infancy, from his mother's womb until the day of his death.
text_la: sed hoc respondit : Ecce concipies et paries filium : cave ne vinum bibas, nec siceram, et ne aliquo vescaris immundo : erit enim puer nazaræus Dei ab infantia sua, ex utero matris suæ usque ad diem mortis suæ.
text_pt: Porém disse-me: Eis que tu conceberás e terás um filho; agora pois, não bebas vinho, nem bebida forte, e não comas coisa imunda; porque o menino será nazireu de Deus, desde o ventre até ao dia da sua morte.
text_el: καὶ εἶπέν μοι ἰδοὺ σὺ ἐν γαστρὶ ἕξεις καὶ τέξῃ υἱόν καὶ νῦν μὴ πίῃς οἶνον καὶ σικερα καὶ μὴ φάγῃς πᾶσαν ἀκαθαρσίαν ὅτι ναζιραῖον θεοῦ ἔσται τὸ παιδάριον ἀπὸ τῆς γαστρὸς ἕως ἡμέρας θανάτου αὐτοῦ

text_en: Then Manue prayed to the Lord , and said: I beseech you, O Lord , that the man of God , whom you sent, may come again, and teach us what we ought to do concerning the child, that shall be born.
text_la: Oravit itaque Manue Dominum, et ait : Obsecro, Domine, ut vir Dei, quem misisti, veniat iterum, et doceat nos quid debeamus facere de puero, qui nasciturus est.
text_pt: Então Manoá orou ao Senhor, e disse: Ah! Senhor meu, rogo-te que o homem de Deus, que enviaste, ainda venha para nós outra vez e nos ensine o que devemos fazer ao menino que há de nascer.
text_el: καὶ ἐδεήθη Μανωε τοῦ κυρίου καὶ εἶπεν ἐν ἐμοί κύριε ἄνθρωπος τοῦ θεοῦ ὃν ἀπέστειλας πρὸς ἡμᾶς ἐλθέτω δὴ πρὸς ἡμᾶς καὶ φωτισάτω ἡμᾶς τί ποιήσωμεν τῷ παιδαρίῳ τῷ τικτομένῳ

text_en: And the Lord heard the prayer of Manue, and the angel of the Lord appeared again to his wife, as she was sitting in the field. But Manue her husband was not with her. And when she saw the angel ,
text_la: Exaudivitque Dominus deprecantem Manue, et apparuit rursum angelus Dei uxori ejus sedenti in agro : Manue autem maritus ejus non erat cum ea. Quæ cum vidisset angelum,
text_pt: E Deus ouviu a voz de Manoá; e o anjo de Deus veio outra vez à mulher, e ela estava no campo, porém não estava com ela seu marido Manoá.
text_el: καὶ ἐπήκουσεν ὁ θεὸς τῆς φωνῆς Μανωε καὶ παρεγένετο ὁ ἄγγελος τοῦ θεοῦ ἔτι πρὸς τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτῆς καθημένης ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ καὶ Μανωε ὁ ἀνὴρ αὐτῆς οὐκ ἦν μετ' αὐτῆς

text_en: she made haste, and ran to her husband: and told him, saying: Behold the man has appeared to me, whom I saw before.
text_la: festinavit, et cucurrit ad virum suum : nuntiavitque ei, dicens : Ecce apparuit mihi vir, quem ante videram.
text_pt: Apressou-se, pois, a mulher, e correu, e noticiou-o a seu marido, e disse-lhe: Eis que aquele homem que veio a mim o outro dia me apareceu.
text_el: καὶ ἐτάχυνεν ἡ γυνὴ καὶ ἐξέδραμεν καὶ ἀπήγγειλεν τῷ ἀνδρὶ αὐτῆς καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν ἰδοὺ ὦπταί μοι ὁ ἀνὴρ ὁ ἐλθὼν πρός με τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ

text_en: He rose up, and followed his wife: and coming to the man , said to him: Are you he that spoke to the woman ? And he answered: I am.
text_la: Qui surrexit, et secutus est uxorem suam : veniensque ad virum, dixit ei : Tu es qui locutus es mulieri? Et ille respondit : Ego sum.
text_pt: Então Manoá levantou-se, e seguiu a sua mulher, e foi àquele homem, e disse-lhe: És tu aquele homem que falou a esta mulher? E disse: Eu sou.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστη Μανωε καὶ ἐπορεύθη ὀπίσω τῆς γυναικὸς αὐτοῦ πρὸς τὸν ἄνδρα καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ εἰ σὺ εἶ ὁ ἀνὴρ ὁ λαλήσας πρὸς τὴν γυναῖκα καὶ εἶπεν ὁ ἄγγελος ἐγώ

text_en: And Manue said to him: When your word shall come to pass, what will you that the child should do? Or from what shall he keep himself?
text_la: Cui Manue : Quando, inquit, sermo tuus fuerit expletus, quid vis ut faciat puer? aut a quo se observare debebit?
text_pt: Então disse Manoá: Cumpram-se as tuas palavras; mas qual será o modo de viver e o serviço do menino?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μανωε νῦν δὴ ἐλθόντος τοῦ ῥήματός σου τί ἔσται τὸ κρίμα τοῦ παιδαρίου καὶ τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the angel of the Lord said to Manue: From all the things I have spoken of to your wife, let her refrain herself:
text_la: Dixitque angelus Domini ad Manue : Ab omnibus, quæ locutus sum uxori tuæ, abstineat se,
text_pt: E disse o anjo do Senhor a Manoá: De tudo quanto eu disse à mulher se guardará ela.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ ἄγγελος κυρίου πρὸς Μανωε ἀπὸ πάντων ὧν εἶπα πρὸς τὴν γυναῖκα φυλαξάσθω

text_en: And let her eat nothing that comes of the vine, neither let her drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean thing: and whatsoever I have commanded her, let her fulfil and observe.
text_la: et quidquid ex vinea nascitur, non comedat : vinum et siceram non bibat; nullo vescatur immundo : et quod ei præcepi, impleat atque custodiat.
text_pt: De tudo quanto procede da videira não comerá, nem vinho nem bebida forte beberá, nem coisa imunda comerá; tudo quanto lhe tenho ordenado guardará.
text_el: ἀπὸ πάντων ὅσα ἐκπορεύεται ἐξ ἀμπέλου οὐ φάγεται καὶ οἶνον καὶ σικερα μὴ πιέτω καὶ πᾶν ἀκάθαρτον μὴ φαγέτω πάντα ὅσα ἐνετειλάμην αὐτῇ φυλαξάσθω

text_en: And Manue said to the angel of the Lord : I beseech you to consent to my request, and let us dress a kid for you.
text_la: Dixitque Manue ad angelum Domini : Obsecro te ut acquiescas precibus meis, et faciamus tibi hædum de capris.
text_pt: Então Manoá disse ao anjo do Senhor: Ora deixa que te detenhamos, e te preparemos um cabrito.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μανωε πρὸς τὸν ἄγγελον κυρίου βιασώμεθα δή σε καὶ ποιήσομεν ἐνώπιόν σου ἔριφον αἰγῶν

text_en: And the angel answered him: If you press me I will not eat of your bread: but if you will offer a holocaust , offer it to the Lord . And Manue knew not it was the angel of the Lord .
text_la: Cui respondit angelus : Si me cogis, non comedam panes tuos : si autem vis holocaustum facere, offer illud Domino. Et nesciebat Manue quod angelus Domini esset.
text_pt: Porém o anjo do Senhor disse a Manoá: Ainda que me detenhas, não comerei de teu pão; e se fizeres holocausto o oferecerás ao Senhor. Porque não sabia Manoá que era o anjo do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ ἄγγελος κυρίου πρὸς Μανωε ἐὰν βιάσῃ με οὐ φάγομαι τῶν ἄρτων σου καὶ ἐὰν ποιήσῃς ὁλοκαύτωμα κυρίῳ ἀνοίσεις αὐτό ὅτι οὐκ ἔγνω Μανωε ὅτι ἄγγελος κυρίου ἐστίν

text_en: And he said to him: What is your name , that, if your word shall come to pass, we may honour you?
text_la: Dixitque ad eum : Quod est tibi nomen, ut, si sermo tuus fuerit expletus, honoremus te?
text_pt: E disse Manoá ao anjo do Senhor: Qual é o teu nome, para que, quando se cumprir a tua palavra, te honremos?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μανωε πρὸς τὸν ἄγγελον κυρίου τί ὄνομά σοι ἵνα ὅταν ἔλθῃ τὸ ῥῆμά σου δοξάσωμέν σε

text_en: And he answered him: Why do you ask my name , which is wonderful?
text_la: Cui ille respondit : Cur quæris nomen meum, quod est mirabile?
text_pt: E o anjo do Senhor lhe disse: Por que perguntas assim pelo meu nome, visto que é maravilhoso?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ ἄγγελος κυρίου ἵνα τί τοῦτο ἐρωτᾷς τὸ ὄνομά μου καὶ αὐτό ἐστιν θαυμαστόν

text_en: Then Manue took a kid of the flocks, and the libations, and put them upon a rock, offering to the Lord , who does wonderful things: and he and his wife looked on.
text_la: Tulit itaque Manue hædum de capris, et libamenta, et posuit super petram, offerens Domino, qui facit mirabilia : ipse autem et uxor ejus intuebantur.
text_pt: Então Manoá tomou um cabrito e uma oferta de alimentos, e os ofereceu sobre uma penha ao Senhor: e houve-se o anjo maravilhosamente, observando-o Manoá e sua mulher.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Μανωε τὸν ἔριφον τῶν αἰγῶν καὶ τὴν θυσίαν καὶ ἀνήνεγκεν ἐπὶ τὴν πέτραν τῷ κυρίῳ τῷ θαυμαστὰ ποιοῦντι κυρίῳ καὶ Μανωε καὶ ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ ἐθεώρουν

text_en: And when the flame from the altar went up towards heaven , the angel of the Lord ascended also in the same. And when Manue and his wife saw this, they fell flat on the ground;
